full_details:
Jharkhand govt. has approved the Paddy Procurement Scheme (धान अधिप्राप्ति योजना) for farmers on 27 November 2018. This scheme aims to purchase dhaan from farmers at Rs. 1750 per quintal which is also the minimum support price (MSP) fixed by the central government. This decision was taken in the cabinet meeting presided over by CM Raghubar Das. 

The state govt. is also considering to continue bonus to farmers for the current financial year. The procurement under Dhaan Adhiprapti Yojana will start from 1st December 2018 to 31 March 2019. To procure paddy, certain changes have been made in the Food Corporation of India (FCI) model. 

At each paddy procurement center, one government officer, one PACS officer and one operator cum account would remain present to provide procurement information to the government.

Jharkhand Paddy Procurement Scheme to Purchase Paddy from Farmers

The state govt. of Jharkhand has fixed a target to procure 4 lakh metric tonne of paddy from farmers. The Paddy Procurement Scheme (Dhaan Adhiprapti Yojana) will start from 1 December 2018 and will end on 31 March 2019. Till date, there are 239 paddy procurement centers in the state and the numbers of these centers can be increased by the concerned department if needed. 

Farmers will get Rs. 1750 for one quintal of paddy as per the MSP fixed by the Modi government. The payment of paddy will go directly into the bank accounts of the farmers through NEFT / RTGS or DBT modes. Bonus is being under consideration and the concerned department is going to submit the report on expenses incurred for bonus. After consideration of this report, the final decision on bonus would be taken.

All the farmers would get information regarding selling of their paddy through SMS or mobile phones. Farmers can then contact the paddy procurement centers to get the token and date to sell their dhaan. Moreover, all those farmers who have not obtained token will again get SMS on their mobile phones to sell their crops in a sequence wise manner. Under Santhal Pargana division, the state govt. will procure paddy through decentralized system in districts Godda, Deoghar, Dumka, Jamtara, Sahibganj and Pakur. 

एक दिसंबर से न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य पर राज्य सरकार 239 केंद्रों पर धान खरीदेगी। अन्नदाता किसानों को प्रति क्विंटल 1750 रुपये समर्थन मूल्य का भुगतान किया जाएगा। #AgriSummit2018 pic.twitter.com/ByBpqQE9XP

— Raghubar Das (@dasraghubar) November 28, 2018

In Palamu division (Palamu, Garhwa, Latehar), the state govt. has choosen the FCI as the nodal agency for procurement. In North Chotanagpur division (Chatra, Hazaribagh, Koderma, Giridih, Ramgarh, Bokaro, Dhanbad), South Chotanagpur division (Lohardaga, Gumla, Simdega, Ranchi, Khunti), Kolhan division (West Singhbhum, Saraikela Kharsawan, East Singhbhum) and Santhal Pargana division (Godda, Deoghar, Dumka, Jamtara, Sahibganj and Pakur), procurement would be done through Jharkhand State Food and Civil Supplies Corporation Ltd.

The state govt. has allocated a fund of Rs. 200 crore for paddy procurement (dhaan adhiprapti) which was previously reserved for sugar procurement. All the farmers will get prices of their paddy within 15 days after selling their crops at the procurement centers.

Jharkhand govt. has launched Chief Minister Fellowship Yojana (CMFY) for Students. Subsequently, all the students can now make online applications for scholarships, grants and honorarium. Accordingly, CM Fellowship Yojana will enable the talented students to complete their studies through easy access to scholarships and grants. Interested candidates can apply online through the official website jhcmfellowship.nic.in

Now students will not have to make unnecessary visits to several departments. This online system will resolve the problem of the candidates who are unable to pursue their studies due to lack of funds. Moreover, govt. is taking efficient steps to raise the standards of higher education and also to promote research.

Furthermore, govt. is also taking steps to provide grants on scholarships. All the candidates who are not paying IT returns can make online registration for CM Fellowship Yojana through the official website from 25 January 2018.

Chief Minister Fellowship Yojana Online Registration Procedure

Below is the complete procedure to make online registration:-

Firstly visit the official website jhcmfellowship.nic.in

Subsequently on the homepage, click the “Registration for Student” link in the main menu.

Afterwards, a Student Registration Form will appear as shown below:-

Jharkhand Chief Minister Fellowship Yojana Students Registration Form

Here candidates have to enter the necessary details and click the “Sign Up” button to complete the registration process.

Subsequently, candidates can make “Login” using the ‘User ID’ and ‘Password’.

Accordingly, candidates have to select the “On Board Scheme Name” for which he is applying i.e UG level Scholarship or Research Fellowship and click the “Go to Instruction” section.

Henceforth, candidates will get directed to the “CM Scholarship Portal” where they can read the Instructions and click the “Accept” button.

The sample of “Under Graduate Scholarship Scheme Application Form” is shown below:-

Jharkhand Chief Minister Fellowship Yojana Students Application Form

Finally, candidates can fill the Application Form and make final submission of completed application form.

Similarly, students can apply for the Research Fellowship by selecting the “Research Fellowship Scheme” in the ‘On board Scheme Name’ and then fill and submit the completed Application Form. 

Jharkhand CM Fellowship Yojna

In order to encourage Higher Education in Jharkhand, the state govt. has launched online Chief Minister Fellowship Portal. Accordingly, Department of Higher and Technical Education will provide fellowship under 3 sections:-

Graduation level – All the candidates pursuing graduation / technical education in 163 best institutions which includes – 23 IIT, 19 IIM, 29 NIT, 17 Law Universities.

Ph.D Level – All candidates who have completed their PG Course and are pursuing Ph.D will get Rs. 15000 per month for the upcoming 3 years for research purpose.

Research Work – If the research subject is accepted by top 100 universities than students will get Rs. 1 lakh.

However, only the students who are not paying IT returns can apply for Chief Minister Fellowship Yojana.

In first phase, govt. will start this pilot project in Ranchi, Dumka, Jamshedpur, Dhanbad, Bokaro and Palamu.

Govt. will provide 3 to 5 days training to cleaners to bring them into category of skilled labourers. Now all such cleaner workers will would get Rs. 7053 assistance p.m instead of Rs. 6612 p.m. 

All the workers in cleaning occupation will get bicycles and their children in 9th to 12th class will get scholarship for studies. 

Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Annapurna Yojana

The state govt. will provide meals to poor hungry people in just Rs. 10 under Mukhyamantri Annapoorna Yojana. This will reduce Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) and will ensure proper nutrition to all especially to women and children. CM Raghubar Das has announced various other measures for the welfare of labourers and safai karmis. 

Now, in case of deaths due to accident, labourers and cleaners would be able to get Rs. 4 lakh assistance from the government. For this all workers and labourers will have to pay premium of Rs. 100 per annum. Any women or men labourers can avail assistance of Rs. 30,000 on the marriage of upto 2 children.

full_details:
Jharkhand govt. is going to launch Mukhbir Yojana to curb child marriage. Under this scheme, people who gives information regarding the child marriage plan to the authorities and becomes spy of govt. will get a cash reward of Rs. 1,000. Moreover, all the village panchayats with no case of child marriage in a single year will get Rs. 50,000.

Dept. of Health and Family Welfare has already sent this proposal to the central government for approval. The primary objective is to eliminate the curse of child marriage from the society. Necessary Counselling will be given to the child whose marriage was going to happen.

Tracking, Identification and Counselling of minor couples could be done by Sahiyas. They will make them understand the need of marriage at the appropriate age. Govt. will provide special training to all Sahiyas. 

The 2 important provisions of Mukhbir Yojana which are being sent to the Union Govt. includes:-

Reward of Rs. 1,000 –

Any person who wants to avail this reward must provide information to the Helpline Service Number 104 regarding the incident of child marriage.

This information should be provided before the marriage actually took place.

The given information must be found correct.

Finally, people will be able to receive a cash reward of Rs. 1000.

Reward of Rs. 50,000 – Any village panchayat in the state which has no reported cases of child marriage for the entire duration of a single year will get Rs. 50,000.

This scheme will create awareness in an extensive manner and will ensure that the complaints are addressed in timely manner. Recently in May 2018, the state govt. has launched a new toll free helpline number service (104) to counter cases of child marriages. All the reports received from the helpline service are sent to the cell In-charge and is further transferred to officials for speedy action.

Till date, 10 complaints are being reported for child marriage through this helpline number with maximum complaints from Ranchi distict. In India, Jharkhand alone reports around 38% of total cases of child marriage. As per the official data, Godda district includes maximum cases of child marriage with 63.5% cases. Next comes the Garhwa and Deoghar districts with 58.8% and 52.7% cases respectively.

Jharkhand govt. is going to launch Mukhyamantri Krishi Aashirwad Yojana 2019 – 2020 for farmers. Under this investment support scheme, govt. will provide financial assistance of Rs. 5,000 per acre for kharif crops every year. This Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana 2019 in Jharkhand is going to benefit around 22 lakh 76 thousand small and marginal farmers in the state.

In order to successfully implement Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Krishi Aashirwad Yojana, govt. will spend Rs. 2,250 crore. The main focus of this Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Scheme 2019-20 is to raise the agricultural production, eliminate agarian crisis and to overcome farmers distress.

It is essential to note that only those small and marginal farmers whose total land holding is less than 5 acres can avail the scheme benefits. This scheme will realize the PM Modi’s vision of Doubling Farmers Income by 2022.

Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana 2019

Under Mukhyamantri Krishi Aashirwad Yojana, govt. will provide Rs. 5,000 per acre per annum to farmers for Kharif crops. All the farmers whose land holdings are less than 1 acre would also get minimum Rs. 5,000 every year. This assistance amount would be given through cheques under Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana 2019. Around 22.76 lakh small and marginal farmers would be benefited through this scheme. 

Govt. will make a budgetary provision of Rs. 2250 crore for this Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Krishi Aashirwad Yojana 2019-20. Around 45 lakh acres agricultural land would be covered under this Krishi Ashirwad Scheme. Now the farmers will not have to depend on any banks or money lenders to buy seeds (beej), compost (khaad) and to make other agricultural investment.

Jaharkhand Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana 2019 is an investment support scheme which will prevent farmers from taking loans as it will make them self dependent. The state govt. is consistently working to improve the financial conditions of farmers. Govt. is making loans available for farmers @0% interest rate. Moreover, govt. is paying Rs. 66 crore as premium for fasal bima (crop insurance) of 14.85 lakh farmers.

— Raghubar Das (@dasraghubar) December 21, 2018

Jharkhand govt. is going to raise the assistance under the Old Age Pension, Widow (Vidhwa) Pension and Viklang (Divyangjan) Pension Scheme from Rs. 600 to Rs. 1000 per month. This increment would be announced in the upcoming state budget for the FY 2019-20. The state govt. wants that the entire 3.25 crore population of the Jharkhand must not suffer from lack of money and their lives could be changed. 

The overall development of the the state only comes with people’s participation. The state govt. wants to get rid of the poverty through power of people, government policies and intent for development. 

For upliftment of citizens, govt. has also started various schemes for the welfare of people. Now, govt. has raised the social security benefits for poor citizens.

Jharkhand Old Age / Widow / Viklang Pension to Raise

In the Jharhand Budget 2019-20, the state govt. will make an announcement regarding the increase in the Old Age Pension, Widow (Vidhwa) Pension and Viklang Pension scheme. Now, all of these social security pension beneficiaries will get an increased amount from Rs. 600 to Rs. 1000 from next year. 

The raised pension amount of beneficiaries will be credited directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiaries. This decision is going to impact hugely to Old Age people, Widow women and Persons with Disability (PWDs) and will raise their living standards. 

Moreover, the directly credit going into the beneficiary account would also help in eliminating the need of middlemen and thus reducing middlemen. The state govt. is consistently working towards ensuring that the pension scheme benefits reaches the last person of the society.

scheme_name: Jharkhand International Migrant Workers Grant Scheme
description: The "Chief Minister Jharkhand International Migrant Worker Grant Scheme" aims to provide financial assistance to the dependents of Jharkhand residents who pass away while working abroad. This scheme ensures timely support to families affected by unforeseen tragedies during overseas employment.
department: Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Department
benefits: • Financial assistance of ₹5,00,000/- to dependents of deceased workers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a dependent of the deceased workers.
1. The deceased must be a Jharkhand resident and an Indian citizen.
1. The family’s annual income should not exceed ₹72,000/-. 
1. The deceased age should be between 15 to 65 years.
1. Eligible dependents include spouses, children, parents, or legal heirs.
1. Death must be certified by the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Step 1: The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the District Commissioner’s office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
OR
Download the application form from the official website.
Step 2: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Commissioner’s office.
Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Commissioner’s office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).
documents_required:
Death Certificate.
Copy of FIR/Post-mortem Report (if applicable).
Copy of the deceased migrant’s passport and visa.
Income Certificate of the dependent.
Residence Certificate of the deceased migrant in Jharkhand.
Two Self-attested Photographs of the dependent/claimant.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Krishi Rin Mafi Yojana
description: The objective of the scheme is to provide relief from the debt burden to short-term agricultural loan holders in the state. Under this scheme, outstanding loan amounts of up to ₹50,000/- in standard crop loan outstanding accounts as of 31st March 2020, will be waived.
department: Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry & Co-operative
benefits:
1. Under this scheme, outstanding loan amounts of up to ₹50,000/- in standard crop loan outstanding accounts as of 31st March 2020, will be waived.

Note: Repayment of outstanding loan through DBT.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Jharkhand.
 1. The age of the farmer should be more than 18 years.
 1. The applicant should be a farmer who self-cultivates their land or cultivates leased land.
 1. The applicant should be a small or marginal farmer who has availed of the loan through the Kisan Credit Card.
 1. The farmer should have a valid Aadhaar number.
 1. The applicant should be a valid ration card holder.
 1. The applicant should be a Kisan Credit Card holder.
 1. The applicant should be a short-term crop loan holder.
 1. The crop loan should be issued by a recognized bank located in Jharkhand.
 1. The family of the deceased debtor is also eligible under the scheme.
 1. The applicant should have a standard crop loan account.
 1. Only one member per family holding a crop loan will be eligible.
 1. This scheme will be voluntary for all crop loan holders.

Note: The applicant has to pay ₹1/- only for the application.
Eligibility for banks, criteria, determining outstanding loans and deadlines, eligible loan accounts, and exceptions:

 - Qualified Banks - Commercial Banks, Scheduled Co-operative Banks and Rural Banks
 - Qualifying Loan - Short-Term Crop Loan
 - Eligible period for disbursement - Upto 31.03.2020
 - Qualifying Loan Account - Single &amp; Joint
 - Loans taken for crop diseases
application_process:
Mode: Online. Step 1: Visit the "Jharkhand Krishi Rin Mafi Yojana" official website to apply for scheme benefits.
Step 2: On the home page, click on 'Beneficiary Registration' and then enter your Aadhaar Number.
Step 3: Your basic information, such as name and loan amount, will be displayed upon entering your Aadhaar number.
Step 4: Enter your ration card number.
Step 5: Click on the name under which the loan is registered.
Step 6: Review all displayed information carefully and click "Submit".
Step 7: Authenticate your Aadhaar to verify your identity.
Step 8: Proceed to make the application fee payment.
Step 9: After successful payment, receive a confirmation slip for your application.

[Online - via CSC]
The eligible applicant will have to follow the following procedures to avail the benefits of this scheme:-
Step 1: To apply for this scheme, the eligible applicant has to visit the Common Service Centers (CSCs)/Bank Branch with a copy of his/her Aadhaar Card and Ration Card.
Step 2: CSC Bank will help the applicant to view their outstanding loan amount and other details using their Aadhaar number on the scheme portal.
Step 3: The applicant will have to provide his/her mobile number and copy of Aadhaar and Ration Card for uploading on the scheme portal.
Step 4: Once the applicant confirms the outstanding details, he/she has to authenticate his application through e-KYC.
Step 5: Once the applicant confirms his/her details through e-KYC, his/her application will be automatically submitted to the scheme portal for further verification and processing.
Step 6: The applicant will receive a token number or reference number upon successful submission of his/her application. This can also be used for future reference.
Step 7: The applicant has to pay ₹1/- only for the application.
Step 8: The applicant can also receive the confirmation message of application submission on his/her mobile number.
Step 9: The applicant can be given a receipt for fee payment at the CSC centre.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Passport-size photograph
Proof of age
Ration card
Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
Bank account details/bank passbook
Other necessary documents if required

scheme_name: Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Gram Gadi Yojana
description: The scheme "Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Gram Gadi Yojana" by the Transport Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to enhance rural connectivity and provide affordable transportation facilities to rural residents. It supports private bus operators to operate on rural routes with financial assistance...
benefits:
• Financial Assistance: Operators receive financial support per kilometer based on bus seating capacity
 - 33 to 42 seats: ₹18 per km.
 - 25 to 32 seats: ₹14.50 per km.
 - 13 to 24 seats: ₹10.50 per km.
 - 7 to 12 seats: ₹7.50 per km.

• Tax and Fee Waivers: Exemption from road tax, permit fee (₹1), application fee (₹1), registration fee (₹1), and fitness inspection fee (₹1).- Priority Access: Rural buses are given priority at government bus stands and are exempted from all stand fees, tolls, and municipal entry fees.- Route Permits: Operators can obtain permits for routes up to 125 km, connecting villages to block/district headquarters and essential services.- Subsidies: Operators can avail subsidies for operational costs such as fuel (diesel).- Renewal Options: Permits are renewable after five years based on satisfactory performance or till the scheme's validity.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a private bus operator registered in Jharkhand.
1. The applicant must operate new light/medium commercial four-wheeled vehicles with seating capacities ranging from 7 to 42 (excluding the driver).
1. The applicant must ensure the vehicles comply with the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, and have either a Hard Top or Soft Top body.
1. Preference will be given to vehicles connecting rural routes to block/district headquarters, schools, colleges, hospitals, and main roads.
1. The applicant must agree to operate vehicles on approved routes and adhere to the fare structure prescribed by the government.
1. Operators who have previously violated permit conditions may be excluded from the scheme.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Step 1: Obtain the application form from the Regional Transport Office (RTO) or download it from the official transport department website.
Step 2: Fill out the application form with all necessary details, including personal, vehicle, and route information.
Step 3: Attach all required documents as mentioned above.
Step 4: Submit the completed application form along with a nominal fee of ₹1 at the respective (Regional Transport Office) RTO.
NOTE:
The application is reviewed by the Regional Transport Authority (RTA). Upon approval, permits are issued for the specified route.
Start bus operations as per the approved schedule and maintain compliance with scheme conditions.
Apply for permit renewal after five years, if applicable.
documents_required:
Passport-size Photographs.
Aadhaar Card (Proof of Identity).
Vehicle Registration Certificate (For new vehicles purchased as per scheme requirements).
Driver’s License (For the vehicle driver).
Permit Application Form (Duly filled and signed).
Vehicle Fitness Certificate.
Route Map/Proposal (Showing the rural route the bus will operate on).
Bank Account Details.
Affidavit of Compliance (Declaring adherence to scheme rules and regulations).

This kanya vivah sahayata scheme has been specifically designed in order to reduce the financial burden on the poor father in case of their daughter’s marriage. 

Under Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojna, the state govt. will support poor people in their daughter’s marriage who cannot afford the cost of marriage. Jharkhand govt. is going to provide assistance of Rs. 30,000 to each girl beneficiaries so that the condition of the girls in the state gets improved. This assistance is given as a help and beneficiaries does not need to repay this amount to the state government.

All the needy and eligible people of the state can download Mukhyamantri Kanyadan yojana form Jharkhand and apply for this scheme.

Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojna Form PDF Download

All the people who fulfills the eligibility criteria can download the Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojna form PDF. Here we are providing you the link to download the application form and the complete application process:-

All the applicants can download the application form through the link – Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojana Jharkhand Form Download

The Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojna application form will appear as follows:-

Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojna Form PDF

All the applicants can download and fill the Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojna application form.

Candidates can submit the duly filled application form along with the required documents at the Department of social and women’s welfare, the government of Jharkhand.

It is important to note that all the poor families must apply for assistance within one month of marriage.

Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojana Eligibility Criteria

All the candidates must fulfill the eligibility criteria for Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojana:-

Applicant must be a permanent resident of the Jharkhand state.

The annual income of the family of the applicant from all sources must not exceed Rs. 72000.

The bride and bridegroom must be of minimum legal age of the marriage. The age of the girl must be above 18 years and the age of boy must be more than 21 years.

All the applicants must belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

No member of the family of the applicant must be employed in any state or central govt. services.

The financial assistance is not applicable in the case of Re-marriage (पुर्नविवाह). However, widows can avail the scheme benefits in case of Re-marriage.

Orphan girls who does not belong to BPL category are also eligible and can avail assistance under Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojana.

List of Documents Required For Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojna 2018

Jharkhand govt. has launched Mukhyamantri Sukanya Yojana Scheme for girls from 1 January 2019. Under this Mukhya Mantri Sukanya Yojana, all the girls from their birth till the age of 18 years will get protsahan rashi of Rs. 30,000 (Rs. 5,000 at birth) through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. In case the girls remain unmarried till 20 years of age, then girls would get an additional Rs. 10,000 assistance.

The primary objective of Mukhya Mantri Sukanya Yojana is to support girls education and this scheme will benefit girls from around 36.57 lakh families. The government, non govt. entities and institutions of panchayati raj should work in coordination so that the social evils in the society could be removed. This encouragement amount is for better nurturing of girl child and to put an end on child marriage. 

With the works of the state government, the maternal mortality rate (MMR) and infant mortality rate (IMR) has been reduced in the previous 4 years, but there is still a long way ahead. So, govt. has decided to launch Mukhya Mantri Sukanya Yojana in the state. 

Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Sukanya Yojana 2019

The state govt. of Jharkhand has started Mukhya Mantri Sukanya Yojana from new year (Jan 2019) to curb under-nutrition and child marriages. Jharkhand govt. will work with UNICEF and civil society organizations for this purpose. Since the time of birth of child till they turn 20, the state govt. would timely provide them with financial aid for their social and economic development.

Mukhya Mantri Sukanya Yojana Amount

The amount to be provided by the state govt. of Jharkhand to the girl child from their birth till the age of 20 years is given below:-

Stages

Protsahan Rashi (Amount)

At birth till 2 years of age of girl child

Rs. 5,000

On taking admission in 1st class

Rs. 5000

Passing 5th class (admission in 6th class)

Rs. 5,000

Passing 8th

Rs. 5,000

On Passing 10th

Rs. 5,000

On Passing 12th

Rs. 5,000

Total (Till girl age is 18 years)

Rs. 30,000

18 to 20 year girls who are unmarried

Rs. 10,000

Total

Rs. 40,000

The funds would be directly transferred into their bank accounts through DBT. The state govt. is committed to remove poverty, migration, malnutrition and child marriages from the state. From 1 January 2019, 2 previously running schemes – Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojana & Mukhyamantri Ladli Lakshmi yojana would be terminated. 

Jharkhand Mukhya Mantri Sukanya Yojana in Hindi

राज्य योजना अंतर्गत “मुख्यमंत्री सुकन्या योजना” की स्वीकृति दी गई. झारखंड के 36 लाख 57 हजार 323 परिवार को इसका लाभ मिलेगा। इस योजना का मुख्य उद्देश्य महिला सशक्तिकरण को बढ़ावा देना, बालिका शिक्षा को प्रोत्साहित करना एवं बाल विवाह प्रथा का अंत करना है. इस योजना के तहत SECC-2011 (ग्रामीण) के अनुसार राज्य के योग्य लाभुक परिवार जिनकी संख्या 27,46,106 है एवं राज्य के सभी अंत्योदय राशन कार्डधारी परिवार जिनकी संख्या दिनांक 21 दिसम्बर, 2018 को 9,11,217 है, को मुख्यमंत्री सुकन्या योजना अंतर्गत बालिकाओं के कल्याण हेतु निम्न प्रकार आर्थिक सहायता प्रदान की जाएगी. इस प्रकार झारखंड के 36 लाख 57 हजार 323 परिवार को इसका लाभ मिलेगा।

मुख्यमंत्री सुकन्या योजना के तहत जन्म से 2 वर्ष उम्र तक की बालिका को आर्थिक लाभ ₹5000 दी जाएगी. कक्षा 1 में नामांकित होने वाली बालिका को ₹5000 की आर्थिक सहायता राशि दी जाएगी. पांचवी कक्षा उत्तीर्ण होने के पश्चात ₹5000 की सहायता राशि दी जाएगी. इसी प्रकार कक्षा आठवीं, कक्षा 10वीं एवं कक्षा बारहवीं उत्तीर्ण होने के पश्चात ₹5000 की आर्थिक सहायता राशि का लाभ मिलेगा.18 से 20 वर्ष उम्र की व्यस्क और अविवाहित को ₹10000 की आर्थिक सहायता राशि दी जाएगी.

झारखण्ड में आज से मुख्यमंत्री सुकन्या योजना की शुरुआत हो रही है। अब हमारी बेटियों के लालन-पालन और शिक्षा में नहीं आएगी कोई बाधा, ये है हमारा आपसे वादा। पहले पढ़ाई फिर विदाई का मूल मंत्र अपनाएं, बेटियों को आगे बढ़ाएं।#NewJharkhand pic.twitter.com/Pv8GS1aYcS

— Raghubar Das (@dasraghubar) January 24, 2019

Jharkhand Mukhya Mantri Sukanya Yojana Beneficiary Selection

Around 36,57,323 families would get benefited from Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Sukanya Yojana 2019. As per the SECC 2011 data, there are 27,46,106 eligible beneficiaries for the scheme in Jharkhand. Moreover around 9,11,271 Antyodaya Ration Card holders (as on 21 Dec 2018) would also get included in this Jharkhand Mukhya Mantri Sukanya Yojana.

In 5 districts namely Deoghar, Godda, Koderma, Giridih and Palamu, a large number of cases for child marriage has been emerged. So there is a need to provide special attention to those regions in the state of Jharkhand. 

पहले पढ़ाई फिर विदाई। इसी मूलमंत्र के साथ हमारी सरकार मुख्यमंत्री सुकन्या योजना लेकर आई है। बेटियों को खूब पढ़ाइए, हर कदम पर सरकार आपके साथ है।#NewJharkhand pic.twitter.com/wHAe4uKkCu

— Raghubar Das (@dasraghubar) January 4, 2019

At the time of nomination for class 1st, 6th, 9th and 11th, the financial amount would be given through DBT directly into the bank accounts of girls. This scheme will reduce the drop out rate of the girl child, curb child marriage and would also reduce corruption.

By providing the girls with financial aid, the govt. will ensure the better upbringing of girls. Financial incentives would be given to those who completed their 18 years of age without marriage. This is an important step to curb child marriage which will lead to the social upliftment of women.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana
description: "Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana" is a 100% State Sponsored scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides social security to all registered workers in the age group of 18-60 years.
department: Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Department
benefits:
In case of death in an accident, ₹ 5,00,000/-.
In case of complete disability in an accident, ₹ 3,00,000/-.
In case of partial disability in an accident, ₹ 2,00,000/-.
In case of normal death, ₹ 1,00,000/-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a registered Construction Worker (Nirman Shramik / Nirman Karmakar).
1. The applicant should be in the age group of 18-60 years.
1. The applicant should have worked for at least 90 days.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Registration:Step 1: Visit the Official website of Comprehensive Labour Management System for Factory Establishment / Worker Registration / Inspection / Management & Grievance Redressal; Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development; Govt. of Jharkhand.
Step 2: At the top right corner, click "Login". On the pop-up screen, click "Register Here".
Step 3: On the next page, a Registration Form will appear. Provide the following mandatory details: First Name, Last Name, Email, and Mobile. Create a Username and a Password. Confirm the Password. Fill in the Captcha Code. Click "Register". Your Mobile Number and Email ID will be verified via One Time Password (OTP). Upon successful verification of the OTP, your registration will be successful. The Login Credentials will be sent to your registered Email ID and Mobile Number.
Application:Step 1: Visit the Official website of Comprehensive Labour Management System for Factory Establishment / Worker Registration / Inspection / Management & Grievance Redressal; Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development; Govt. of Jharkhand.
https://shramadhan.jharkhand.gov.in/home
Step 2: At the top right corner, click "Login". Fill in your Username and Password. Click "Login".
Step 3: In the ribbon, click "Services > BOC Scheme Benefit > Application Form. On the next page, the "Scheme Benefit Form" (Application Form) will open. 
a) In the "Basic Details" section, fill in the mandatory fields (fields ending with a red asterisk mark): BOC Registration Number, Applicant's Name, Applicant's Father's Name / Husband's Name, Applicant's Date of Birth, Applicant's Aadhaar Number, District, Sex.
b) In the "Select Scheme" section, select the scheme from the list that you wish to apply for.
c) In the "Upload Section", upload the mandatory documents (those ending with a red asterisk mark) in the specified file size and file type.
Step 4: Finally, click on "Submit Request" to submit your application. On the next page, your "Application ID" will be displayed, confirming the successful submission of the application. Please note down this Application ID for future reference. The Application ID will also be sent to your registered Email ID.
Check Application Status: Step 1: Once submitted, the application goes for 3-level approval: Clerk > Labour Superintendent > DLC.
Step 2: Go to Services > BOC Scheme Benefit > Application Status.
Step 3: On the next page, fill in your Application ID, and click "Search". The status of your application will be displayed in a tabular format: Application ID, Applicant Name, Scheme Applied, Application Status, Remarks, Date, and Time. 
Step 4: Once the DLC approves the application, the "Application Status" changes to "Approved". The Applicant can take print of this page by clicking “PRINT” and submit the same at the Labour Office to avail of the scheme benefit.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Patrakar Samman Pension Niyamawali
description: The "Jharkhand Patrakar Samman Pension Niyamawali" aims to provide financial assistance to journalists who have served the state for an extended period. It ensures their well-being post-retirement and acknowledges their contribution to media and society.
benefits:
• A monthly pension of ₹7,500/- for journalists.
• The family pension of 50% of the journalist's pension goes to the spouse after their demise.
• Lifetime pension for retired journalists who meet the eligibility criteria.

NOTE: Pension payments are made directly to beneficiaries' bank accounts through an online transfer.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a journalist.
1. The applicant should have an employee as a full-time journalist/media professional for a minimum of 20 years in Jharkhand or undivided Bihar (pre-November 15, 2000).
1. The applicant should not be a pension beneficiary from any other media institution or government.
1. The applicant should have retired at the age of 58 or as per the retirement norms of the media organization.
1. The applicant should have an accreditation certificate issued by the Directorate of Information and Public Relations at the time of retirement.
1. The applicant must not have any criminal convictions leading to imprisonment of more than two years.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Step 1: The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications or the official online portal.
Step 2: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Director, Information and Public Relations Department, Jharkhand.
Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).
documents_required:
Self-declaration Affidavit (20 years of full-time service as a journalist in Jharkhand).
Service Duration Certificate (issued by the editor(s) of media organizations where the applicant worked).
Complete Details of contributions to the Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) for at least 20 years.
Accreditation Certificate (issued by the Information and Public Relations Directorate).
Proof of Retirement Age (58 years or organization-specific retirement letter).
Aadhaar Card or PAN Card for identification.
Bank Account Details with a nationalized bank.
Annual Life Certificate to be submitted in March each year.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Petrol Subsidy Scheme
description: The scheme "Petrol Subsidy Scheme" implemented by the Food, Public Distribution & Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide a petrol subsidy of ₹250 per month for two-wheelers to eligible NFSA/Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme beneficiaries.
department: Food, Public Distribution and Consumer affairs Department
benefits:
*Subsidy Amount*

• ₹25/- per liter of petrol for up to 10 liters monthly (₹250/month).

*Mode of Disbursement:* 

• Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary's bank account.
eligibility:
> *General Eligibility:*

1. The applicant should possess a valid ration card under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) or Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme.
1. All family members listed in the ration card must have Aadhaar numbers linked and verified.
1. The applicant's Aadhaar should be linked to a valid bank account and an updated mobile number.

> *Vehicle Eligibility:*

1. The applicant's two-wheeler must be registered in their name and in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant must possess a valid driving license.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Registration Process:Download the CMSUPPORT app or visit the official portal jsfss.jharkhand.gov.in.
Enter your ration card number and Aadhaar number.
An OTP will be sent to the mobile number linked to the Aadhaar. Verify the OTP.
Login Credentials:Use your ration card number as the login ID and the last 8 digits of your Aadhaar as the password.
Filling the Form:Select your name from the family members listed on the ration card.
Enter your two-wheeler's registration number and driving license details.
Verification Process:Submitted vehicle details are sent to the DTO (District Transport Office) for verification.
Post verification, the data is forwarded to the District Supply Officer (DSO) for final approval.
Approval and Disbursement:Once approved, the subsidy amount is transferred directly to the applicant's linked bank account through DBT.
documents_required:
Copy of Ration Card (NFSA/Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme).
Aadhaar Card of the Applicant (Linked to the Bank Account).

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
description: The scheme was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry & Cooperative, Government of Jharkhand. This scheme is mainly to provide financial assistance to the farmers in the event of crop damage due to any natural calamity and natural accidents.
department: Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry & Co-operative
benefits:
1. Under this scheme, assured financial assistance is provided to eligible farmers in the event of crop loss occurring due to natural calamity.
 1. In the event of 30-50% loss: ₹3,000/- per acre maximum upto 5 acres
 1. In the event of >50% loss: ₹4,000/- per acre maximum upto 5 acres

Note 1: Both Kharif (Paddy & Maize) and Rabi (Wheat, Mustard, Gram, and Potato) season crops are covered under this scheme.
Note 2: No intermediary role of insurance companies and no premiums are required to be paid by applicant farmers.
Note 3: Loss estimation through data of Crop Cutting Experiment.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Jharkhand.
 1. The applicant should be a small or marginal farmer.
 1. The applicant should be a ‘Raiyat’ or ‘Bataidaar’ farmer.
 1. The age of the farmer should be at least 18 years.
 1. The farmer should have a valid Aadhaar Number.
 1. Farmers cultivating on government or non-majorua land with lease or settlement documents from the Revenue Department are also eligible.
 1. The farmer should possess requisite land papers (LPC/Land Receipts).
 1. Farmers can avail benefits for agricultural land ranging from a minimum of 10 decimals to a maximum of 5 acres under the scheme.
 1. Crop assistance will be provided to farmers only in case of crop loss of at least 20%.
 1. This scheme will be voluntary for all farmers.

Note: Under the scheme, special efforts will be made to ensure maximum coverage of SC/ST/Women/Paharia Tribe/Primitive Tribe farmers.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Registration Process:Step 1: Visit the official website of the “Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana” to apply under the scheme.
Step 2: On the home page, click on ‘Farmer Registration’ and enter your Name, Aadhaar Number, Mobile Number, Captcha, and then click on ‘Get OTP’.
Step 3: After receiving the OTP, enter it to complete your registration.
Login to apply under the scheme:Step 1: Visit the official website of the “Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana”.
Step 2: Navigate to the ‘Registration’ section on the homepage and click on ‘Application’.
Step 3: Choose either your Aadhaar Number or Mobile Number for login, then select the Crop Season, enter your Aadhaar Number or Mobile Number, and provide your password and captcha before clicking ‘login’.
Step 4: Your basic information such as name, date of birth, and address will be displayed.
Step 5: Review all displayed information carefully, enter the captcha, and click on "Next".
Step 6: Upload the required ‘Declaration’ and other necessary documents.
Step 7: Re-check all entered information and uploaded documents to ensure accuracy.
Step 8: Upon submission, you will receive a confirmation slip confirming your application.

[Online - via CSC]
The eligible applicant may visit the nearest Common Service Centre to apply under the scheme.

scheme_name: Jharkhand Rajya Patrakar Swasth Bima Yojna Niyamawali 2021
description: The Jharkhand Rajya Patrakar Swasth Bima Yojna Niyamawali 2021 is a health insurance scheme for accredited journalists in Jharkhand. It provides comprehensive health coverage to ensure financial security during medical emergencies.
benefits:
• Health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000/- per year for accredited journalists.
• Coverage for self, spouse, and dependent children (up to 2).
• Includes expenses for hospitalization, surgeries, medicines, and treatments.
• Cashless treatment in empaneled hospitals.

> Note-1: The Jharkhand State Journalist Health Insurance Scheme is valid for one year, with renewal formalities required before its expiry.

> Note-2: Media representatives must deposit 20% of the annual premium via banker’s cheque/cheque/demand draft for health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000/- to the designated account of the Director, Information & Public Relations Directorate, Jharkhand Government, by the specified date. The remaining 80% of the annual premium will be covered by the Department.

> Claim Process:

• The insured media representative must provide complete details of dependents (spouse and two children) and nominate a beneficiary for claim settlement in the application form to receive medical reimbursement from the insurance company.
• In case of treatment or an accident, it is mandatory to inform the insurance company's district office and the Information and Public Relations Department, Ranchi, within a maximum of seven days.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must reside in Jharkhand and their work area should be within the state.
1. The applicant should be an accredited journalist in Jharkhand.
1. The media representatives must be from newspapers, magazines, news agencies, electronic media, or news-based electronic media.
1. The applicant must be regularly or contractually employed by the respective media organization.
1. The applicant must possess an accreditation certificate issued by the state government.
1. The journalist's age should be between 21 to 60 years. 
1. Freelance journalists must present valid press credentials issued by the Information and Public Relations Department at the time of applying.

description: The “Jharkhand Sportsperson Pension Scheme” aims to provide financial support to retired athletes for their lifelong contribution to sports. eligibility:
Eligibility Criteria for the Student:

1. The student should be a native of Jharkhand.
1. The student belongs to the Other Backward Class category.
1. The student's family annual income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-.
1. The student must be enrolled in a recognized educational institution that complies with the rules of the scheme and is registered on the departmental scholarship portal. The student should be pursuing a post-matric course (Degree, Diploma, Certificate, or equivalent). 
1. The student should not be receiving any other scholarship or financial assistance from the central or state government. 

Classification of Courses: [Page No. 18](https://ekalyan.cgg.gov.in/downloads/Post_Matric_Scholarship_sankalp_2022.pdf)
Group 1: Professional degree/postgraduate courses in institutions with A++ to B++ NAAC accreditation.
Group 2: Vocational and diploma courses requiring Class 12 or higher qualifications.
Group 3: Polytechnic and other courses not covered in Groups 1 or 2.
Group 4: Graduate and Post Graduate course.Group 5: All post-matriculation (Post Class X level non-degree courses).
application_process:
Mode: Online. Student Registration:
Students must apply online on the scholarship e-Kalyan portal designated by the Department of Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Minorities, and Backward Classes Welfare.
Students must first enter their Aadhaar number, name, date of birth, gender, mobile number while filling out the online registration form.
After Registration:
After validation, an application ID will be generated by the portal, which must be used to complete further steps of the application.
Students must provide the details of their Aadhaar-linked bank account under their name.
Students must upload the following documents to the portal. 
NOTE: Applications with bank account details in another person’s name will be rejected.
Verification by Educational Institutions:
After submitting the online application, it will be verified by the respective educational institution or college through the departmental portal.
Applications not verified by the institution/college will be deemed invalid.
NOTE: Offline applications will not be accepted under any circumstances.
Instruction for Educational Institutions under the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme:
All educational institutions must register on the departmental scholarship portal within the stipulated time to be covered under the scheme.
Institutions/colleges must submit the required documents as specified by the Tribal Welfare Commissioner, Jharkhand, Ranchi.
A prescribed form for registration will be made available on the scholarship portal by the Commissioner.
Only those institutions that maintain the prescribed academic standards are eligible under this scheme.
Institutions/colleges must possess a valid AISHE (All India Survey on Higher Education) or U-DISE (Unified District Information System for Education) code to qualify.
Institutions/colleges must register once on the portal, and the registration will remain valid for the duration of the course's recognition period.
Institutions must update their NAAC (National Assessment and Accreditation Council) or NBA (National Board of Accreditation) details on the portal.
The Tribal Welfare Commissioner will verify these details via the NAAC/NBA portal.
Institutions must submit a self-audited report every six months in a prescribed format to the Tribal Welfare Commissioner.
Each institution must designate a Nodal Officer (Institute Nodal Officer - INO) to handle all scholarship-related tasks and provide necessary information to the District Welfare Officer.
Institutions and hostels housing students benefiting from the scheme must upload geo-tagged photographs to the departmental scholarship portal.
A two-member inspection team constituted by the Tribal Welfare Commissioner will conduct physical inspections of out-of-state institutions every three years.
If irregularities or errors are found during inspections, the Commissioner has the authority to take necessary actions.

application_process:
Mode: Online. The interested applicants visit the official Chevening website to apply.
Step 1: Complete the online registration form
Once you’ve clicked on the application system, you will first be asked to read and consent to the Chevening terms and conditions and Privacy Notice, and register your email address and mobile phone number. You will then receive an email with a link to the application portal.
Step 2: Pass the eligibility checker
After you have clicked on the link to the application portal, answer the eligibility questions to confirm your eligibility for a Chevening Scholarship.
You will find out immediately if you passed or failed the eligibility checker. If you did not pass but think there was an error, you will be given two more attempts. 
If you pass the eligibility checker, you will receive an email to your registered email address with a link to continue your application. 
Tip: Take the eligibility quiz on our website to find out if you will pass the eligibility checker! 
Step 3: Make a note of your access code
Once you have followed the link in your email to continue your application, you will see an access code displayed on your screen. This access code is unique to you.
You must make a note or take a photo of your unique access code for your records as you will need it every time you want to access your application.
Step 4: Complete each section of the application form
You will now be able to start your Chevening application. 
When completing the form, keep in mind that you will be logged out of the system if you are inactive for 15 minutes, so remember to save your progress as you work through each stage! 
You will need to complete each section of the application form: 
Personal Details: Provide your full name, pronouns, date of birth, address, and preferred interview location. Immigration Details: Confirm your country of citizenship, passport number (where available), and other relevant details. Education History: Enter details of your education, including names of institutions attended, courses studied, and results received. You can add up to 15 entries. Work History: You can add up to 15 entries of past work experiences to the application form. The system will then calculate if you meet Chevening’s requirement for 2,800 hours of work experience by multiplying the number of weeks by the number of hours worked for each entry. You will be able to view your total number. Find out more about the work experience requirement and the type of work that counts towards it. Programmes of Study Submit details of your top three UK master’s degree course choices. You can find a full list of Chevening eligible courses on the course finder. You will be asked if you have already applied to each of your course choices. Please note that it is not a requirement to apply to your course choices before submitting your Chevening application. Read more about preparing your UK university application. Referees On your application form will you be asked to submit the names, job details, and contact details of two referees. If you are invited to interview, you will need to upload two letters written by your chosen referees to the online application system. Find out more about references. Essay Questions Respond to the four Chevening essay questions on leadership, relationship-building, your course choices, and future career goals. Each answer has a 500-word limit and must be in English.We recommend you prepare your answers to the essay questions in a separate document, before copy and pasting them into the application form once finalised.Read about how to score well on each of Chevening’s application criteria. Equal OpportunitiesShare your background information to help us monitor diversity and accessibility. This does not affect your application outcome. Step 5: Submit your application
Once you have ensured all sections of the application form are marked as ‘complete’:
Consent to the scholarship conditions outlined on the application form. 
Click ‘submit application’ and ‘confirm submission’. 
Give yourself a pat on the back!
Selection Process:Eligible applications will be shortlisted by the Chevening Secretariat.
Selected candidates undergo an interview process with a panel, including representatives from the Jharkhand government and FCDO.
Final selection is based on merit and adherence to Chevening standards.

full_details:
Mukhyamantri Swasthya Beema Yojana (MSBY) is a new health insurance scheme in the state of Jharkhand which will be launched on 15th November 2017. The state government of Jharkhand will implement the Swasthya Beema Yojana from 28th December 2017 to provide health insurance coverage to the state residents.

The government is preparing to launch the Chief Minister Health Insurance Scheme on 15th November. The scheme will provide benefits to about 57 lakh families in the state who are covered under the National Food Security Act. The government would provide free and cashless treatment to the poor families under the scheme.

The government may not take any premium from the poor people of the state and bear the full premium. The treatment under the Mukhyamantri Swasthya Beema Yojana would be available at all the government hospitals and empaneled private health institutions. The government will also enlist the popular and well-known hospitals and nursing homes at its border line and neighboring states for free and cashless treatment under the scheme.

Benefits Under Mukhyamantri Swasthya Beema Yojana (MSBY)

The state government would provide health insurance coverage to the state residents, especially families belonging to the economically weaker section of the society under the MSBY scheme.

Under the scheme, Rs. 50,000 has been provisioned for secondary care and Rs. 2 lakh for special care, Rs. 30,000 for senior citizens of additionally covered class. The government would provide health cards to the beneficiaries and the whole system would be cashless. 

The MSBY scheme, once implemented would be of great help to the state residents especially those who are not able to afford today’s costly treatments.

RMC has launched a demand survey for the PMAY and inviting applications from interested eligible candidates. The state government of Jharkhand will provide affordable houses to urban poor beneficiaries of the scheme under PMAY.

PMAY Ranchi Application Form Download

The application form for demand survey of PMAY in Ranchi can be downloaded in PDF format from the official website of Ranchi Municipal Corporation from the following link.

PMAY Ranchi Application Form

After downloading the application form, you can submit the filled form at the nearest RMC office. The last date to submit the application form is 30th April 2017.

The applicants who wish to apply online for PMAY can do so through the official website pmaymis.gov.in of PM Awas Yojana. The candidates who have already applied for the scheme through pmaymis.gov.in need not to apply again.

PMAY Ranchi Flat Details

Flats under PMAY in Ranchi would be constructed in Edalhatu in Bundu, Ranchi, HEC and Valmiki Nagar. RMC has selected about 150 slums which will be covered under the first phase of PMAY. 300 and 700 square foot homes would be constructed under the scheme in Ranchi.

Eligibility Criteria

Following candidates are eligible to apply for PMAY demand survey in Ranchi.

– People living in Ranchi from at least 2015.

– People having a valid residential proof of Ranchi such as rental slips or any other govt. authorized residence proof.

– Annual income as below

– For type 1 flats – Not more than 3 Lakh

– For type 2 flats – Between 3 to 6 Lakh

full_details:
Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G) has finally been launched by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi in Agra on 20th November 2016. Under the PM Awas Yojana Gramin affordable housing scheme, central government aims to develop 3 Crore homes by the year 2022 in rural areas for poor families including BPL.

PMAY-G is the revamped version of Indira Awas Yojana which was renamed earlier this year with some pro-poor changes in the scheme. Housing units under the PMAY-G scheme are already being offered to the beneficiaries in rural areas across the country. Pradhan Mantri Narendra Modi also handed over the allotment letters to the beneficiaries during the launch event.

The minimum area of home under the new scheme has been increased to 25 Square meter (267 Square foot) from 20 Sq.Mt. in earlier scheme.

Government has also released the scheme logo and a video

http://iay.nic.in/netiay/Video/PMAYGLaunch.mp4

The objective of the scheme is to provide homes to every Indian by the year 2022. Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin will be implemented across the country except Delhi and Chandigarh. The immediate target of PMAY-G is to construct 1 Crore affordable homes in rural areas by the year 2018-19.

Financial Assistance Under PMAY-G

The central government would be providing a financial assistance of Rs. Rs. 120,000 in plain areas and Rs. 130,000 in eastern, hilly and IAP areas to the beneficiaries. Along with this, an additional Rs. 12000 will also be provided to build toilet to each beneficiary under the Swachch Bharat Mission. The beneficiaries will also be provided daily wages of up to 90-95 days (Rs. 18000) through MGNREGA.

Hence, the total financial assistance amount will be 1 Lakh 50 thousand for plain areas and 1 Lakh 60 thousand for eastern, hilly and IAP areas. Interested beneficiaries can also avail a loan of upto Rs. 70000 from any of the nationalized banks for the construction of home. 

Selection of beneficiaries under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin will be done on the basis of SECC-2011 data. The government has also launched AwaasApp for beneficiaries to know the status of their application, funding or share the progress of construction.

To know more about the PMAY-G, please visit the following links

IN ENGLISH: https://sarkariyojana.com/pradhan-mantri-awas-yojana-gramin/

IN HINDI: Pradhan Mantri Gramin Awas Yojana in Hindi

OR visit the official website at http://iay.nic.in

Video & Image Source and Credits: http://iay.nic.in

scheme_name: PVTGs Dakia Yojana (Chief Minister's Food Security Scheme)
description: The "PVTGs Dakia Yojana (Chief Minister's Food Security Scheme)" by the Welfare Department, Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to ensure food security for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs). It provides subsidized food grains to enhance their living conditions.
department: Food, Public Distribution and Consumer affairs Department
benefits:
*Food Security for PTG Families:*

 - Free provision of 35 kg of wheat and rice per family per month at ₹1 per kg.

*Direct Village-Level Distribution:*

 - Food grains are distributed at the village level by Block Welfare Officers.

*Support for National Food Security:*

• Complements the "Antyodaya Yojana" by including all PVTG families in Jharkhand.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs).
1. The applicant’s family must be enrolled under the "Antyodaya Yojana."
1. The family should reside in designated PVTG areas or remote locations.
application_process: Mode: Offline. To avail the benefits of the scheme, the eligible applicant may visit the nearest Block Welfare Office with all the relevant documents.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card (If applicable).
Ration Card (If applicable).

scheme_name: Rearing Pond Construction Scheme
description: The "Rearing Pond Construction Scheme" by the Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, and Cooperation, Government of Jharkhand, aims to promote fish farming by providing financial aid for constructing rearing ponds. Beneficiaries receive up to 80% government assistance for Scheduled Castes (SC)
department: Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry & Co-operative
benefits:
*Financial Assistance:*

• SC/ST beneficiaries receive up to 80% of the total cost (maximum ₹4,00,000/-).
• Other categories receive up to 70% (maximum ₹3,50,000/-).
• Pond Construction Support: Assistance for constructing one-acre rearing ponds using machinery.

*Mode of Disbursement:* 

• Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to beneficiaries' bank accounts.

*Installments:*

• First installment: ₹1,00,000 after one to two feet of excavation.
• Second installment: ₹2,00,000 after three feet of excavation.
• Remaining funds after full excavation and dressing verification.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a fisherman.
1. The applicant whose proposed land is near their residence, consisting of one, two, or three plots of "don" land. 
1. The applicant should be engaged in fish farming or have constructed a fish seed hatchery with a departmental subsidy.
1. The land proposed for pond construction must be undisputed. At least 130 decimals of land are required for a 100 decimal water area. For larger ponds, the ratio of water area to total land should be at least 1:1.3.
1. The proposed land must not be mortgaged against any bank loan.
1. The applicant must have valid possession of the proposed land and provide the necessary documentation.
1. The applicant should be financially capable of contributing their share of the pond construction costs.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Notification & Advertisement: 
Applications are invited through newspaper advertisements and single-window systems.
Application Submission: 
Applicants submit their proposals with necessary land documents and proof of experience in fish farming to District Fisheries Officers.
Selection Process: 
District councils shortlist candidates based on eligibility and land verification.
Approval & Funding:
Selected beneficiaries sign an agreement with the department before funds are transferred in installments.
Construction & Monitoring: 
Ponds are constructed under technical supervision, with geo-tagging and periodic inspections.
documents_required:
Land Ownership Certificate or Lease Agreement
No-Objection Certificate (NOC) for land use
Bank Account Details
Caste Certificate (for SC/ST applicants)
Aadhaar Card
Proof of past fish farming activities (if applicable)

scheme_name: Reservoir Fisheries Development Scheme
description: The scheme "Reservoir Fisheries Development Scheme" by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Jharkhand, enhances fish production and livelihood opportunities for registered fisheries cooperatives through the provision of fish fingerlings, boats, and nets.
department: Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry & Co-operative
benefits:
• Supply of 530 lakh fish fingerlings annually to various reservoirs.
• Subsidy of ₹1,000/- or 50% of the cost per member for fishing nets (whichever is lower).
• Provision of ₹10,000/- or 50% of the cost for one boat per cooperative society (whichever is lower).
• Encouragement for cage culture in water bodies.
• Enhanced fish production in 1,06,000 hectares of water bodies.
• Livelihood support for members of registered fisheries cooperative societies.
• Focused implementation in mining-affected water bodies.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a member of a registered fisheries cooperative society.
1. The cooperative society should be actively involved in fisheries activities.
1. The water body must be a stable water resource such as a reservoir, check dam, coal pit, or similar areas affected by mining.
1. The water body should have a minimum size to qualify for stocking and development.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Step 1: The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the District Fisheries Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
Step 2: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Fisheries Office.
Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Fisheries Office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).
documents_required:
Cooperative Society Registration Certificate
Membership Proof of the Applicant
Water Body Inspection Report
Cost Estimates for Nets and Boats
Bank Account Details for Subsidy Transfer
Declaration of Adherence to Fisheries Guidelines

scheme_name: Saksham Jharkhand Kaushal Vikas Yojana
description: The "Saksham Jharkhand Kaushal Vikas Yojana" is an initiative by the Jharkhand government to equip youth aged 18-35 years with quality skills training aligned with the National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF). The scheme aims to create job opportunities for 70% of successful trainees.
department: Labour, Employment, Training and Skill Department
benefits:
Payment terms and schedule are guided by the Common Norms notified by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE). 

• Training Cost per Hour:

 1. Category I Sectors/Trades: ₹49/- per hour.
 1. Category II Sectors/Trades: ₹42/- per hour.
 1. Category III Sectors/Trades: ₹35/- per hour.

• Boarding and Lodging Costs: For residential training or trainees who need to travel significant distances
 1. X Category Cities: ₹375/- per day per trainee.
 1. Y Category Cities: ₹315/- per day per trainee.
 1. Z Category Cities: ₹250/- per day per trainee.
 1. Rural Areas or Non-Municipal Areas: ₹220/- per day per trainee.

• Placement opportunities for 70% of trainees.
• Training in industry-relevant sectors like Tourism & Hospitality, Telecom, Security, Retail, Plumbing, Logistics, IT/ITES, Electronics, Domestic Worker, Construction, Capital Goods, BFSI, Beauty & Wellness, Automotive, Apparel, and Agriculture, Food Processing, Healthcare, Iron & Steel, Mining
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant's age should be 18-35 years.
1. The applicant must belong to one of the priority groups (SC/ST, women, PwD, transgender).
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Candidate registration by TSP:The candidate visits the nearest Training Service Provide Center for registration under the "Mukhymantri Sarthi Yojana" umbrella scheme. 
NOTE: Candidate registration would be Aadhaar-based & hence Aadhaar number at the time of candidate registration would be mandatory.

Mode: Online. Self-Registration by Candidate:Visit the Jharkhand Skill Development Mission official website.
Click on ‘Candidate Registration’ under the ‘Registration’ tab.
Create Profile:Provide basic information such as First Name, Last Name, Username, Password, Identity Type (e.g., Aadhaar), Identity Number, Date of Birth, Gender, Mobile Number, and Email.
Submit to receive a User ID and Password via SMS and email.
Login and OTP Validation:Log in using the provided Username and Password.
Enter the OTP sent to your registered mobile number to activate the User ID.
Manage Profile:After login, access the ‘Registration’ link.
Update and save user profile details such as Personal information and optional bank account details. 
Contact and Educational Qualification Information:Enter and save your contact details, including address and communication preferences.
Fill in education details if literate, or select preferred languages if illiterate. 
Save and submit information to the Training Service Provider (TSP).
Registration ID Generation:
On final submission, the system generates a unique Registration ID and notifications for successful registration will be sent via SMS and email.
NOTE: Aadhaar number is mandatory for registration and prevents duplicate entries.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card.
Educational Certificate.
Residential Certificate.
Passport-sized Photograph.

scheme_name: Salt Distribution Scheme Jharkhand
description: The "Salt Distribution Scheme" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, ensures subsidized salt is provided to AAY, PHH, and Green Cardholders, promoting accessibility and affordability.
department: Food, Public Distribution and Consumer affairs Department
benefits:
• Subsidized salt is provided at ₹1/- per kilogram.

Note:

1. Benefits extended to AAY and PHH cardholders under NFSA and Green Cardholders under JSFSS.
1. Distributed monthly through designated fair price shops.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant must hold an Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) card, a Priority Household (PHH) card under the National Food Security Act, 2013, or a Green Card under the Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme.
1. Preference is given to economically disadvantaged households.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Visit the nearest ration shop or designated enrollment center with the required documents.
If Aadhaar is not available, apply for Aadhaar enrollment at an authorized center.
Submit the Aadhaar number or Aadhaar Enrolment Identification Slip during registration.
Verify the eligibility and documents with the designated officer.
Collect the salt from the distribution center as per the monthly schedule.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card or Aadhaar Enrolment Identification Slip.
Bank or Post Office Passbook with Photo.
Permanent Account Number (PAN) Card.
Passport (if available).
Ration Card.
Voter Identity Card.
MGNREGA Card.
Kisan Photo Passbook.
Driving License issued under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.
Certificate of Identity with a photo issued by a Gazetted Officer or Tehsildar on official letterhead.

scheme_name: Sanitary Pad Supply Scheme
description: The "Sanitary Pad Supply Scheme" by the Women, Child Development & Social Security Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to promote hygiene and health among women and adolescent girls. It provides free sanitary pads quarterly to women aged 20–40 years through Anganwadi centers.
department: Women, Child Development & Social Security Department
benefits:
*Free Sanitary Pads Distribution:*

• Beneficiaries receive 3 packs (each containing 6 sanitary pads) every quarter.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a women. 
1. The applicant age should be between 20–40 years.
1. The applicant or her dependent must not be:

• Permanently employed in central/state government or public sector enterprises.
• Retired government employees or pension recipients.
• An income tax payer.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Registration:
Visit the nearest Anganwadi center to register for the scheme.
Provide valid identification documents (Aadhaar, PAN, etc.).
Submit a self-declaration form for eligibility confirmation.
Verification:
Anganwadi workers will verify the details and register beneficiaries.
Women without Aadhaar will be assisted in obtaining it, while alternative IDs will be accepted temporarily.
Distribution:
Beneficiaries will receive sanitary pads during quarterly Village Health, Sanitation, and Nutrition Day (VHSND) programs.
Anganwadi workers will maintain stock and beneficiary records.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card 
Any other Government-Approved ID, such as a PAN Card, Ration Card, Voter ID Card
Self-Declaration Form

scheme_name: Sarna /Jahersthan/Hadgadi & Masna Protection and Development Scheme
description: The "Sarna / Jahersthan / Hadgadi & Masna Protection and Development" scheme by the Department of Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Minorities, & Backward Classes Welfare, Government of Jharkhand, aims to preserve & develop sacred tribal sites. The scheme facilitates fencing, infrastructure.......
department: Department of Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare
benefits: • Fencing of sacred sites: Ensuring protection and prevention of encroachment.- Infrastructure Development: Construction of multipurpose halls, seating arrangements, and water supply facilities.- Beautification & Preservation: Landscaping, gardening, and tribal-themed wall paintings.- Solar-Powered Lighting: Installation of eco-friendly lighting solutions.- Driveway & Walkway Development: Enhanced accessibility within these sites.- Monetary Allocation: Up to INR 5.00 Crore per unit based on approved estimates.- Cultural Promotion: Establishment of storage facilities and designated areas for cultural performances.
eligibility:
1. The site must be an officially recorded Sarna, Jahersthan, Hadgadi, or Masna location.
1. The concerned site should be under tribal community usage and cultural significance.
1. The beneficiary community must form a designated committee consisting of tribal members only.
1. Gram Sabha selection and approval are mandatory for project initiation.
1. The site must be registered under Revenue, Registration & Land Reforms Department records.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Site Identification & Proposal Preparation: 
The Gram Sabha identifies the site and prepares a project proposal.
Beneficiary Committee Formation: 
A tribal-only committee is formed under the guidance of traditional village leaders.
Approval from Gram Sabha: 
The project is formally approved and documented.
Submission to District Welfare Office/ITDA: 
The proposal, along with required documents, is submitted.
Technical Assessment & Approval: 
A review is conducted for feasibility and budgetary sanction.
Administrative Sanction: 
Final approval is granted by the concerned department.
The approved funds are released to the Beneficiary Committee.
documents_required:
Land records verifying the site's authenticity
Gram Sabha resolution approving the project
Beneficiary Committee details and member identification
Detailed project proposal with technical estimates

scheme_name: Sarvajan Pension Yojana
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of per month to elderly individuals, widows, destitute women, differently-abled persons, primitive tribes, and HIV/AIDS patients. The scheme eliminates previous age restrictions and targets inclusivity by guaranteeing pensions to all eligible.
department: Women, Child Development & Social Security Department
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
benefits:
• A pension of ₹1,000/- per month.

> Note: Timely pension disbursal by the 5th of every month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicants should be elderly, widows, destitute women, differently-abled, primitive tribes and people suffering from HIV/AIDS. 
1. The senior citizen's age should be 60 years or above.
1. The destitute women's age should be 18 years or above 
1. The differently-abled age should be 5 years or above.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Step 1: The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the Block Development Officer in the rural area and the Circle Officer in the urban area and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
Step 2: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Block Development Officer in the rural area and the Circle Officer in the urban area. 
Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the Block Development Officer in the rural area and the Circle Officer in the urban area to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).
documents_required:
Voter ID
Disability Certificate (if applicable)
HIV/AIDS Medical Certificate (if applicable)
Any Other Document if Required

department: Women, Child Development & Social Security Department
category: Education & Learning, Social welfare & Empowerment, Health & Wellness

scheme_name: Scheme Of Coaching & Allied For Scheduled Castes
description: Scheme Of Coaching & Allied For Scheduled Castes aims to provide support for the betterment of Scheduled Caste (SC) candidates for coaching and pre examination training in quality coaching institutions to enable them to appear in competitive examinations.
department: Department of Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare
benefits:
• The students will be given stipend of Rs.1000/- fixed per month for the entire period of coaching as mentioned above.

department: Department of Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare
benefits:
> *List of villages under Shaheed Gram Yojana:*

S.No.DistrictBlockVillage1KhuntiArkiUlihatu2RanchiChanhoSilagai3SahebganjBarhetBhoganadih4GarhwaBhandariaMadgardi5GumlaSisaiMurgu Sisai6GumlaBisunpurChingari Nava Toli7West SinghbhumRajnagar ThanaGumidpur, Matkom Beda Gaon8KhuntiMurhuAetkedihNOTE: As per requirements, villages of other martyrs of the freedom struggle can also be included under the scheme.

The EESL would replace the bulbs, tube lights and fans free of cost under the warranty period if a technical problem occurs. The replaced through the same distribution outlets operating in the state.

The LED bulbs has already proved to be the electricity and money savers for the consumers as well as the government. The distribution of the LED tube lights and fans would further help in saving the energy for peak demand and reducing energy bills for the consumers.
