application_process: Mode: Offline. After inviting applications through an advertisement, the selection will be made based on a presentation before the duly constituted competent committee.
documents_required: Documents are required as per the guidelines of the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology.

scheme_name: Establishment and Operation of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) Laboratories
description: The scheme aims to establish STEM laboratories in schools across Uttarakhand to provide students of classes 6 to 12 with hands-on science, technology, engineering, and mathematics learning opportunities and strengthen their practical understanding of scientific concepts.
benefits: Under this, 41 STEM laboratories have been established across the state to strengthen practical science education for secondary and higher secondary level students and to provide hands-on learning activities for students of classes 6 to 12, enabling them to conduct science-related experiments in these labs.
eligibility:
1. Students must be studying in classes 6 to degree level in a school in Uttarakhand.
1. Students from schools with a STEM laboratory, as well as those from nearby schools, are eligible to use the STEM laboratories.
application_process: Mode: Offline. All students of schools with STEM laboratories can conduct experiments in the laboratories established in their schools, while students from schools without laboratories can avail of this benefit by visiting nearby schools that have STEM labs.
documents_required: Documents required as per the guidelines of the respective schools that have STEM laboratories

scheme_name: Establishment of Broiler Farms
description: The scheme aims to promote commercial broiler rearing by providing financial assistance in the form of subsidies for poultry rearing and infrastructure development, thereby enhancing income generation and employment opportunities, especially for women and self-help groups (SHGs).
benefits:
Under this scheme:

 - A subsidy of ₹15/- per bird is provided for 6 batches, amounting to a total subsidy of ₹45,000/- per beneficiary.
 - An additional grant of ₹15,000/- per beneficiary is provided for fence construction, making the total subsidy ₹60,000/- per beneficiary.
 - With a minimum of 500 broiler birds, the total unit cost is approximately ₹3.05 lakh.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant may belong to any caste.
1. Preference will be given to women and self-help groups (SHGs).
1. The applicant must own land or have land on lease.
1. The applicant must have a KYC-certified bank account.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The Veterinary Officer/Livestock Extension Officer will identify eligible beneficiaries and collect their applications.
Applicants must submit their Aadhaar card, bank account details, and land records along with the application form.
The Veterinary Officer will prepare a project report, which the livestock owner will submit to the bank. All applications will be forwarded to the Chief Veterinary Officer’s office. The District Executive Committee will conduct the verification, select the beneficiaries, and disburse the subsidy.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Bank Account Details
Land Records
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Establishment of Cell for SC/ST
description: The project is being implemented by UCOST in collaboration with Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India to empower Scheduled Caste & Scheduled Tribe communities across Uttarakhand by addressing their fundamental challenges through scientific & technological interventions.
benefits:
The project “Establishment of Cell for SC/ST” is being implemented by UCOST in collaboration with the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India. Benefits-

 - To address the basic problems of all Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe communities living in the 13 districts of Uttarakhand through scientific applications.
 - To promote sustainable development among Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes through various scientific applications, guiding them towards proper development.
 - To enhance the traditional knowledge system through innovation by providing skill development and entrepreneurship training.
 - To establish a database of technologies and map the basic resources of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiaries must belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community residing in any of the 13 districts of the Kumaon and Garhwal divisions of Uttarakhand.

(Mainly: more than 50% of the population)
application_process: Mode: Offline. SC/ST communities living in the hilly areas of Uttarakhand will be the targeted beneficiaries at the district level, for which baseline data will be generated by selecting priority areas within these SC/ST communities.
documents_required: Documents are required to be submitted as per the guidelines of the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology.

scheme_name: Establishment of Cow Shelters
description: The scheme aims to provide proper shelter and care to unprofitable, abandoned, or roaming cattle by supporting eligible organizations in establishing and maintaining cow shelters with financial assistance from the state government.
benefits: Under the scheme, to provide proper shelter to unprofitable livestock abandoned by cattle rearers and roaming freely, the applicant organization will be eligible for a government grant of up to 90% of the total expenditure on non-recurring items, such as the construction of the main cowshed building, storage rooms, compound walls, drinking water systems, establishment of a plant for producing cow urine extract, biogas plants, and veterinary dispensaries. The maximum limit of the government grant is ₹25.00 lakh.
eligibility:
For the establishment of cow shelters, applications will be accepted from the following non-governmental voluntary organizations registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860:

 - A charitable institution registered for the welfare of cattle and other animals, a charitable institution formed for the welfare of cattle without any profit motive, or a public trust not registered under any law.
 - Preference will be given to organizations with a minimum of 3 years of work experience and proven capacity.
 - Preference will also be given to applicant institutions that own land or have taken land on lease for at least 30 years.
 - For eligibility for the maintenance grant, the cowshed must shelter a minimum of 25 destitute, non-profitable bovine animals in hilly areas and a minimum of 50 in plain areas.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The concerned organization shall apply to the Uttarakhand Animal Welfare Board office in Dehradun. The application form can be downloaded from this link (https://ahd.uk.gov.in/files/Gau_Sadan_Recognition_A%20pplication_Form.pdf) or obtained from the Livestock Extension Officer/Animal Husbandry Department in the respective area. The following documents are required to be submitted along with the application form:
Land ownership records in the name of the organization, verified by the Revenue Department.
Registration under the Societies Registration Act or the Trust Act.
Resolution or provision in the organization’s service rules to provide shelter to unprofitable cattle.
Name, designation, address, and telephone number of the organization’s management executive.
No objection certificate issued by the local Gram Sabha, Municipality, or other local body.
Income-expenditure report certified by a chartered accountant.
Bank account details of the institution.
After the selection of the institution, the applicant organization must sign and submit a contract, valid for a minimum of 5 years, before receiving government financial assistance.
documents_required:
Land ownership records in the name of the organization, verified by the Revenue Department.
Registration under the Societies Registration Act or the Trust Act.
Resolution or provision in the organization’s service rules to provide shelter to unprofitable cattle.
Name, designation, address, and telephone number of the management executive of the organization.
No objection certificate issued by the local Gram Sabha, Municipality, or other local body.
Income-expenditure accounting report certified by a Chartered Accountant.
Bank account details of the institution.
A contract valid for at least 5 years on the prescribed form.

scheme_name: Establishment of Digital Learning Platform
description: The scheme aims to establish Digital Learning Platform to provide training and career counseling on various subjects, including ICT orientation, emerging technologies, and more, through both online and offline modes for students of secondary schools across the state.
benefits: Under the Digital Learning Platform, students of secondary schools are provided with training and career counseling on various subjects, such as ICT orientation, emerging technologies, and more, through both online and offline modes.
eligibility: 1. All students studying in secondary schools across Uttarakhand are eligible.
application_process: Mode: Offline. A five- or seven-day training on digital technology shall be provided to students through both online and offline modes in various secondary schools across the state.
documents_required: The required documents should be submitted in accordance with the guidelines of the respective school.

scheme_name: Establishment of Poultry Valley
description: The scheme aims to promote sustainable and organized poultry farming among cooperative society members, especially women, by providing financial and technical support for poultry rearing, thereby enhancing income generation and livelihood opportunities in the state.
benefits:
• Under the project, each farmer will rear 750 chicks annually in three phases. The Animal Husbandry Department will supply 500 one-day-old chicks from the state sector budget through M-PACS, while the farmer will bear the cost of the remaining 250 chicks.
 - The Cooperative Department will provide an interest-free loan for the construction of poultry sheds and for the care & rearing of the chicks.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be a member of a Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society (MPACS).
 1. Preference will be given to female beneficiaries under this scheme.
 1. The applicant must not have any outstanding loans from MPACS or any other bank.
 1. The selected applicant must be eligible to receive Medium-Term (MT) and Short-Term (ST) loans under the Deendayal Upadhyaya Krishi Kalyan Yojana.
 1. The applicant must own or have land on lease.
application_process: Mode: Offline. Beneficiaries must apply through the Cooperative Department and the Veterinary Officer. The application must submit the following documents along with application form: Aadhaar card, bank account details, land records/registry/lease documents, and a certificate or affidavit from the concerned bank stating that the applicant is not a loan defaulter.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Bank Account details
Land records / Registry / Lease documents
Certificate or affidavit from any bank confirming that the applicant is not a loan defaulter

scheme_name: Establishment of Tea Factories - Uttarakhand Tea Development Board
description: The scheme aims to promote the development of the tea industry in Uttarakhand by establishing tea factories for processing locally produced green leaves, generating local employment, enhancing farmers’ income through fair procurement, and developing a sustainable tea value chain in the state.
benefits:
In the fiscal year 2023-24, the Uttarakhand Tea Development Board processed 5.92 lakh kilograms of green tea leaves and produced approximately 1.25 lakh cups of tea.
At present, the Board has established its own tea factories in the following districts:

 1. Tea Factory, Ghorakhal (Nainital) – Organic
 1. Tea Factory, Champawat – Organic
 1. Tea Factory, Bhatoli (Chamoli) – Organic
 1. Tea Factory, Kausani (Bageshwar) – Inorganic
 1. Tea Factory, Harinagari (Bageshwar) – Inorganic

In addition to the above, the Board is proposing to establish small tea factories in the following districts:

 - Tea Factory, Dhauladevi (Almora)
 - Tea Factory, Didihat (Pithoragarh)
eligibility: It is proposed to operate the above tea factories established by the Board in Public-Private Partnership (PPP) mode/private sector in the future, for which the eligibility criteria and policy are being prepared.
application_process: Mode: Offline. Employment is being provided to workers at the local level by engaging them in the tea factories established by the Board. Green leaves are being purchased from farmers who have reclaimed and are operating their own gardens, at the rate of ₹40/- per kilogram, and are being supplied to the factories. Payments are made by the Board directly to the farmers’ bank accounts on a monthly basis.
documents_required: Documents are required in accordance with the Uttarakhand Tea Development Board guidelines to avail of the benefits.

scheme_name: Establishment of Vermicompost Units
description: The scheme aims to promote sustainable agriculture and organic farming by providing financial assistance for setting up vermicompost units to farmers and women self-help groups.
benefits: Under this scheme, a subsidy of 75% of the cost, up to ₹33,300/- per unit, is provided for setting up vermicompost units (including pit construction and provision of earthworms).
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a farmer and must hold a valid Udhyan Card.
1. The applicant must have either their own land or land on lease.
1. All women members of self-help groups are also eligible to avail benefits under the scheme.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Applications for establishment of vermicompost units must be submitted to the officers or staff at the Horticulture Mobile team Centres. The application should include land-related documents such as Khasra and Khatauni, Aadhaar card, PAN card, Udhyan card, bank account details, and mobile number. Currently, the application process is offline.
If a farmer faces difficulty in filling out the application, personnel at the respective Horticulture Mobile team Centre will provide assistance. Once submitted, the application is forwarded by the Centre to the district level, which then sends it to the Directorate. Upon approval of the farmer’s proposal by the Directorate, a government order is issued, authorizing the district to grant approval/work orders accordingly.
Upon acceptance, the district officer sends the farmer an approval letter and informs them via phone. The establishment of the vermicompost unit is then carried out in the presence of departmental officials, followed by an on-site inspection. After verification, the subsidy is disbursed directly into the beneficiary’s bank account.
documents_required:
Land-related documents such as Khasra and Khatauni
Aadhaar card
PAN card
Udhyan card
Bank account details
Mobile number

scheme_name: Ex-Gratia Grant for Clothes, Utensils, and Household Items to Disaster-Affected Families
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to disaster-affected families for clothes, utensils, or household items in cases where their house has been washed away, completely or substantially damaged due to a natural calamity, or affected by waterlogging for a period of more than two days.
benefits: Under this scheme, an ex-gratia grant of ₹2,500/- per family is provided for damage to clothes, and an additional ex-gratia grant of ₹2,500/- per family is provided for damage to utensils or household items.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiary must be a disaster-affected family from Uttarakhand whose house has been affected by a natural disaster.
application_process: Mode: Offline. Information about the disaster and the resulting damage is received from various sources. The concerned Patwari verifies the damage and records it in the P-20 form. The Patwari’s report is subsequently verified by the Tehsildar and the Sub-Divisional Magistrate. Approval is then obtained from the District Magistrate. Once the District Magistrate’s approval is received, relief funds are disbursed to the concerned beneficiaries at the Tehsil level.
documents_required:
Form P-20 Entry Confirmation (recorded by the concerned Patwari)
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Ex-Gratia Payment for Life-Threatening Injury Requiring Hospital Stay for Treatment
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals who sustain life-threatening injuries due to disasters and require hospitalization for treatment.
benefits: Under this scheme, an ex-gratia grant of ₹16,000/- per person is provided in case of a hospital stay for more than one week, and ₹5,400/- per person in case of a hospital stay for less than one week.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be a person admitted to a government or non-government hospital due to an injury caused by a disaster, including those engaged in relief or disaster preparedness activities who sustained injuries during such work.
application_process: Mode: Offline. Information about the disaster and the resulting damage is received from various sources. The concerned Patwari verifies the damage and records it in the P-20 form. The Patwari’s report is subsequently verified by the Tehsildar and the Sub-Divisional Magistrate. Approval is then obtained from the District Magistrate. Once the District Magistrate’s approval is received, relief funds are disbursed to the concerned beneficiaries at the Tehsil level.
documents_required:
Form P-20 Entry Confirmation (recorded by the concerned Patwari)
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Ex-Gratia Payment for Loss of Hands, Legs, Eyes, or Vision
description: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to individuals who suffer physical disabilities such as loss of limbs or vision as a result of disasters or while participating in relief and preparedness activities. Under this scheme, financial assistance between ₹74,000/- to ₹2,50,000/-is provided.
benefits: Under this scheme, an ex-gratia grant of ₹74,000/- is provided to each affected person. In cases where the disability exceeds 60%, a higher amount of ₹2,50,000/- per person is provided.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be either disaster-affected individual or involved in disaster relief or preparedness-related activities.
1. The extent and cause of the disability must be certified by a doctor from a government hospital or dispensary.
application_process: Mode: Offline. Information about the disaster and the resulting damage is received from various sources. The concerned Patwari verifies the damage and records it in the P-20 form. The Patwari’s report is subsequently verified by the Tehsildar and the Sub-Divisional Magistrate. Approval is then obtained from the District Magistrate. Once the District Magistrate’s approval is received, relief funds are disbursed to the concerned beneficiaries at the Tehsil level.
documents_required:
Medical Disability Certificate (issued by Government Hospital or Authorized Medical Officer)
Form P-20 Entry Confirmation (recorded by the concerned Patwari)
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Family Pension Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
description: The scheme provides financial assistance to the spouse of a registered construction worker in the event of the worker’s death, if the deceased was a pensioner. Under this scheme, the family pension will be ₹500/- per month or 50% of the pensioner's pension, whichever is higher.
benefits: • Pension Amount: ₹500/- per month or 50% of the pensioner's pension, whichever is higher.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be the spouse (husband/wife) of the deceased construction worker.
 1. The deceased construction worker must have been registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
 1. The deceased construction worker must have been receiving a pension from the Board at the time of death.
application_process:
[Online - via CSC]
The online application for the scheme can be submitted through Shramik Suvidha Kendras.
At the time of application, the applicant must attach the self-declaration certificate, Shramik card of the deceased worker, death certificate of the deceased worker, Aadhaar card, and other required documents. 
The application for family pension must be submitted within three months from the date of death of the pensioner. If the application is found correct during the departmental verification, the family pension will be sanctioned and disbursed.
documents_required:
Self-declaration certificate
Labour card of the deceased worker
Death certificate of the deceased worker
Aadhaar card
Other required documents

scheme_name: Farmer Pension Scheme
description: The scheme aims to provide financial support to elderly farmers residing in the state of Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1200/- is provided to farmers who are above 60 years of age, own up to 2 hectares of land, and cultivate their own land.
benefits: A pension of ₹1,200/- per month is provided to eligible farmers.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a farmer actively engaged in cultivating their own land.
1. The applicant must be above 60 years of age.
1. The applicant must own and cultivate up to 2 hectares of agricultural land.
application_process:
Mode: Online. The applicant can apply online either by themselves or through a Common Service Center (CSC) via the Department’s Pension Portal (https://ssp.uk.gov.in), the UMANG Mobile App, or the Apuni Sarkar Portal (https://eservices.uk.gov.in).
The following documents are mandatory at the time of applying: Applicant’s mobile number, Passport-size photograph (attested by Gram Pradhan / V.P.D.O. / certified by Councillor), Photocopy of Aadhaar card and Voter ID card, An attested copy of the Khatauni (land records), Permanent Residence Certificate, A ₹10/- stamp paper affidavit declaring that the applicant cultivates their own land and owns up to 2 hectares of land, or less than 2 hectares, along with the relevant land documents, CBS bank account details (linked/seeded with Aadhaar), Copy of family register (for rural areas only), Copy of the resolution passed in the open meeting of Gram Panchayat (for rural areas) / certified by Councillor (for urban areas)
The land ownership certificate is issued by the Revenue Officer/Assistant Agriculture Officer, who certifies it in the prescribed form/letter. There is no requirement for an income certificate.
All the above documents must be issued from the district where the application is being submitted.
For verification of the online application form in rural areas, the final decision is taken by the District Social Welfare Officer after recommendations from the Gram Panchayat Development Officer, Assistant Social Welfare Officer, and Block Development Officer, respectively. In urban areas, verification and recommendation are done by the Assistant Social Welfare Officer and Sub-District Magistrate. If the application is found correct, the District Social Welfare Officer approves it, after which the pension payment process is initiated.The pension is credited to the applicant’s bank account one month after the approval of the application.
documents_required:
Applicant’s mobile number
Passport-size photograph (certified by Gram Pradhan / V.P.D.O. / Councillor)
Aadhaar card
Voter ID card
CBS bank account linked/seeded with Aadhaar card
An attested copy of the Khatauni (land records)
Permanent Residence Certificate
A ₹10/- stamp paper affidavit declaring that the applicant cultivates their own land and owns up to 2 hectares of land, or less than 2 hectares, along with the relevant land documents
Copy of family register (only for rural areas)
Note 1: All the above documents must be issued from the district where the application is submitted.
Note 2: The land ownership certificate is issued by the Revenue Officer/Assistant Agriculture Officer, who certifies it in the prescribed form/letter.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance After Death (UKBOCWWB)
description: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2 lakh in case of natural death and ₹4 lakh in case of accidental death to the dependents of registered construction workers.
benefits:
• ₹2,00,000/- will be provided in the event of the natural death.
 - ₹4,00,000/- will be provided in the event of the accidental death.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a dependent of the deceased construction worker.
 1. The dependent’s name must be mentioned in the labour card as a dependent.
 1. The deceased construction worker must have been registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
application_process:
[Online - via CSC]
The online application for the scheme can be submitted through Shramik Suvidha Kendras by the nominated dependent of the registered construction worker, whose name is mentioned in the worker’s Shramik Card.
It is mandatory to apply within one year from the date of the worker’s death. 
At the time of application, the following documents must be attached: self-declaration certificate, Shramik Card of the deceased worker, Aadhaar Card, death certificate, accident-related proof (in case of accidental death), Aadhaar Card and bank account details of the dependent, along with an affidavit stating that this benefit has not been availed under any other scheme. 
After verification and approval through departmental investigation, financial assistance is provided.
documents_required:
Self-declaration certificate
Labour Card of the deceased worker
Aadhaar Card
Death Certificate 
Accident-related proof (in case of accidental death)
Aadhaar Card 
Bank account details of the dependent, along with an affidavit stating that this benefit has not been availed under any other scheme

scheme_name: Financial Assistance and Grants to Sports Associations/ Clubs/ Sports Committees of Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to provide financial support or grants to recognized sports associations, clubs, and committees in the state for organizing sports competitions and for purchasing sports equipment for associations and players at the national, state, and district levels.
benefits:
Recognized associations, clubs, and sports committees will receive financial assistance as follows:

• National-level competitions: ₹3.50 lakh
• State-level competitions: ₹2.50 lakh
• District-level competitions: ₹1.00 lakh

Additionally, there is a provision to provide ₹2.50 lakh to players selected to represent at the international level.
eligibility: 1. The recognized Sports Associations, Clubs, and Sports Committees in Uttarakhand are eligible to receive financial assistance or grants under this scheme.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Recognized associations, clubs, sports societies, and selected international-level players may apply for grants using the prescribed format, as per departmental rules.
Sports associations, clubs, and committees in Uttarakhand are provided grants and financial assistance for organizing sports competitions and purchasing sports equipment, benefiting approximately 20 associations, committees, and players throughout the year.
documents_required: Submission of documents is required in accordance with the department's guidelines to avail the benefits of the scheme.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Construction of Toilet (UKBOCWWB)
description: The scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹12,000/- to registered construction workers for building toilets. The assistance is disbursed in two installments: the first installment of ₹8,000/- and the second installment of ₹4,000/-.
benefits:
> Under the scheme, registered construction workers receive financial assistance of ₹12,000/- in two installments for the construction of toilets.

 - First Installment: ₹8,000/- - Second Installment: ₹4,000/-
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
application_process:
[Online - via CSC]
The online application can be submitted through Shramik Suvidha Kendras. At the time of application, the following documents are required: Shramik Card, Aadhaar Card, Self-Declaration Certificate, Aadhaar-linked bank account details, and a photograph showing the worker along with the toilet under construction. The photograph must clearly show the toilet with concrete walls, roof with lintel, tank, water arrangement, and seat.
Land-related documents of the site where the toilet is constructed, such as Dakhal Kharij/Khatauni/Registry or land ownership certificate, along with a permanent residence certificate, must also be attached. Additionally, an affidavit is required stating that the applicant has not availed benefits from any other scheme and has not applied for assistance from any other department.
If the application is verified and found correct during the departmental investigation, the first installment is credited to the applicant’s bank account. After completion of the construction, the applicant must reapply after one month with all relevant documents to receive the second installment of ₹4,000/-.
documents_required:
Labour Card
Aadhaar Card
Self-Declaration Certificate
Aadhaar-linked bank account details
A photograph showing the worker along with the toilet under construction (Photograph must clearly show the toilet with concrete walls, roof with lintel, tank, water arrangement, and seat)
Land-related documents of the site where the toilet is constructed, such as Dakhal Kharij/Khatauni/Registry or land ownership certificate
A permanent residence certificate
An affidavit is required stating that the applicant has not availed benefits from any other scheme and has not applied for assistance from any other department.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Daughter's Marriage (UKBOCWWB)
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹51,000/- per marriage for the marriage of registered construction workers themselves or for the marriage of up to two daughters.
category: Women and Child, Social welfare & Empowerment
benefits:
• An amount of ₹51,000/- for each marriage is provided.

> Note: Assistance is provided for the marriage of up to two daughters of the registered worker as well as for the worker’s own marriage.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
 1. Financial assistance is available for the worker’s own marriage and for the marriage of up to two daughters.
application_process:
[Online - via CSC]
The online application can be submitted through Shramik Suvidha Kendras. 
Along with the application form, applicants must submit their Shramik Card, bank account details, marriage card, Aadhaar cards of the bride and groom, the marriage registration certificate, a self-written certificate stating that no assistance has been received from any other department, and a self-declaration certificate. 
It is mandatory to apply within one year from the date of marriage. After submission, the department conducts verification, and if the application and documents are found to be correct, the financial assistance is transferred directly to the construction worker’s bank account.
documents_required:
Labour Card
Worker’s bank account details
Marriage card
Bride and groom’s Aadhaar cards and marriage registration certificate
Self-written certificate stating that no assistance has been received from any other department
Self-declaration certificate

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Natural Disaster
description: The scheme aims to provide timely financial assistance and relief to individuals and families affected by natural calamities, helping them recover from losses to life, property, and livelihood.
benefits: Under this scheme, in case of any loss due to a natural calamity, financial assistance of up to ₹10,000/- is sanctioned by the Tehsildar, up to ₹50,000/- by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, and above ₹50,000/- by the District Magistrate.
eligibility:
1.	The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
2.	The applicant or their family must have been affected by a natural disaster.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. In the event of a disaster, upon suo motu cognizance by the Revenue Administration, or on the report of an affected individual, person from the disaster-affected area, or public representative, the revenue officials of the concerned area such as the Patwari, Kanungo, or Tehsildar will inform the officials of the Disaster Department, such as the District Disaster Management Officer. Subsequently, the Sub-Divisional Magistrate or Tehsildar, after conducting a field investigation through the Regional Revenue Sub-Inspector and related departments, will assess the damage and initiate necessary action to provide relief to the affected individual or family as per the prescribed rules.
To identify completely damaged buildings, a three-member committee will be constituted at the District Magistrate level, comprising the Block Development Officer (or their representative) and one Junior Engineer. The committee will approve the relief amount for all buildings deemed completely damaged and unsafe for human habitation and will sanction the relief amount for the affected individual or family accordingly.
If the financial assistance amount is up to ₹10,000/-, it is approved by the Tehsildar; if it exceeds ₹10,000/- but is below ₹50,000/-, it is approved by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate; and if it exceeds ₹50,000/-, it is approved by the District Magistrate.
Currently, the distribution of financial assistance for natural calamities is conducted offline. However, the approval process at the office level has been made online through the Apuni Sarkar Portal. Once the approval is granted at the District Magistrate level, the sanctioned amount is sent to the Tehsildar through the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, who then forwards it to the concerned Patwari. The Revenue Sub-Inspector (Patwari/Lekhpal) subsequently disburses the amount to the disaster-affected person or family in the respective area.
After approval from the Sub-Divisional Magistrate or Tehsildar, the financial assistance is provided to the person or family affected by the natural calamity through the Revenue Sub-Inspector (Patwari/Lekhpal) of the concerned area.
documents_required: Documents are required as per the guidelines of the Revenue Administration to avail the benefits of the scheme.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Purchase or Construction of House (UKBOCWWB)
description: The scheme provides loans of up to ₹50,000/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) for the purchase or construction of a house, at a minimum interest rate of 5% per annum.
benefits:
1. Under the scheme, registered construction workers are eligible to receive an advance loan amount of up to ₹50,000/- for the purchase or construction of a house, subject to the conditions specified by the Board.
 1. Interest of at least 5% per annum is applicable on this loan.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
 1. To avail an advance loan for the purchase or construction of a house, the worker must have been a member of the fund for at least five years and should have a minimum of 15 years remaining until superannuation/retirement age.
application_process:
[Online - via CSC]
The online application is submitted through Shramik Suvidha Kendras. 
Along with the application form, the applicant must attach the Shramik Card, Aadhaar Card, bank account details, and a handwritten self-declaration certificate stating that no assistance has been taken from any other department for the same purpose. 
If the application is verified and found correct during the departmental investigation, the advance amount is disbursed, on which the worker is required to pay interest at the rate of 5% per annum.
Proof of completion of the work must be submitted to the Secretary of the Board within six months from the date of withdrawal of the advance. The sanctioned advance amount shall be recovered in equal installments as determined by the Board.
documents_required:
Labour Card
Aadhaar Card
Bank account details
A handwritten self-declaration certificate stating that no assistance has been taken from any other department for the same purpose

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Authors for Book Publication
description: The scheme aims to support the state's eminent litterateurs, writers, poets, and authors by providing financial assistance whose literary works remain unpublished due to financial constraints.
benefits: Under this scheme, the department provides financial assistance to eminent litterateurs, writers, and poets of the state whose works remain unpublished due to lack of funds.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be an eminent litterateur, writer, author, or poet.
1. The applicant’s literary work must remain unpublished solely due to financial constraints.
application_process:
Mode: Online. The department publishes advertisements in newspapers inviting applications for book publication. After the advertisement is issued, eligible beneficiaries can apply online through the Apuni Sarkar portal. The key documents required are as follows:
Manuscript
Quotation for printing the book
Aadhaar Card
Bank Account Details
PAN Card
Permanent Residence Certificate
A departmental committee is constituted to examine the applications and manuscripts received. Financial assistance for book publication is provided only after the committee’s recommendation.
documents_required:
Manuscript
Quotation for printing the book
Aadhaar Card
Account Number
PAN Card
Permanent Residence Certificate

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Permanent Residents of Uttarakhand for Religious Pilgrimages
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹50,000/- to permanent residents of the state who have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra, irrespective of their religion or caste.
benefits: The Uttarakhand State Government provides financial assistance of ₹50,000/- to permanent residents of the state, irrespective of religion or caste, who successfully complete the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra organized by the Government of India.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra organized by the Government of India.
1. The applicant must have undertaken the journey through the Kumaon Mandal Vikas Nigam.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Permanent residents of the state who have completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra via the Pithoragarh Yatra route can apply online through the Apuni Sarkar portal, after receiving a recommendation from the Kumaon Mandal Vikas Nigam. The main documents required for the application are as follows:
Permanent/Domicile Certificate of Uttarakhand
Travel Completion Certificate issued by the Ministry of External Affairs, along with other travel-related documents
Photocopy of bank passbook showing the account number and IFSC code
Photocopy of PAN card
Photocopy of Aadhaar card
After submission, the application forms are scrutinized by the Director's office. If the documents are found to be correct, the reimbursement amount is credited to the concerned individual.
documents_required:
Permanent/Domicile Certificate of Uttarakhand
Travel Completion Certificate issued by the Ministry of External Affairs, along with other travel-related documents
Photocopy of bank passbook showing the account number and IFSC code
Photocopy of PAN card
Photocopy of Aadhaar card

scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Youth Groups
description: The scheme aims to promote self-employment & entrepreneurship among rural youth by providing financial support. Financial assistance is provided to Mangal Dals affiliated with the department to help them start employment-oriented projects in 18 identified business sectors.
department: Department of Youth Welfare and Provincial Protection Corps
benefits:
Financial support for starting one of the 18 Identified Business Activities for Starting Employment-Oriented Projects/Businesses in Uttarakhand State:

• Dairy Production – ₹1,00,000/-
• Tent Utensil Rental – ₹50,000/-
• Sound System Rental – ₹50,000/-
• Flour Mill Setup – ₹50,000/-
• Photocopy/Fax/Lamination Machine – ₹1,00,000/-
• Mushroom/Vegetable/Flower Cultivation – ₹50,000/-
• Handloom/Woolen Items Production Equipment – ₹50,000/-
• Adventure Sports Equipment – ₹4,00,000/-
• Tailoring/Beauty Parlor Equipment – ₹50,000/-
• Organic Fertilizer/Animal Feed Production – ₹50,000/-
• Fruit Preservation Unit – ₹50,000/-
• Animal Husbandry – ₹50,000/-
• Cultural Instrument Purchase – ₹50,000/-
• Electronics Repairs/Works – ₹50,000/-
• Vehicle Repair Work – ₹50,000/-
• Plumbing Work – ₹10,000/-
• Mobile Phone Repair – ₹12,000/-
• Innovative Projects – ₹1,50,000/-

Funding Process:
Financial assistance will be 75% of the total project cost or the specified amount for the chosen activity (whichever is lower). The remaining cost must be arranged by the beneficiary youth groups on their own.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a Mangal Dal affiliated with the Youth Welfare and PRD Department of Uttarakhand.
1. The members of Mangal Dal must be permanent residents of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant (Mangal Dal) must not have benefited previously under the scheme.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To avail of financial assistance, interested Yuvak/Mahila Mangal Dal members must obtain an application form from the Youth Welfare and PRD office. 
The application must include a group photo of all team members, a description or work plan of the business they intend to undertake, details regarding the availability of a building or land for the business, and a certified estimate of potential expenses. In addition, the application should contain the team’s registration number, names of all team members, their birth certificates, educational qualification certificates, permanent residence certificates, the team’s bank account details, and any training or experience certificates related to the business. Details of the family’s monthly income from all sources must also be submitted.
All completed applications are to be submitted to the District Youth Welfare and PRD Officer through the Regional Youth Welfare and PRD Officer. 
The District Officer will conduct a site inspection and forward the proposal along with their recommendation to the District Magistrate. For the purpose of selection and monitoring, the list of recommended youth groups will be sent to the Director, Youth Welfare and PRD Directorate, who will select a minimum of two beneficiary youth groups from each district and provide financial assistance within the allocated budget. 
The approved amount will be transferred directly to the bank account of the group.
documents_required:
Group Photograph of All Members
Project Proposal/Business Plan
Availability Proof of Building/Land for Business
Certified Cost Estimate
Group Registration Number
List of All Group Members with Names
Birth Certificates of All Members
Educational Qualification Certificates
Permanent Residence Certificates
Group Bank Account Details
Training/Experience Certificate (related to selected business activity, if applicable)
Details of the family’s monthly income from all sources

scheme_name: Financial Assistance/Pension to Former Renowned Sportspersons
description: The scheme aims to provide lifelong monthly financial assistance ranging from ₹4,000/- to ₹10,000/- in the form of a pension to former renowned sportspersons of Uttarakhand who are above 50 years of age and are financially weak.
benefits: Under this scheme, financially weak former renowned sportspersons of the state are provided a lifelong monthly pension, with a minimum of ₹4,000/- and a maximum of ₹10,000/-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant should be an ex-sportsperson. 
1. The applicant must be above 50 years of age.
1. The applicant should not be currently employed.
1. The applicant’s monthly income from all private sources should not exceed ₹20,000/-.
1. The applicant should be a former medalist or participant in:

• Olympic Games, World Cup/Championship
• Asian Games, Commonwealth Games
• Afro-Asian Games, SAF Games
• Para-Olympic/Special Olympic (Mental/Physical Disabilities)
• World Marathon (Disabled), International Veteran (Masters) Championships
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The Sports Directorate issues a notification inviting applications. 
Applicants are required to submit their applications to the Directorate along with certificates of participation and medals in relevant sports competitions, permanent residence certificate, income certificate, Aadhaar card, bank account details, and birth certificate.
documents_required:
Participation/Medal Certificates
Permanent Residence Certificate
Income Certificate
Aadhaar Card
Bank Account Details
Birth Certificate

scheme_name: Fish Farming Diversification (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe) Scheme
description: The scheme aims to promote economic empowerment and livelihood diversification among Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe communities through fisheries-based activities.
benefits:
Under this scheme:

 - Fishermen who already own ponds are provided a 60% subsidy for repairing or improving their ponds, or for undertaking duck/poultry farming and other integrated activities.
 - To connect landless individuals with fish processing and marketing businesses, a 60% subsidy of ₹1,50,000/- is provided against the cost of a mobile fish stall amounting to ₹2,50,000/-.
 - A 60% subsidy of ₹42,000/- is provided against the cost of ₹70,000/- for the improvement of a 100-square-meter pond.
 - A 60% subsidy of ₹3,00,000/- is provided against the cost of ₹5,00,000/- for the improvement of a 10-hectare pond in plain areas.
 - A 60% subsidy of ₹83,000/- is provided against the cost of ₹1,39,000/- for establishing one integrated unit (chicken/duck/banana/papaya) in mountainous areas.
 - In plain areas, a grant of 60%, i.e. ₹3,96,000/-, is provided against the cost of construction of one integrated unit valued at ₹6,60,000/-.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community.
 1. The applicant should be engaged in fish production and possess a pond or be landless and interested in engaging in fish processing or marketing businesses to be eligible.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To avail the benefits of the scheme, eligible beneficiaries are required to submit an application for pond improvement, integrated fisheries, or fish processing/marketing business to the office of the Assistant Director of Fisheries or District Fisheries In-charge at the district level.
For applications related to pond improvement or integrated fisheries, the applicant must attach the following documents: Aadhaar card, land records, permanent residence certificate, caste certificate, bank account details, mobile number, and pond details.
For fish processing/marketing, the application must include: Aadhaar card, permanent residence certificate, caste certificate, bank account details, and mobile number.
In the future, the application process will be made available online through the Apuni Sarkar Portal.
After submission of the application, a survey is conducted by the fisheries inspectors or field personnel, and a proposal is prepared in consultation with the beneficiary. Once the proposal is finalized, it is approved by the concerned district officer. Thereafter, under the supervision and technical guidance of field staff, the pond repair/improvement work, integrated activities, or fish stall setup is completed. Following the successful completion of work, the subsidy amount is disbursed through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) on the basis of a work completion certificate.
documents_required:
For pond improvement or integrated fisheries, the application must include the following documents:
Aadhaar card
Land Documents (Khasra Khatauni of land for pond owners)
Permanent residence certificate
Caste certificate
Bank account details
Mobile number
Pond details
For fish processing/marketing, the application must include:
Aadhaar card
Permanent residence certificate
Caste certificate
Bank account details
Mobile number

scheme_name: Flower Area Expansion
description: The scheme aims to promote and expand flower cultivation by providing cultivators in Uttarakhand access to quality flower planting material at a subsidized cost, thereby increasing flower production and enhancing farmers’ income.
benefits:
To encourage flower production, flower planting material (bulbs, plants, and seeds) is provided to cultivators at a 50% subsidy on the total cost, applicable for a maximum area of 4 hectares, as follows:

 - For open flowers, planting material worth up to ₹20,000/- per hectare is provided.
 - For stalked flowers, planting material worth up to ₹50,000/- per hectare is provided.
 - For bulbous flowers, planting material worth up to ₹75,000/- per hectare is provided.

(For example, if 1 kg of marigold seeds costs ₹200/-, the cultivator pays ₹100/- at the Horticulture Mobile team Center, while the government provides a subsidy of ₹100/-, allowing the cultivator to obtain the seeds for ₹100/-.)
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card.
1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Application forms can be obtained from the officers or staff at the Horticulture Mobile team Centre. Forms are also available for download from the department’s website: https://shm.uk.gov.in.
For winter planting, applications must be submitted between September and October, and for rainy season planting, applications must be submitted between April and June. Applicants are required to submit land-related documents, such as Khasra and Khatauni, along with the application form. For leased land, additional documents including the lease certificate, Aadhaar card, PAN card, Udhyan Card, bank account details, and mobile number are required.
Currently, the application process is offline. Farmers must submit their completed application along with the required documents to the respective Horticulture Mobile team Centre. The application format also serves as a proposal. If a farmer faces any difficulty in filling out the form, the staff at the respective centres are responsible for providing assistance.
For applications under centrally-sponsored schemes, once the proposal is submitted, the Horticulture Mobile team Centre forwards it to the district level. From there, applications are sent to the state level, and then to the Government of India. After the action plan is approved by the Government of India, targets are communicated back to the district level through the Directorate.
For state-sponsored schemes, applications are sent from the Horticulture Mobile team Centre to the district level, and then to the Directorate. Once the Directorate approves the farmers’ proposals, approval or work orders are issued to the districts as per the Government Order.
Once a farmer's proposal is approved, the district officer issues an acceptance letter and informs the farmer via phone. The farmer can then purchase flower planting material (bulbs, plants, or seeds) from the relevant Horticulture Mobile team Centre at a 50% subsidy. Beneficiaries are selected on a first-come, first-served basis, subject to budget availability.
documents_required:
Land-related documents, such as Khasra and Khatauni (lease certificate, in case of leased land)
Aadhaar Card
PAN Card
Udhyan Card
Bank account details
Mobile Number
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Food Processing and Value Addition Management
description: The scheme aims to promote the establishment of food processing units in Uttarakhand, enhance value addition in agricultural and horticultural products, support entrepreneurs with financial assistance, and strengthen the state’s food processing ecosystem.
benefits:
Under this scheme, for setting up new food processing units, 50% of the project cost, up to a maximum of ₹400.00 lakh (₹4 crore), is provided as government assistance/subsidy.
The department is in the process of uploading previously approved proposals on its website, similar to the MSME model, to make it easier for interested companies, firms, or promoters to prepare their proposals.
eligibility: 1. Companies, firms, and promoters interested in setting up food processing units in Uttarakhand are eligible to receive assistance under this scheme.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The application form can be obtained from the officers/personnel working in the Horticulture Mobile team centres, or it can also be downloaded from the department's website https://shm.uk.gov.in. The application/proposal must be accompanied by documents covering the 29 points outlined in the checklist, including: application in the prescribed format, DPR, promoter's permanent residence certificate, organization's biodata, unit area address, bank/institution appraising the project proposal, proof of appraisal by the bank/financial institution, NOC from the Fire Department, land records in the organization's name, land conversion certificate, company/institution's boilerage, raw material procurement, details of the unit's products, contracts with farmers, site plan, FSSAI certification, employment generation certificate, details of civil works certified by a civil engineer, quotations from suppliers of plant machinery and equipment certified by a chartered mechanical engineer, supplier quotations for machinery purchases, marketing strategy for production, process flow chart, details of unit implementation, ₹100/- affidavit, funding, project cost, and eligibility.
In case of difficulty completing the application/proposal, personnel at the Horticulture Mobile team Centres will assist the applicant. The completed application must be submitted to the office. Before applying for the project, the entrepreneur or institution must submit the loan appraisal to the bank.
The relevant proposals are then forwarded directly to the Mission Directorate by the Horticulture Mobile team Centre personnel. Once the Directorate approves the proposals, the entrepreneur receives an acceptance letter and is informed by telephone. During this period, the entrepreneur is required to get the loan approved, with departmental officers providing necessary assistance. After loan approval, the information must be submitted to the department.
The food processing unit is established with the technical assistance and supervision of departmental officers. Upon completion, a joint inspection is conducted by the departmental team, and after satisfactory verification, the appropriate subsidy is disbursed into the entrepreneur's bank account.

Detailed Project Report (DPR)
Promoter's permanent residence certificate
Organization's biodata
Unit location/address
Bank/institution appraising the project proposal
Proof of appraisal by the bank/financial institution
NOC from the Fire Department
Land records in the organization's name
Land conversion certificate
Company/institution boilerage details
Raw material procurement details
Details of the unit's products
Contracts with farmers
Site plan
FSSAI certification
Employment generation certificate
Details of civil works certified by a civil engineer
Quotations from suppliers of plant machinery and equipment certified by a chartered mechanical engineer
Supplier quotations for machinery purchases
Marketing strategy for production
Process flow chart
Details of unit implementation
₹100 affidavit
Funding details
Project cost
Eligibility documents
Any other documents as required

scheme_name: Formation of Mahila Mangal and Yuvak Mangal Dal
description: The scheme aims to form groups of interested women and men from Gram Panchayats across the state, who are 18 years of age or above, enabling them to avail the benefits of various schemes of the Youth Welfare and PRD Department and to collectively undertake business or livelihood activities.
department: Department of Youth Welfare and Provincial Protection Corps
benefits: It is mandatory to form a group in order to avail the benefits of various schemes of the Youth Welfare and PRD Department and to collectively undertake any business activity.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be an interested woman or man.
1. The applicant must be a resident of a Gram Panchayat in Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Formation of Mahila Mangal and Yuvak Mangal Dals – The Youth Welfare & PRD Department forms one Mahila Mangal Dal and one Yuvak Mangal Dal in each Gram Panchayat.
Any individual wishing to become a member of the Mahila Mangal Dal or Yuvak Mangal Dal must have a related proposal passed by the Gram Sabha and submitted to the concerned Regional Youth Welfare and PRD Officer.
documents_required:
Identity proof
Proof of age
Other document if required

scheme_name: Free Computer Training
description: The scheme aims to provide a one-year free training course (Computer / Accounting / Web Designing / Digital Marketing) to ex-servicemen, serving soldiers, their widows, and dependents who have passed the 12th standard.
benefits: Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries are provided with a one-year free training course in Computer, Accounting, Web Designing, or Digital Marketing.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be an ex-serviceman, serving soldier, widow of a serviceman, or their dependent, and must have passed the 12th standard.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Under the scheme, training is provided in all districts in the following subjects:
Diploma in Computer Applications and Programming (Duration – 1 year)
Diploma in Professional Accounting (Duration – 1 year)
Web Designing and Development (Duration – 1 year)
Digital Marketing (Duration – 1 year)
The Director, Sainik Welfare Office, invites applications for these courses from ex-servicemen and their dependents through publicity campaigns. The following documents are required for application:
General application form
Aadhaar Card
Ex-serviceman Identity Card
Discharge Book
Educational certificate (12th pass)
After verification, the concerned District Sainik Welfare Office forwards the list of eligible applicants to the training institute. The institute then informs the selected candidates and commences the training program.
documents_required:
Aadhaar card
Ex-servicemen identity card
Discharge book
12th pass educational certificate

scheme_name: Free Legal Aid under the Legal Services Authority Act 1987
description: The scheme aims to provide free legal aid to all eligible persons in Uttarakhand who intend to file a case, have already filed a case, or need to defend a case under the provisions of the Legal Services Authority Act, 1987.
benefits: • Under this scheme, eligible persons who intend to file a case, have already filed a case, or need to defend a case shall be entitled to receive free legal services from the State Authority, the High Court Legal Services Committee, the District Legal Services Authority, or the Taluk Legal Services Committee, as the case may be under the Act.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand state.
1. The following persons shall be eligible for free legal aid:

• All citizens belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST).
• Persons subjected to human trafficking, abuse, or forced labour, as defined under Article 23 of the Constitution of India.
• All women and children.
• All persons with disabilities and persons with mental illness.
• Persons affected by natural calamities or disasters, including mass destruction, caste violence, caste atrocities, floods, earthquakes, industrial disasters, etc.
• All workers employed in the industrial sector.
• All persons detained in jail, prison, protection homes, juvenile homes, psychiatric hospitals, or nursing homes.
• Ex-servicemen.
• Persons belonging to the transgender community.
• Senior citizens.
• Persons infected with HIV/AIDS.
• All other persons whose annual income from all sources is less than ₹3,00,000/-.

> _Note: There is no income limit for persons mentioned in serial numbers 1 to 11._
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To provide free legal aid, the High Court Legal Services Committee has been established at the Hon’ble Uttarakhand High Court, District Legal Services Authorities have been set up in all districts, and Legal Services Committees have been constituted at the Tehsil level.
An E-Seva Kendra has been established within the premises of the Hon’ble High Court (Gate No. 7), where legal aid and advice can be availed by submitting a form and contacting the High Court Legal Services Committee, Nainital, at telephone number 09412979696. Additionally, the legal aid helpline number 15100 and toll-free number 1800 180 4000 are operational at the front office of the State Authority, where legal aid and advice can be obtained by calling.
For free legal aid, if any senior citizen, woman, or child is unable to visit the concerned office or submit the online form, Legal Volunteers deployed across urban and rural areas of the state can provide assistance. The list of Legal Volunteers, including their names and mobile numbers, is available on the website: https://slsa.uk.gov.in
At the district level, each District Legal Services Authority has a front office where legal aid and consultation can be availed either in person or by submitting a form. Applicants can also apply for free legal aid online at: https://nalsa.gov.in/lsams/nologin/applicationFiling.action?requestLocale=en. The offline application form can be downloaded from the website of the State Legal Services Authority, Uttarakhand: https://slsa.uk.gov.in
The eligible beneficiary will need the following documents to submit the form: Aadhaar Card, mobile number, caste certificate if belonging to SC/ST, disability certificate issued by the State Government or District Administration for persons with disabilities or mental illness, and income certificate or BPL certificate for those whose annual income from all sources is ₹3,00,000/- or less.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Mobile number
Caste certificate if belonging to SC/ST
Disability certificate issued by the State Government or District Administration for persons with disabilities or mental illness
BPL certificate/Income certificate for those whose annual income from all sources is ₹3,00,000 /-or less.

scheme_name: Free Pre-Recruitment Training
description: The scheme aims to provide 8 weeks of free pre-recruitment training for recruitment into the Military, Paramilitary, and Police Forces to sons of ex-servicemen aged between 16 and 21 years who have passed high school with at least 45% marks.
benefits: Under this scheme, 8 weeks of free pre-recruitment training for recruitment into the Military, Paramilitary, and Police Forces is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a son of an ex-serviceman.
1. The applicant's age should be more than 16 years and less than 21 years.
1. The applicant should have passed high school with 45% marks.

*All expenses incurred on training (honorarium of trainers + food + accommodation) are borne by the Directorate of Sainik Welfare.*
Note: 5 courses are conducted each year.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The District Sainik Welfare Office invites applications from sons of ex-servicemen through public notifications. 
Applicants are required to submit the following documents: Ordinary Application Form, Birth Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Educational Certificate (at least High School or Higher Secondary), Medical Certificate, Ex-Serviceman Identity Card, and Discharge Book. 
The above documents should be submitted to the concerned District Sainik Welfare Office. Once the applications are processed, selected trainees are informed about the training schedule, after which the training is conducted in the Garhwal and Kumaon divisions of the state.
documents_required:
Ordinary Application Form
Birth Certificate
Aadhaar Card
Educational Certificate (at least High School or Higher Secondary)
Medical Certificate
Ex-Serviceman Identity Card
Discharge Book

scheme_name: Free Shoe and Bag Scheme
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from Classes 1 to 8 studying in all government & government-aided schools for purchasing shoes & bags. An amount of ₹318/- per student for Classes 1 to 5 & ₹462/- per student for Classes 6 to 8 is provided through Direct Benefit Transfer.
benefits:
Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided for purchasing shoes and bags for boys and girls as follows:

 - ₹318/- per student for Classes 1 to 5
 - ₹462/- per student for Classes 6 to 8

The amount is transferred directly to the students' account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student of Classes 1 to 8 studying in any government or non-government aided school in Uttarakhand.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Students will receive the amount after submitting their Aadhaar card and bank account details to the Principal. 
At the beginning of the academic session, the amount is transferred through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card 
Bank account Details

scheme_name: Free Training for Vehicle Drivers
description: The scheme aims to improve the driving skills and employability of Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates by providing free, high-quality driving training, thereby reducing road accidents and promoting self-employment opportunities.
benefits: Under this scheme, training will be provided to vehicle drivers to enhance their driving skills, which will help reduce road accidents and enable them to pursue better self-employment opportunities.
eligibility:
• The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 - The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Interested applicants can submit their applications in the prescribed format (available at the IDTR office) in offline mode at the Institute of Driving and Traffic Research (IDTR), Dehradun.
Required Documents for Light Motor Vehicle (Vocational Course):
Aadhaar card of the applicant.
Caste certificate of the applicant.
One recent passport-size photograph.
High School Certificate or 8th Class Transfer Certificate.
A valid Light Motor Vehicle (Non-Transport) Driving License, at least one year old.
For Heavy Vehicle (Vocational Course):
Aadhaar card of the applicant.
Caste certificate of the applicant.
One recent passport-size photograph.
High School Certificate or 8th Class Transfer Certificate.
A valid Light Motor Vehicle (Transport) Driving License.
The license must be at least one year old.
For Refresher Courses:
Aadhaar card of the applicant.
A valid Driving License to operate a Light or Heavy Motor Vehicle.Validity: There is no time limit.
Renewal: It is not required.
Fees: Free of cost.
Process: Applications are scrutinized, and eligible candidates are admitted to the training program on a first-come, first-served basis.
Process: Applications can be submitted throughout the year, and training commences as soon as batches are formed.
documents_required:
For Light Motor Vehicle (Commercial Course):
Aadhaar Card of the Applicant
Caste Certificate
One Passport Size Photograph
High School Certificate or 8th Class Transfer Certificate
Valid Non-Transport Light Motor Vehicle License (Minimum 1 year old)
For Heavy Motor Vehicle (Commercial Course):
Aadhaar Card of the Applicant
Caste Certificate
One Passport Size Photograph
High School Certificate or 8th Class Transfer Certificate
Valid Transport Light Motor Vehicle License (Minimum 1 year old)
For Refresher Courses:
Aadhaar Card of the Applicant
Valid Driving License for Light or Heavy Motor Vehicle

scheme_name: Free Travel in Uttarakhand Transport Corporation Buses to Widowed Daughters-in-Law of Freedom Fighters
description: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Uttarakhand Transport Corporation (UTC) buses to the widowed daughters-in-law of freedom fighters. Beneficiaries under this scheme are entitled to avail complimentary travel across all UTC bus services within the state.
benefits: Under this scheme, widowed daughters-in-law of freedom fighters are entitled to free travel in Uttarakhand Transport Corporation (UTC) buses across the state.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a widowed daughter-in-law of a freedom fighter from Uttarakhand.
 1. The beneficiary must possess a valid identity card for the journey.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To obtain an identity card, the widowed daughter-in-law of a freedom fighter must contact the concerned District Magistrate's office, inquire about the required documents, and submit the application.
The District Magistrate's office will then issue her an identity card, on the basis of which she can travel free of cost in the buses of the Uttarakhand Transport Corporation.
documents_required:
Identity proof (Aadhaar card, voter ID, etc.)
Death certificate of husband
Address proof
Passport-size photographs (recent)
Other documents as required

scheme_name: Freeship less than ₹1,00,000 (UG students only)
description: The scheme "Freeship Less than ₹1,00,000 only for UG students" by the Dean Student Welfare, GBPUAT, Pantnagar aims to support meritorious undergraduate students from low-income families. This Freeship scheme provides full tuition fee exemption to eligible students.
benefits:

scheme_name: Fruit Area Expansion
description: The scheme aims to increase fruit production by encouraging farmers to establish new orchards, providing fruit plants at a 50% subsidy to support the expansion of fruit cultivation across Uttarakhand.
benefits:
• Increasing production by establishing new orchards. 
 - Fruit plants are provided at a subsidy of 50% of the total cost.
 - For developing orchards, fruit plants such as mango, guava, pomegranate, apple, litchi, plum, peach, apricot, walnut, citrus, malta, kiwi, dragon fruit, etc., are provided to farmers. (For example, if a walnut plant costs ₹400/-, the farmer has to deposit ₹200/- at the concerned Horticulture Mobile team Centre, and the government bears the remaining ₹200/- as subsidy, so the farmer receives the plant for ₹200/-.)
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a Udhyan Card.
1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease.
1. If the farmer owns land, the maximum land allowed per beneficiary is 4 hectares and the minimum land allowed is 0.02 hectares.
1. The maximum land area allowed under the scheme is 4 hectares.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Application forms can be obtained from the officers or staff at the Horticulture Mobile team Centre. Forms are also available for download from the department’s website: https://shm.uk.gov.in.
For winter planting, applications must be submitted between September and October, and for rainy season planting, applications must be submitted between April and June. Applicants are required to submit land-related documents, such as Khasra and Khatauni, along with the application form. For leased land, additional documents including the lease certificate, Aadhaar card, PAN card, Udhyan Card, bank account details, and mobile number are required.
Currently, the application process is offline. Farmers must submit their completed application along with the required documents to the respective Horticulture Mobile team Centre. The application format also serves as a proposal. If a farmer faces any difficulty in filling out the form, the staff at the respective centres are responsible for providing assistance.
For applications under centrally-sponsored schemes, once the proposal is submitted, the Horticulture Mobile team Centre forwards it to the district level. From there, applications are sent to the state level, and then to the Government of India. After the action plan is approved by the Government of India, targets are communicated back to the district level through the Directorate.
For state-sponsored schemes, applications are sent from the Horticulture Mobile team Centre to the district level, and then to the Directorate. Once the Directorate approves the farmers’ proposals, approval or work orders are issued to the districts as per the Government Order.
After a farmer’s proposal is approved, the district officer sends an acceptance letter and also informs the farmer via phone. Subsequently, the farmer can purchase fruit saplings from the relevant Horticulture Mobile team Centre at a 50% subsidy. Beneficiaries under the scheme are selected on a first-come, first-served basis, subject to budget availability.

scheme_name: Gaura Shakti Yojana
description: The objective of scheme is to prevent crimes against women & girls and to ensure prompt action in case of any incident. Under this, a three-tier support system is set up with Mahila Desks at police stations,Women Safety Helpline & Counselling Cells at district level, & a State Women Safety Helpline.
category: Public Safety,Law & Justice, Women and Child
benefits:
Under this Scheme, the following steps have been taken by Uttarakhand Police to prevent crimes against women and ensure women’s safety:

 1. A Quick Reaction Team (QRT) has been formed under the Women Help Desk at every police station. On receiving a complaint related to women at the police station, the QRT immediately reaches the spot and acts as the first responder, providing all possible assistance to the victim.
 1. Identification of Hot Spots and sensitive areas with regard to crimes against women is being carried out. CCTV cameras/lights are being installed in such Hot Spots, and their regular monitoring is ensured.
 1. Regular patrolling by Cheetah, Mahila Cheetah, and CPU teams is conducted during the opening and closing hours of schools, colleges, and coaching institutes.
 1. A team comprising Women Help Desk In-charges and four constables, named “Team Gaura”, has been constituted. The team regularly organizes awareness programmes to educate students on safety, drugs, traffic rules, cybercrime, etc. To strengthen this initiative, about 3,000 awareness booklets have been distributed to districts from the headquarters.
 1. From 20th to 22nd February 2023, a total of 35 women personnel appointed to Team Gaura from all districts were provided Self-Defense Instructor Course (Level-I) training. In continuation, the process of providing Level-II training to these personnel is underway. These trained women police personnel are regularly conducting training programmes in schools, colleges, and other institutions across districts to teach self-defense techniques to girl students.
eligibility: 1. Women and girls of the state are eligible to receive assistance under this scheme.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. In view of the safety of women and the prompt redressal of their complaints, the “Gaura Shakti Module” has been developed under the Uttarakhand Police App. After registration, the registrant remains in direct one-to-one contact with the designated Women Police Officer of the concerned police station. For effective implementation, a detailed SOP has been prepared, and all concerned officials have been trained at the headquarters level. In addition, a separate mobile number has been allotted to the in-charges of Women Help Desks in all police stations. Through this app, women can also easily register complaints online.
To ensure 24×7 accessibility, the Police Department has made the following platforms available for reporting crimes against women/girls or for registering complaints:
Dial 112 – with trained female police personnel available round-the-clock.
WhatsApp number at Police Headquarters – 9411112780
“Women Help Desk” at every police station.
Uttarakhand Police App – “Gaura Shakti Module” / SOS feature
Police station / outpost
With the objective of making every police station in the state more women-friendly, at least one Woman Sub-Inspector and four Women Constables have been deployed at each police station.
The Uttarakhand Police also ensures payment of compensation amounts as per rules under the Crime Victim Assistance Scheme, 2013. Further, the Uttarakhand Sexual Crime and Other Crimes Victim/Survivor Women Compensation Scheme, 2020 has been implemented for women victims. All concerned officials have been directed to assist crime victims in obtaining compensation under both schemes and to coordinate with the concerned departments as required.
Keeping in mind the sensitivity of cases involving women, investigations of sexual crimes against women are conducted exclusively by Women Officers. To ensure quality investigations, a booklet containing detailed SOPs and instructions has been issued by the headquarters and distributed to all women investigators. For scientific evidence collection in such cases, Sexual Assault Evidence Collection (SAEC) Kits are being provided to districts as needed.
Cases registered under POCSO and rape are being disposed of within the prescribed timelines. According to the ITSSO Portal, Uttarakhand ranks third at the national level in the timely disposal of such cases within two months.
Under the provisions of the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015, a Special Juvenile Police Unit (SJPU) has been constituted in each district under the chairmanship of the Senior Superintendent of Police. Additionally, a Child Welfare Police Officer (CWPO) has been appointed at every police station. Child-friendly police stations have also been established in every district.

eligibility:

application_process:
Mode: Online. The applicant can apply online either by themselves or through a Common Service Center (CSC) via the Department’s Pension Portal (https://ssp.uk.gov.in), the UMANG Mobile App, or the Apuni Sarkar Portal (https://eservices.uk.gov.in).
The following documents are mandatory at the time of applying: Applicant's mobile number, Aadhaar card, Passport-size Photo, Caste Certificate, Domicile/permanent residence certificate of Uttarakhand, CBS Bank Account Details (linked/seeded with Aadhaar), Valid Income Certificate or BPL Certificate, Ration Card, Copy of Family Register (only for rural areas), Bride and groom's date of birth certificate (High School certificate/Birth certificate/Family register/Aadhar card), Marriage registration certificate, Affidavit (Applicant's family has taken benefit only once before or has not taken benefit at all)
