 1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain).
 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 35 years.

 1. The applicant must be studying in or have taken admission to a university/college/institute recognized by the Central Government, State Government, or any other competent authority.

scheme_name: Minority Scholarship Scheme for Class 1 to 10
description: The scheme aims to provide scholarships to students belonging to minority communities who are studying in Classes 1 to 10 in any recognized government/non-government educational institution in Uttarakhand.
benefits:
At present, the State Government provides the following monthly scholarships for students from Class 1 to 10:

• Class 1 to 5: ₹50/-- Class 6 to 8: ₹80/-- Class 9 to 10: ₹120/-
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain).
1. The applicant must be studying in Classes 1 to 10.
1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized government/non-government educational institution in the state of Uttarakhand.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Minority community students studying in Classes 1 to 10 can register at any time through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP 2.0) at https://scholarships.gov.in. Registration requires an Aadhaar number and an Aadhaar-linked mobile number. 
During registration, students provide basic information such as their name, parents’ names, and educational qualifications. Upon successful registration, a student ID and password are generated. 
For applying to the scholarship, the department publishes advertisements in newspapers or on the NSP portal, inviting online applications within a stipulated period. 
Students must log in using their registered ID and password or register if not already done, and select their school or institution during the application process.
While applying, students are required to upload mandatory documents, including educational certificates, Aadhaar card, bank account linked with Aadhaar, permanent residence certificate, self-declaration certificate of minority community, income certificate, certificate of studying in school, and a passport-size photograph. In addition, offline copies of these documents must be submitted to the school or institution for verification. 
Once submitted, the application reaches the school’s Institute Nodal Officer (INO), who verifies the documents and forwards the application to the State Nodal Officer (SNO). The SNO then forwards the applications to the Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India after a random selection process (2% of applications). 
If all documents and eligibility criteria are verified and found correct, the scholarship amount is directly transferred to the student’s bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
documents_required:
Educational certificates
Aadhaar card
Bank account linked with Aadhaar
Permanent residence certificate
Self-declaration certificate of minority community
Income certificate
Certificate of studying in school
Passport-size photograph

scheme_name: Motorcycle Taxi Yojana
description: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing interest-free loans for purchasing motorcycles or scooters to operate as motorcycle taxis, thereby enhancing tourism connectivity and generating livelihood opportunities in the state.
benefits:
• The applicant will be provided an interest-free loan for a period of 2 years to purchase scooters or motorcycles for transporting tourists/travelers from one place to another at major tourist destinations. 
 - The loan will cover 75% of the total cost or ₹1.75 lakh per scooter/motorcycle, whichever is lower. The remaining 25% of the amount must be arranged by the applicant. 
 - An applicant can purchase a maximum of 10 scooters/motorcycles.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years old and not more than 55 years old.
 1. The applicant must possess a valid license issued by the Transport Department.
 1. The applicant must not be a defaulter of any financial or cooperative institution.
 1. The applicant must have a minimum CIBIL (Credit Information Bureau India Limited) score of 700 or above.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The applicant will obtain the application form from the cooperative bank in their area to purchase a scooter or motorcycle.
Along with the application form, the following documents must be attached and submitted to the concerned bank: Aadhar card, birth certificate, bank account details, permanent residence certificate, quotation and ex-showroom price of the scooter/motorcycle, driving license, and details of two sureties.
After submission, the applications will be scrutinized and then sent to the District Level Committee constituted under the chairmanship of the District Magistrate/Chief Development Officer. The applications will be presented before the committee for selection.
The applications of applicants selected by the committee will be forwarded to the concerned bank branches through the District Cooperative Bank Head Office. After completing the prescribed formalities, the bank will issue a loan sanction letter, and the sanctioned loan amount will be sent directly to the institution or firm from which the scooter or motorcycle is to be purchased.
The maximum period of the loan will be 3 years. The loan will be recovered in 35 equal monthly installments, starting one month after the date of disbursement.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Medhwi Balika Protsahan Yojana
description: The scheme aims to provide financial incentives to meritorious girl students belonging to minority communities based on their performance in the High School Examination or its equivalent (Munshi/Maulvi) and Intermediate Examination or its equivalent (Alim).
benefits:
The following incentives are given to meritorious girl students of minority community:
High School / Munshi / Maulvi:

• ₹10,000/- for securing 60% or above marks
• ₹15,000/- for securing 70% or above marks
• ₹20,000/- for securing 80% or above marks

Intermediate / Alim:

• ₹15,000/- for securing 60% or above marks
• ₹20,000/- for securing 70% or above marks
• ₹25,000/- for securing 80% or above marks
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to a minority community in Uttarakhand.
2. The applicant must be a girl student.
3. The girl student must have secured 60% or more marks as an institutional candidate in the High School Examination of the Uttarakhand Secondary Education Board / Madrasa Board or its equivalent (Munshi/Maulvi), or in the Intermediate Examination or its equivalent (Alim).
4. The applicant’s mother/father/guardian should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category, or their annual family income from all sources should not exceed:

 - ₹81,000 in rural areas
 - ₹1,03,000 in urban areas

5. The girl student must be unmarried.
6. The age of the girl student should not be more than 20 years.
7. A maximum of two daughters from the same family can avail of this benefit.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The advertisement for filling up application forms is published by the District Minority Welfare Officer or the District Social Welfare Officer, generally by 31st July every year. At present, applications are invited offline. The application form can be obtained from the departmental office or downloaded from the official website https://minoritywelfare.uk.gov.in
After obtaining the form, applicants are required to attach the necessary documents, which include a self-declaration certificate of belonging to a minority community, an income certificate, a permanent residence certificate, an affidavit declaring unmarried status and confirming that only two daughters of the family have received or will receive the benefit, details of an Aadhaar-linked or seeded bank account, a copy of the Aadhaar card, and a mobile number. 
The completed form along with these documents must be submitted at the development block office or the district office. From there, the development block office forwards the applications to the district level, where a committee reviews them and recommends eligible cases to the Directorate. The Directorate then consolidates the proposals and sends them to the Government.
Once the budget is sanctioned, funds are allocated to the districts as per the approved demand, and the sanctioned amount is transferred directly from the district to the beneficiary’s bank account. 
The benefit is available only in the same year in which the High School, Intermediate, or equivalent examination is passed, and it is mandatory to apply within that year. Selection of beneficiaries is made on the basis of budget availability.
documents_required:
Self-declaration certificate of belonging to a minority community
Income certificate
Permanent residence certificate
Affidavit stating unmarried status and confirming that only two daughters of the family have received or will receive the benefit
Aadhaar-linked/seeded bank account details
Aadhaar card
Mobile number, etc.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Protsahan Yojana
description: The scheme supports minority community candidates of Uttarakhand by offering financial incentives for competitive exam preparation. Incentives are provided at different stages of success in exams like UPSC, UKPSC (including judicial services), and entrances to IITs & IIMs.
benefits:
The following incentives are provided to candidates from the minority community for their preparation:
For the All India Civil Services Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC):

• ₹75,000/- after passing the Preliminary Examination and applying for the Main Examination.
• ₹25,000/- for interview preparation after passing the Main Examination.

For the Uttarakhand State and Subordinate Services (Direct Recruitment), Combined Competitive Examination, Higher Judicial Service, and Provincial Civil Services (Judicial) conducted by the Uttarakhand Public Service Commission (UKPSC):

• ₹60,000/- after passing the Preliminary Examination and applying for the Main Examination.
• ₹20,000/- for interview preparation after passing the Main Examination.

For admission to national-level institutes through entrance examinations:

• Group A: Admission to IITs and IIMs – ₹60,000/- after clearing the entrance examination and securing admission.
• Group B: Admission to AIIMS, IISc Bangalore, IISER (Kolkata & Bangalore), national-level medical colleges recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI), National Institutes of Technology (NITs) recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), National Law Universities recognized by the Bar Council of India (BCI), and through the Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) – ₹50,000/- after passing the entrance examination and securing admission.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain).
 1. The applicant must have successfully cleared either the Preliminary or Main Examination stage of UPSC, UKPSC (Combined Competitive or Higher Judicial Services), or the entrance examination of a national-level institution (such as IITs, IIMs, etc.).
 1. The annual income of the applicant’s parents/guardians (including the applicant’s own income, if any) must not exceed ₹4.50 lakh.
 1. The grant amount will be released only after the candidate submits the admit card of the relevant examination and the original application form/certificate of success to the competent authority.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Applicants can obtain the application form from the Directorate or the District Minority Welfare Office, or they may download it from the website https://minoritywelfare.uk.gov.in/. 
The application must be submitted within thirty days of clearing the examinations conducted by the State Public Service Commission or the Union Public Service Commission, and within thirty days of securing admission in a national-level institute after clearing its entrance examination. At present, the process is conducted offline.
The application form must be accompanied by a recent passport-size photograph certified by a gazetted officer, educational qualification certificates, a self-declaration minority community certificate, a permanent residence certificate, a valid income certificate, the admit card of the concerned examination, proof of success in the examination, details of an Aadhaar-linked bank account, a copy of the Aadhaar card, and an affidavit. The affidavit must declare that the benefit has not been availed earlier in the current financial year, specify whether the attempt is the first, second, or third, and state clearly whether the applicant is in government service. After verifying the details, the completed form must be submitted to the District Minority Welfare Officer’s office within one month of the result being declared.
The original certificates of the candidate are verified by the competent authority, and the candidate may be called for this purpose. Once the verification is found to be correct, eligible applications are forwarded from the district level to the Directorate for budget allocation. The Directorate then consolidates all proposals and submits them to the government. 
On receiving the budget, the Directorate releases funds to the districts as per the demand, and the respective district offices transfer the sanctioned amount directly into the candidate’s Aadhaar-linked bank account.
If a candidate qualifies in two or more examinations in the same financial year, benefits will be provided under only one scheme, depending on the option exercised by the candidate.
documents_required:
Recent passport-size photograph certified by a gazetted officer
Educational qualification certificates
Self-declaration minority community certificate
Permanent/original residence certificate
Valid income certificate
Admit card of the relevant examination
Proof of success in the examination
Aadhaar-linked/sealed bank account details
Aadhaar card
Affidavit (stating that the applicant has not received this benefit earlier in the same financial year, and clarifying whether this is the first/second/third attempt at the competitive examination. It must also mention whether the applicant is in Government service or not)

benefits:

 - For Senior Division/Senior Wing cadets: ₹2,400/-.
 - For Junior Division/Junior Wing cadets: ₹1,200/-.

> Unit Level:

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Ekeekrit Bagwani Vikas Yojana
description: The scheme aims to promote horticulture development in Uttarakhand by providing farmers with subsidized fruit plants, seeds, pesticides, & horticulture infrastructure such as Cool Houses & Refrigerator Vans, thereby increasing productivity, reducing post-harvest losses, & enhancing farmers’ income.
benefits:
Under this scheme, the following assistance is provided:

 - 50% subsidy on the cost of fruit plants, open-field vegetable seeds, spice seeds, and flower seeds. No direct monetary assistance is provided; the seeds and plants are supplied at a subsidized rate.
 - 60% subsidy on the cost of pesticides and other plant protection chemicals. No direct cash is given; the medicines are provided at a subsidized rate.
 - 50% subsidy on the total cost of ₹15.00 lakh for Cool Houses with a capacity of 30 MT.
 - 50% subsidy on the total cost of ₹26.00 lakh for Refrigerator Vans with a capacity of 9 MT.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a farmer and hold a valid Udhyan Card.
1. The farmer must either own agricultural land or have land on lease.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The application form can be obtained from the officers or personnel working at the Horticulture Mobile team Centres. It can also be downloaded from the department's website: https://shm.uk.gov.in. The application should be submitted approximately two months before planting saplings or applying medicines.
Along with the application form, the following documents are required: land-related documents such as Khasra and Khatauni; for leased land, a lease certificate; and identification documents including Aadhar card, PAN card, Udhyan card, as well as bank account details and mobile number. Currently, the application process is offline.
The farmer must submit the completed application form along with the required documents to the Horticulture Mobile team Centre. The proposal should be submitted in the prescribed format of the application form. If the farmer faces any difficulty in filling out the form, the concerned personnel at the Horticulture Mobile team Centre are responsible for assisting him. The centre then forwards the farmer's proposal to the district level, and from there to the Directorate. Once the Directorate approves the proposal, a government order is issued, and the districts receive the approval/work order accordingly.
After approval, the district officer sends an acceptance letter to the farmer and also informs them over the phone. The farmer can then purchase fruit saplings, seeds, or medicines from the Horticulture Mobile team Centre at a 50% subsidy.
In the case of Refrigerator Vans and Cool Houses, the subsidy is provided only after the farmer purchases the van or constructs the Cool House, following a site inspection by departmental officials. Beneficiaries under the scheme are selected on a first-come, first-served basis, subject to the availability of the budget.
documents_required:
Land-related documents such as Khasra and Khatauni
Lease certificate (for leased land)
Aadhaar card
PAN card
Udhyan card
Bank account details
Mobile number
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Ghasyari Kalyan Yojana
description: The scheme aims to provide affordable and nutritious packed silage and total mixed animal feed to livestock farmers, especially women, in the remote hilly areas of Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, silage is made available to livestock farmers at a subsidized rate of ₹2.75 per kg.
benefits:
• Packed silage and complete mixed animal feed are prepared by blending nutrients with green maize and are made available to cattle rearers in the remote rural and hilly areas of Uttarakhand at the rate of ₹2.75 per kg. 
 - Under the scheme, a 75% subsidy is provided on the selling price of silage, which is ₹9.00 per kg, and the State Government also provides financial assistance of ₹3.00 per kg towards expenses such as loading, transportation, and handling. As a result, silage is made available to beneficiaries at a subsidized rate of ₹2.75 per kg.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be residing in a hilly area of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be a livestock farmer or a woman engaged in livestock farming.
 1. The scheme is applicable only in the hilly areas of Uttarakhand.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Livestock owners or women beneficiaries can request silage directly from the secretary of the concerned cooperative society by submitting a written application. Along with the application, they must provide documents verifying their residence within the committee area, including their Aadhaar card.
In mountainous areas where cooperative societies are located far away, women can submit their subsequent requests through telephone or WhatsApp. Membership in a cooperative society is not mandatory under this scheme.
Based on the submitted request, livestock farmers or women beneficiaries will receive silage, total mixed ration, or fodder upon depositing the prescribed fee at the offices or centers of the cooperative societies.
documents_required:
Aadhaar card
Proof of residence
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Hunar Yojana
description: The scheme aims to provide free training in trades such as sewing, embroidery, knitting, plumbing, electronics, and in Information Technology fields including computer hardware, software, networking, accounting, and more, to individuals belonging to minority communities.
benefits:
Under this scheme, free training is provided along with an honorarium during the training period. The honorarium is paid as follows:

 - ₹2,000/- for 100 hours of training,
 - ₹2,500/- for 150 hours of training,
 - ₹4,000/- for 250 hours of training,
 - ₹4,500/- for 300 hours of training,

The training is conducted through implementing agencies, and the honorarium is disbursed based on attendance. A minimum of 90% attendance is mandatory.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be a man or woman belonging to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain).
 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 45 years.
 1. The applicant must have completed education either from a Government school or from a Madrasa.
 1. For traditional training courses such as sewing, embroidery, plumbing, electronics, knitting, etc., the applicant must be at least Class 5 pass or literate.
 1. For Information Technology courses (Computer Hardware, Software, Networking, Accounting, etc.), the applicant must have passed at least High School.
 1. The annual family income should not exceed ₹3,50,000/- in rural areas and ₹4,50,000/- in urban areas.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Under this scheme, training is provided through voluntary organizations. The Minority Welfare Department publishes advertisements inviting applications for training, after which interested candidates can obtain the application form from the Minority Welfare Office. 
The completed application form must be submitted to the office along with Aadhaar card, permanent residence certificate, minority certificate, income certificate, and educational qualification certificate. Applicants are then called for an interview by the selection committee constituted at the district level under the chairmanship of the District Minority Welfare Officer or the District Social Welfare Officer, who also serves as the ex-officio District Manager. 
At the time of the interview, candidates are required to present the original copies of all their documents for verification. After selection, the training is provided by the designated institute. 
Training programs are organized every year, and applicants may also submit their forms to the Minority Welfare Office in advance, even before the advertisement, so that their applications can be considered when the training sessions commence.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Permanent Residence Certificate
Minority Certificate
Income Certificate
Educational Qualification Certificate

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Kaushal Unnayan and Vaishvik Rojgar Yojana
description: The scheme aims to provide skill upgradation training along with country-specific training to the youth of the state, enabling them to secure employment opportunities abroad.
benefits:
• Under this scheme, youth of Uttarakhand are provided with skill upgradation training in various domains such as language, culture, work ethics, nursing, and hospitality, along with country-specific training. 
 - The training is provided as per the demand of foreign employers to enable the youth to secure suitable service and job opportunities abroad.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a youth of Uttarakhand.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Youth interested in overseas employment can register on the Apuni Sarkar portal. The registration process requires basic details such as the preferred field of work, educational qualification certificates, and passport information. 
After registration, applicants will be invited for a screening test. Those who qualify will become eligible for training.
Upon selection, candidates must submit their Aadhaar card, bank account details, and permanent residence certificate. Training may be provided in either residential or non-residential mode.
The State Government bears 20% of the total training cost. If the trainee avails a loan for up to 60% of the training cost, the State Government will subsidize 75% of the loan interest. In cases where no loan is taken, only 20% of the cost will be covered by the State Government. Trainees can apply for the loan during the training period, with assistance provided by the concerned department.
After completing the training, the employing company or institution conducts a test or interview. Only candidates who pass will be sent for overseas employment. 
The registration process on the Apuni Sarkar portal remains open throughout the year.
documents_required:
Aadhaar card
Bank account details
Permanent residence certificate

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Kit Yojana
description: The scheme aims to improve the health and well-being of both mothers and their newborn girl children by providing essential item kits after the institutional delivery of pregnant women registered at an Anganwadi Centre.
department: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
benefits:
In the state, after the institutional delivery of a pregnant woman, the following benefits will be provided:

• The woman will receive one Mahalakshmi kit for the birth of each of her first two girl children.
• In the case of twins, the woman will be given one Mahalakshmi kit, and each child will receive a separate Mahalakshmi kit.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman registered with an Anganwadi Centre and eligible to receive a Mahalakshmi Kit after delivery.
 1. The beneficiary must not be an income tax payer.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. After the institutional delivery of a pregnant woman registered at an Anganwadi Centre, a Mahalakshmi Kit is provided as a benefit.
The following items are included in the kit for mothers and their newborn girl children:
For Mothers: Dry fruits, socks, scarf, towel, shawl, blanket, bedsheet, sanitary pads, mustard oil, soap, and nail cutter.
For Newborn Girl Child: Cotton/warm cap, socks, diaper, towel, baby soap, rubber sheet, warm blanket, and vaccination card.
documents_required:
Identity proof of beneficiary
Delivery related medical reports/documents

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Poshan Yojana
description: The scheme aims to improve the health of pregnant and lactating women by providing nutritional food such as eggs twice a week and dates twice a week at Anganwadi Centres.
department: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
benefits: Under the scheme, pregnant and lactating women are provided eggs two days a week and dates two days a week. Dates are given to those registered women who do not consume eggs.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a pregnant or lactating woman.
application_process: Mode: Offline. Women who are registered at the Anganwadi Centre receive the benefits at the centre itself.
documents_required: Identity proof i.e. Aadhaar card, etc.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Junior Level)
description: The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among students entering Classes 6, 7, and 8 by providing financial assistance to meritorious students, based on their performance in a competitive examination conducted by the SCERT, Uttarakhand.
benefits:
Rate of Scholarship:

• For Class 6th Students: ₹600/- per month for 1 year.- For Class 7th Students: ₹700/- per month for 1 year.- For Class 8th Students: ₹800/- per month for 1 year.
eligibility:
1. The student must have passed Class 5 (institutional) from a Government School or Government-aided private school of the state (excluding Central and Residential schools) and must be studying in Class 6.
 1. The applicant must qualify in the competitive examination conducted by SCERT, Uttarakhand.
 1. Based on the examination results, a student securing a position in the top 10% of the total participants will be eligible to avail the benefits of this scheme.
 1. The selected student must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance and secure at least 60% marks in Classes 6 and 7. For SC/ST students, a relaxation of 5% is provided in both marks and attendance requirements.
 1. There is no income criterion for the parents/guardians of the student under this scholarship.
 1. A student cannot avail double benefits under multiple state scholarship schemes.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To appear in the scholarship examination, a student can collect the application form from the Block Education Officer’s office or download it from the School Education Department’s website (https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in) or the SCERT Uttarakhand website (https://scert.uk.gov.in/) during the months of June-July every year. At present, the application process is offline, and no application or examination fee is required.
While filling the application form, the student must attach a passport-size photograph, Aadhaar card, Class 5 passing certificate, admission card for Class 6, caste certificate if applicable, disability certificate if applicable, and Aadhaar-linked bank account details. The student must ensure that all information provided in the form is correct and then submit it to the Principal of the school where he or she is studying.
The Principal verifies the form on the basis of documents and school records, attests the photograph, and forwards the form to the Block Education Officer’s office by the stipulated date, which is usually around 21st August. After verification, the Block Education Officer issues the admit card.
Students can collect the admit card from their school or from the Block Education Officer’s office. The examination is conducted every year in September in an objective-type multiple-choice format. Students who are placed in the merit list are informed by the Principal, after which the scholarship amount is directly credited to the student’s bank account.
documents_required:
Passport-size photograph
Aadhaar card
Class 5 passing certificate
Admission card for studying in Class 6
Caste certificate (if applicable)
Disability certificate (if applicable)
Aadhaar-linked bank account details

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Secondary Level- Class 11 & 12)
description: The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students entering Classes 11 and 12 by providing financial assistance to meritorious students who have secured 80% or more marks in the Uttarakhand Board Examination of Class 10.

*Rate of Scholarship:*

eligibility:

The scholarship amount is transferred to the student’s bank account once the school receives the allocated budget.
documents_required:

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Puraskar Yojana
description: The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students and provides cash prizes to those who secure first, second, or third positions in their graduation or post-graduation studies at the university level.
benefits:
At the university level, students securing first, second, and third positions in graduation examinations are awarded:

 - 1st Position: ₹50,000/-
 - 2nd Position: ₹30,000/-
 - 3rd Position: ₹15,000/-

Students securing first, second, and third positions in post-graduation examinations are awarded:

• 1st Position: ₹75,000/-
• 2nd Position: ₹60,000/-
• 3rd Position: ₹30,000/-
eligibility:
1. This scheme is applicable to the top three students who have obtained the highest marks at the university level after completing their courses in the Arts, Science, and Commerce faculties at the graduate and post-graduate levels in the state’s Shridev Suman University, Kumaon University, Soban Singh Jeena University, and their affiliated colleges.
 1. Students who have obtained less than 60% marks will be ineligible under the scheme.
 1. Students who have appeared in improvement examinations in graduation or post-graduation, backlog examinations, or those who have dropped out in any year and then progressed to the next class will also be ineligible for the scheme.
application_process:
Mode: Online. The department requests a faculty-wise list of students who have obtained the highest marks in government universities and their affiliated colleges. 
The scholarships are credited directly to the students’ accounts after their data is verified through the Samarth portal. 
Students do not need to apply for this themselves.
documents_required: The required documents can be collected directly from the student’s university/college records.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Gas Refill Yojana
description: The scheme aims to support poor families by reducing their household fuel expenses. Under this scheme, Antyodaya (pink card) ration card holders in the state are entitled to receive three free gas cylinder refills every year.
benefits: Under this scheme, Antyodaya ration card (pink card) holders in the state are entitled to receive 03 free gas cylinder refills every year.
eligibility:
• The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
• The applicant must hold an Antyodaya (pink card) ration card issued by the state.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The list of Antyodaya ration card holders is provided by the District Supply Officer to the respective gas agency in the area.
An Antyodaya ration card holder can avail a free gas refill after linking their ration card details, Aadhaar, and bank account with the nearest gas agency.
To receive one free refill every four months, the cardholder must first pay the full price of the gas to the gas agency and collect the cylinder. The cost of the gas will then be reimbursed directly to the cardholder’s bank account through DBT.
documents_required:
Antyodaya Ration Card (Pink Card)
Aadhaar Card/Bank Details
Mobile Number

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Rajya Krishi Vikas Yojana
description: The scheme aims to help sugarcane farmers grow better crops, increase production, improve sugar quality, and provide support through high-quality seeds, modern techniques, mechanization, crop protection, and advanced farming practices.
benefits: 1. Breeder Seed Sugarcane Production Program: The programme is proposed to be run by G.B. Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar, on the farms of its subordinate research centres. Under this scheme, breeder seed production of the latest sugarcane varieties will be carried out. At sugarcane research centres, 25% of breeder seed nurseries will be established in autumn and 75% in spring. As per the allocation by the Sugarcane Department, a subsidy of ₹100/- per quintal is provided to the institution for seed distribution from these nurseries. Based on the average yield of the district, 50% of the subsidy will be provided for agricultural inputs such as fertilizers and pesticides at the time of sowing in the nursery, with the remaining amount payable upon seed distribution. 1. Establishment of Base Nurseries: It is proposed to establish base nurseries. A subsidy of ₹50/- per quintal will be provided for sugarcane seed distribution, with a maximum limit of ₹15,000/-. 1. Establishment of Primary Nurseries: It is proposed to establish primary nurseries, under which a subsidy of ₹25/- per quintal of sugarcane seed will be provided, with a maximum limit of ₹10,000/-. 1. Field Demonstrations: Demonstrations will be organized using the latest sugarcane sowing techniques. Sugarcane farmers will be provided a grant of ₹7,500 per 0.5-hectare demonstration. 1. Sugarcane Seed Transportation and Harvesting Loading: A 100% subsidy on actual transportation costs will be provided to buyer-based nursery holders or the Sugarcane Development Council for transporting elite seeds produced at research farms. 1. Subsidy on Agricultural Equipment: Under the Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization, human-operated equipment for sugarcane cultivation will be distributed to farmers. 1. Sugarcane Seed Differential Price Payment: The Department will provide a subsidy based on the actual cost of sugarcane seeds, which can be supplied from any sugarcane research center located within or outside the State. 1. Pest, Disease, and Weed Control: A farmer is eligible for a subsidy of up to ₹3,000/- per hectare for crop protection and weed control. The subsidy covers 50% of the actual cost, with a maximum limit of ₹3,000/- per farmer. 1. Distribution of Micronutrients, Organic, and Bio-Fertilizers: Farmers will receive a 50% subsidy, up to ₹1,000/- per hectare, on the purchase of micronutrients, organic, and bio-fertilizers to promote successful sugarcane cultivation and improve sugar recovery. 1. The scheme encourages farmers to adopt advanced sugarcane cultivation through publicity campaigns, soil testing, and training programs at the village and district levels.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a farmer cultivating sugarcane.
1. The applicant must be a permanent member of a cooperative sugarcane development society.
1. The applicant must practice advanced sugarcane farming.
1. The applicant’s name must be registered in the land records of the state.
application_process: Mode: Offline. To select sugarcane farmers eligible for the benefits of this scheme, the selection is carried out after discussions with public representatives in the Gram Sabha (village assembly) meeting at the village level, followed by a survey conducted by the sugarcane supervisor, and upon approval by the departmental officers (Sugarcane Development Inspector, Senior Sugarcane Development Inspector, and Assistant Sugarcane Commissioner).
documents_required:
Identity proof
Land record documents
Bank account details
Proof of membership of the concerned society 
Other supporting documents as required

eligibility:

 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman or a lactating mother registered and residing within the service area of the concerned Anganwadi Centre (AWC).
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Step 1: Visit the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) in your locality.
Step 2: Obtain the scheme enrollment form from the Anganwadi Worker (AWW).
Step 3: Fill in the details in the form with attach the required documents.
Step 4: Submit the filled form and documents to the AWC.
After Submission of Application:The Anganwadi Worker verifies the eligibility and registers the applicant under MSPY – Maternal Nutrition.
Beneficiary receives acknowledgement of enrolment and is included in the monthly THR distribution list.
On the 1st of every month, the AWW distributes the entitled THR packages (Til Ladoo, Chana, Paushtik Bhel, Dates) at the AWC.
Health services such as ANC check-ups, IFA and Calcium supplementation continue as per schedule.
documents_required:
Identity proof (Aadhaar Card, etc.)
Proof of Residence
Pregnancy Certificate / Maternal Health Card/Medical Report
Any other documents (as per requirement)

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Saur Swarojgar Yojana - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
description: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by enabling them to establish and operate solar power projects, thereby generating clean energy, providing a sustainable source of income, and encouraging entrepreneurship.
benefits:
Under the scheme, self-employment is provided to eligible applicants/beneficiaries through the allocation of solar power projects with capacities of 20, 25, 50, 100, and 200 kW, as detailed below:

 - 20 kW: Project cost ₹10 lakh; land required – 300 sq. meters.
 - 25 kW: Project cost ₹12.50 lakh; land required – 300 sq. meters.
 - 50 kW: Project cost ₹25.00 lakh; land required – 700–1000 sq. meters.
 - 100 kW: Project cost ₹50.00 lakh; land required – 1500–2000 sq. meters.
 - 200 kW: Project cost ₹100.00 lakh; land required – 3000–4000 sq. meters.

*(Selected candidates will be provided loans from Uttarakhand State/District Cooperative Banks at an interest rate of 8%. Additionally, beneficiaries will be eligible for incentives and benefits under the MSME Policy-2023, provided by the Industries Department.)*
The electricity generated from the allotted solar projects will be purchased by Uttarakhand Power Corporation Limited (UPCL) for a period of 25 years. Payments to beneficiaries will be made according to the prevailing tariff rates for the electricity sold.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. Only one solar power plant will be allotted per family, and each applicant is eligible for only one project.
 1. To avail benefits under the current MSME Policy, the allottee must apply under this scheme as a proprietorship. Applications in the form of a partnership firm, company, trust, or society will not be permitted.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Under the scheme, applications must be submitted online through the portal https://msy.uk.gov.in/. For the application, the applicant must provide a permanent residence certificate, Aadhar card, identity card, application fee, affidavit, and documents related to the proposed land. 
After submission, the application is sent to UPCL for technical feasibility and review (TFR). Once this process is complete, UPCL returns the application to UREDA, after which the district office presents it to the allotment committee. Upon recommendation by the committee, UREDA allocates the solar power plant to the applicant.
documents_required:
Permanent Residence Certificate
Aadhaar Card
Identity Card
Application Fee
Affidavit
Documents related to the proposed land
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance and subsidies for establishing new enterprises or upgrading existing small-scale units.
benefits:
The maximum project cost for manufacturing sector enterprises is ₹25 lakh, and for service and business sector enterprises, it is ₹10 lakh, which is financed through banks.

 - 25% subsidy for Category-A districts (manufacturing sector – maximum ₹6.25 lakh; service sector – maximum ₹2.50 lakh)
 - 20% subsidy for Category-B and B+ districts (manufacturing sector – maximum ₹5 lakh; service sector – maximum ₹2 lakh)
 - 15% subsidy for Category-C and D districts (manufacturing sector – maximum ₹3.75 lakh; service sector – maximum ₹1.50 lakh)

> Note: Classification of districts category wise is attached at [Annexure-1](https://uk.gov.in/department92/library_file/file-04-12-2023-06-02-23.pdf). (Page No. 157)
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
 1. No educational qualification is required for availing the benefits under this scheme.
 1. Under the scheme, financing is available for industrial, service, and business sectors. It is also available for projects related to apple cultivation, orchids, animal husbandry, and agriculture activities.
 1. The applicant or entity must not be a defaulter of any bank, nationalized bank, financial institution, or cooperative bank/institution.
 1. The applicant must hold an account with the financing bank in the concerned area.
application_process:
Mode: Online. To avail the benefits of the scheme, applications must be submitted online through the portal https://msy.uk.gov.in/. Eligible applications are then forwarded online to banks for funding. Financial assistance may be provided under the scheme for both new projects and for upgrading existing small-scale enterprises.
The documents required for the application include the applicant’s photograph, Aadhaar card, permanent or original residence certificate, special category or caste certificate (if applicable), a copy of project details, handicapped certificate (if applicable), and ration card. All self-attested documents must be uploaded online through the online portal.
The prescribed subsidy will be released only after the project established under the scheme has been successfully operational for a continuous period of two years.
documents_required:
Applicant’s photograph
Aadhaar card
Permanent/original residence certificate
Special category/caste certificate (if applicable)
Copy of project details
Handicapped certificate (if applicable)
Ration card copy
(All self-attested documents must be uploaded online through a single portal.)

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana Ati Sukshm (Nano) Udhyam
description: The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance through banks to facilitate the establishment of new micro (nano) enterprises as well as the expansion of existing businesses.
benefits:
To strengthen small entrepreneurs and businessmen in rural and urban areas, financing of up to ₹50,000/- is provided through banks for setting up micro enterprises or businesses. This financial assistance is also available for the expansion of existing businesses. The subsidy structure is as follows:

 - Subsidy for Category A districts: 35% for the general category (maximum ₹17,500/-) and 40% for the special category (maximum ₹20,000/-).
 - Subsidy for Category B and B+ districts: 30% for the general category (maximum ₹15,000/-) and 35% for the special category (maximum ₹17,500/-).
 - Subsidy for Category C and D districts: 25% for the general category (maximum ₹12,500/-) and 30% for the special category (maximum ₹15,000/-).

The category-wise classification of districts is provided in [Annexure-2](https://uk.gov.in/department92/library_file/file-04-12-2023-06-02-23.pdf) (Page No. 157).
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
 1. No educational qualification is required for availing the benefits under this scheme.
 1. The applicant must hold an account with the financing bank in the concerned area.
 1. The applicant or entity must not be a defaulter of any bank, nationalized bank, financial institution, or cooperative bank/institution.
application_process:
Mode: Online. To avail the benefits of the scheme, applications must be submitted online through the portal https://msy.uk.gov.in/. Eligible applications are then forwarded online to banks for funding. Financial assistance may be provided under the scheme for both new projects and for upgrading existing small-scale enterprises.
The documents required for the application include the applicant’s photograph, Aadhaar card, permanent residence/domicile certificate, special category or caste certificate (if applicable), a copy of project details, affidavit, education certificate, bank account details, disability certificate (if applicable), and ration card. All self-attested documents must be uploaded online through the online portal.
The prescribed subsidy will be released only after the project established under the scheme has been successfully operational for a continuous period of one year.
documents_required:
Applicant’s photograph
Aadhaar card
Permanent/residence certificate
Special category/caste certificate (if applicable)
Project report
Affidavit
Education certificate
Bank account details copy
Disability certificate (if applicable)
Ration card
(All self-attested documents must be uploaded on the online portal only.)

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Uchcha Shiksha Shodh Protsahan Yojana
description: The scheme aims to promote high-quality, interdisciplinary research in higher education institutions across state. The broad subject areas for research include Science, Arts & Humanities, Home Science, & Commerce & Management, while proposals in interdisciplinary subject areas are also encouraged.
benefits: The maximum research grant provided by the state government is ₹15 lakh, which may be increased up to ₹18 lakh in special circumstances.
eligibility:
1. The regular professors working in state government colleges and state university campuses of Uttarakhand, as well as students and research scholars enrolled in regular programs at recognized institutions within the state, are eligible to apply.
 1. A research proposal may also include a co-investigator alongside the principal investigator.
 1. The broad subject areas for research include Science, Arts and Humanities, Home Science, and Commerce & Management, while interdisciplinary subjects will also be accepted. 
 1. Research related to the state that proves to be productive and useful in social, economic, contemporary, or other areas of special importance will be encouraged. 
 1. Priority will be given to problem-oriented, solution-driven, and action-based research topics (Problem and Action-Based Research Programme).
 1. Research proposals may also be invited based on requests for specific issues raised by any department of the state government. 
 1. A maximum period of two years will be allowed for completing the research work, which may be extended by one additional year under special circumstances.
 1. Only one research project will be permitted for any teacher or research scholar at a time.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Researchers must submit their research proposals online through the Samarth portal (https://uttarakhand.samarth.ac.in/index/site/login). 
During the application process, the proposal must be uploaded and forwarded by the institution’s Principal or Registrar within fifteen days of submission; otherwise, it will automatically move to the next level. 
The proposal will then be evaluated by the Evaluation Committee, and the research grant will be released in three installments via DBT to the institution’s Research and Development Cell account.
Upon the written request of the Principal Investigator, the Principal or Registrar must make the grant available to the Principal Investigator or Researcher within three days. If this is not done, the State Research and Development Cell Committee must be informed through the Director of Education with clear written reasons, and the final decision will rest with the Secretary, Higher Education/Committee.
The first installment, amounting to 50% of the grant, will be released upon approval of the research proposal. 
The second installment, amounting to 30%, will be released only after submission of the utilization certificate. 
The third and final installment, amounting to 20%, will be released upon completion of the research work. 
The research must be original and in accordance with UGC standards. 
A Research Assistant will receive a stipend of ₹5,000 per month from the release of the first installment until the completion of the research work.
documents_required: All required documents must be submitted in accordance with the guidelines specified for the research proposal by the concerned institution.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Udeeyman Khiladi Unnayan Chhatravriti Yojana
description: The scheme aims to promote sports among talented children aged 8 to 14 years in Uttarakhand by providing a monthly scholarship of ₹1,500. Players in this age group are selected every year on the basis of Physical & Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT), with 150 boys & 150 girls selected from each district.
benefits:
• Under this scheme, players aged 8 to 14 years are selected every year on the basis of the Physical and Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT). 
 - From each district, 150 boys and 150 girls are selected (25 boys and 25 girls from each age group: 8–9 years, 9–10 years, 10–11 years, 11–12 years, 12–13 years, and 13–14 years). 
 - Each selected player is awarded a scholarship of ₹1,500/- per month for one year.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be a boy or girl between 8 and 14 years of age.
 1. The boy or girl who obtain the highest marks based on merit in the final district-level competition, conducted through various stages of the Physical and Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT) assessing physical abilities such as strength, flexibility, endurance, speed, and coordination, will be eligible for the sports scholarship.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The Sports Directorate will publish the selection schedule through an advertisement in April. The selection process is typically completed between May 15 and June 15 each year, and information regarding the venue and dates will be provided by the respective District Sports Officer.
A maximum of two boys and two girls from each school (government, non-government, or private) will be eligible to participate in each age group. The selection of these students will be carried out by the respective schools themselves. There will be no compulsion to conduct the Physical and Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT) at the school level; however, schools will be informed about this method through wide publicity so that players are aware of the process at the initial stage.
Further process – The subsequent selection is conducted by the districts at the Nyaya Panchayat, Municipality, Municipal Corporation, Block Development, and district levels:
