scheme_name: Mushroom Production
description: The scheme aims to promote and support mushroom cultivation in the state by providing financial assistance and subsidies for establishing mushroom, compost, and spawn production units, thereby enhancing both farmer income and overall mushroom production in Uttarakhand.
benefits:
Under the scheme:

 - To promote mushroom production, a 40% subsidy is provided to the individual sector (farmers or persons interested in mushroom cultivation).
 - For setting up a mushroom production unit, a 40% subsidy is provided, up to a maximum of ₹20,00,000/- per unit.
 - For setting up a compost production unit, a 40% subsidy is provided, up to a maximum of ₹20,00,000/- per unit.
 - For setting up a spawn production unit, a 40% subsidy is provided, up to a maximum of ₹15,00,000/- per unit.
 - For the public sector (government departments, institutions, agricultural/industrial universities, etc.), 100% subsidy is provided on the total cost.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a farmer interested in mushroom production.
1. The farmer must either own land or have land on lease.
1. Each farmer is eligible for assistance for only one unit.
1. There is no provision to provide assistance or subsidy if the farmer does not take a loan.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To avail the benefits of this scheme, the applicant must first download the application form/proposal format from the department's website https://shm.uk.gov.in/ or obtain it from the Horticulture office of the concerned district.
The applicant must then prepare the application proposal in the prescribed format. If any difficulty arises in preparing the proposal, assistance can be sought from the departmental staff at the Dehradun and Jyolikot Indo-Dutch Mushroom Offices. Once prepared, the proposal must be submitted to the relevant office.
The interested farmer must apply for a bank loan. For this, the applicant is required to provide land documents, Aadhaar card, PAN card, bank account details, income details from mushroom farming, expenditure details, other sources of income, and any land-related documents. The bank will process the loan application and approve it following its standard procedures.
After loan approval, the farmer must submit the application to the office of the Director of Horticulture Mission/Chief Mushroom Development Officer in the prescribed format. The application must include the following documents: land records, bank loan approval letter, Aadhaar card, bank passbook, PAN card, copy of family registry/ration card, permanent residence/account khatauni, khasra and khatauni, mushroom training certificate, affidavit, lease certificate for leased land, and, in the case of owned land, an affidavit of ownership. If any required documents are missing at the time of application, the applicant may be asked to provide them verbally or in writing. The submitted proposal is then evaluated by a committee.
Upon approval of the proposal, the applicant is notified by telephone and receives a formal approval letter from the office of the Director of Horticulture Mission/Chief Mushroom Development Officer. The farmer may then begin establishing the mushroom unit. Following this, departmental personnel conduct a site inspection. Based on the inspection report, the subsidy is disbursed directly into the farmer's account in two installments. Currently, this entire process is conducted offline.
documents_required:
For applying a loan from a bank, following documents are required:
Land documents
Aadhaar card
PAN card
Bank account details
Income details from mushroom farming
Expenditure details
Details of other sources of income
Upon approval of the bank loan, the farmer needs to submit the following documents to the office of the Director of Horticulture Mission or the Chief Mushroom Development Officer:
Land records
Bank loan approval letter
Aadhaar card
Bank passbook
PAN card
Copy of family registry or ration card
Permanent residence proof
Land documents (Khasra and khatauni details)
Mushroom training certificate
Affidavit
Lease certificate (if land is leased)
Affidavit of ownership (in case of round account land)
If any required documents are missing, the applicant is asked to provide them either verbally or in writing.

scheme_name: Mushroom Production and Marketing Scheme
description: The scheme aims to promote mushroom cultivation among farmers by providing subsidized inputs, training, and support for marketing, thereby increasing their income and encouraging entrepreneurship in the sector.
benefits:
Under this scheme, the following assistance is provided:

 - Pasteurized compost is provided at a 50% subsidy on the total cost, up to a maximum of 50 quintals per beneficiary. Similarly, mushroom spawn (seed) is provided at a 50% subsidy on the total cost, up to a maximum of 25 kg per beneficiary. No cash is given; the pasteurized compost and spawn are provided directly by the department.
 - Seven-day training for mushroom growers is provided (₹1,050/- per beneficiary), of which ₹700/- is transferred to the beneficiary’s account through DBT, and ₹350/- is used for training materials and related expenses.
 - Farmers/mushroom growers who produce mushrooms under the scheme can sell their produce in local markets or mandis.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a farmer interested in mushroom cultivation.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To avail the benefits of this scheme, the applicant must first download the application form/proposal format from the department's website https://shm.uk.gov.in/ or obtain it from the concerned Horticulture Mobile team Centre office. The applicant must then prepare the proposal in the prescribed format.
If there is any difficulty in preparing the proposal, the Horticulture Mobile team Centre personnel will assist. The application requires land documents, Aadhaar card, PAN card, bank account details, expected income from mushroom cultivation, and any previous training certificates. The completed proposal must then be submitted to the office.
If the farmer does not have sufficient funds, they may apply for a loan from the bank. The application form is then sent directly to the Horticulture Mission, where it is evaluated by a committee. Upon approval, the applicant is informed via telephone and receives an acceptance letter from the office of the Director of the Horticulture Mission or the Chief Mushroom Development Officer.
Interested farmers can obtain pasteurized compost and spawn from the relevant district office. This entire process is currently conducted offline. Eligible beneficiaries are allocated up to 50 quintals of compost and 25 kg of spawn on a first-come, first-served basis, depending on budget availability.
For training, an application must be submitted to the Horticulture Mobile team Centre. After receiving the request, the department schedules the training and informs the farmer by phone. The farmer can then attend the training on the scheduled date.
documents_required:
Land related documents
Aadhaar card
PAN card
Bank account details
Details of expected income from mushroom cultivation
Certificates of any previous training in mushroom cultivation

scheme_name: Namami Gange Yojana- Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to promote sustainable and organic farming practices among farmers residing in villages along the banks of the Ganga and its tributaries.
benefits: Under the scheme, farmers are provided assistance to adopt organic farming through the formation of clusters.
eligibility: 1. Farmers residing in villages located along the banks of the Ganga and its tributaries in Uttarakhand are eligible for assistance under this scheme.
application_process: Mode: Offline. Applications can be submitted in the prescribed format at the office of the Uttarakhand Organic Commodity Board, Kisan Bhawan, 2nd Floor, Mussoorie Bypass, Ring Road, Nehrugram, Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248001.
documents_required: Documents are required as per the guidelines of the Council to avail the benefits of the scheme.

scheme_name: Nandaa Gaura Yojana
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for upto 2 girls in a family. Assistance is given in 2 installments per girl child: 1st installment of ₹11,000 is provided at the time of birth if girl is born in a hospital/ANM center & 2nd installment of ₹51,000 is given when girl passes Class 12th.
department: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
benefits:
Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to two girls of an eligible family in two installments for each girl child:

 - ₹11,000/- at the time of birth.
 - ₹51,000/- when the girl passes Class 12.

For the first installment, the application must be submitted within six months of the girl’s birth, and the child must be born in a hospital/ANM center.
For the second installment, the application can be submitted when the girl passes Class 12. Applications are invited from July to November of the same year in which she passes. If applied in the next year, the application will not be considered valid. The second installment will be granted only if the girl has passed Class 12 from the Uttarakhand Board, Secondary Education Board of other states, CBSE, ICSE, or the National Institute of Open Schooling, New Delhi, and the girl must be unmarried.
eligibility:
1. The applicant family must be permanent residents of Uttarakhand.
2. The family’s monthly income should not exceed ₹6,000/-, or the family should belong to the BPL category to be eligible.
3. The benefit is applicable for up to two girls per family.
4. It is mandatory for the mother/father/guardian to submit an affidavit regarding availing or not availing the benefit of the scheme for other girl children in the family in the past. The affidavit must include the following declarations:

 - All information regarding movable and immovable properties and other details sought by me have been provided correctly.
 - I certify that this benefit is being availed for my first/second daughter.
 - No facts have been concealed by me.
 - I have provided the details of all family bank accounts along with bank statements for the last one year.
 - In the case of applying after passing Class 12, I confirm that my daughter is unmarried.

5. Girls living in Nari Niketan, Balika Niketan, orphanages, or other state government-aided homes will be exempted from the requirement of birth certificate, permanent residence certificate, income certificate, or parent’s name to avail the benefit after passing Class 12.
application_process:
Mode: Online. To avail the benefits of this scheme, the girl child or her parents/guardians must register on the official portal https://www.nandagaurauk.in
Aadhaar card and mobile number are mandatory for registration. After completing the registration, it is necessary to upload the required documents within the stipulated time to apply for benefits.
For claiming benefits at the birth of a girl child, the following documents are required: Maternal Child Immunization/MCP (Vaccination) card, latest passport size photograph of the girl child, birth registration certificate, mother’s institutional delivery certificate, signature of the mother/father/guardian, Aadhaar card, PAN card, bank account linked with Aadhaar, mobile number, and permanent residence certificate.
For claiming benefits after passing the 12th standard, the applicant must submit: latest passport size photograph, signature, Aadhaar card, PAN card, bank account linked with Aadhaar, permanent residence certificate, high school certificate, mark sheet and certificate of passing Class 12th, or a self-attested mark sheet in case of passing from National Open School or other recognized institutions. Additionally, a copy of the admission record in higher education (if available) and a certificate of passing Class 12th issued by the Principal (for institutional students only) are required.
In addition to the above, the following documents are necessary for availing benefits under both installments: certificate of Anganwadi worker, ration card, copy of family register or certificate issued by member/councilor, income certificate or BPL certificate, house tax receipt issued by the urban/rural local body or, in the absence of a house tax receipt, a certificate issued by the village headman/councilor, documents of rent agreement (if applicable), copy of bank passbook or one-year bank statement of all family members, family status assessment from the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC), affidavit, other relevant documents, copies of the last three electricity bills of the family, and the latest water bill (or mention in the affidavit if no connection exists).
Once the online application is submitted, verification will be carried out by the concerned department. If all documents and details are found correct after verification, the benefit amount is credited directly into the applicant’s bank account, subject to the availability of budget.
documents_required:
For claiming benefits at the birth of a girl child, the following documents are required:
Maternal Child Immunization/MCP (Vaccination) card
Latest passport size photograph of the girl child
Birth registration certificate
Mother’s institutional delivery certificate
Signature of the mother/father/guardian
Aadhaar card, PAN card, bank account linked with Aadhaar
Mobile number
Permanent residence certificate
For claiming benefits after passing the 12th standard, the applicant must submit: 
Latest passport size photograph, signature
Aadhaar card, PAN card
Bank account linked with Aadhaar
Permanent residence certificate
High school certificate, mark sheet and certificate of passing Class 12th, or a self-attested mark sheet in case of passing from National Open School or other recognized institutions. Additionally, a copy of the admission record in higher education (if available) and a certificate of passing Class 12th issued by the Principal (for institutional students only) are required.
In addition to the above, the following documents are necessary for availing benefits under both installments: 
Certificate of Anganwadi worker
Ration card
Copy of family register or certificate issued by member/councilor,
Income certificate or BPL certificate, house tax receipt issued by the urban/rural local body or, in the absence of a house tax receipt, a certificate issued by the village headman/councilor, documents of rent agreement (if applicable), 
Copy of bank passbook or one-year bank statement of all family members, family status assessment from the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC), affidavit, other relevant documents, copies of the last three electricity bills of the family, and the latest water bill (or mention in the affidavit if no connection exists).

scheme_name: National AIDS Control Programme - Uttarakhand
description: The programme aims to prevent and control the spread of HIV/AIDS through awareness, testing, and treatment, while providing care and support to affected individuals.
department: Medical Health And Family Welfare Department
benefits: Raising public awareness about HIV/AIDS and providing free HIV testing, treatment, and medication.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiaries should be the general public and HIV-infected individuals residing in Uttarakhand.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Under the National AIDS Control Programme, the general public is made aware about HIV/AIDS through various publicity campaigns, and complete information on prevention can be obtained by calling the toll-free helpline 1097.
HIV testing is provided free of cost at ICTCs established in government hospitals.
People living with HIV receive free anti-retroviral medication through designated Anti-Retroviral Therapy (ART) centres.
documents_required: Documents are required in accordance with the programme guidelines.

scheme_name: National Bio Energy Programme - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
description: The scheme aims to promote the use of biogas as a clean and renewable energy source, help livestock farmers set up biogas plants, reduce the use of conventional fuels, and support eco-friendly rural development in the state.
benefits:
The gas produced from biogas plants can be used for cooking, and high-quality compost manure can also be obtained as a byproduct.
The grant for establishing biogas plants is payable as follows:

 - 1 cubic meter – ₹17,000/-
 - 2–4 cubic meters – ₹22,000/-
 - 6 cubic meters – ₹29,250/-
 - 8–10 cubic meters – ₹34,500/-
 - 15 cubic meters – ₹63,250/-
 - 20–25 cubic meters – ₹70,400/-

The estimated cost of a small biogas plant is approximately ₹40,000/-, and the department provides a grant of ₹22,000/-.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a livestock farmer residing in Uttarakhand.
1. To install a biogas plant, 12 sq. meters of land (4 × 3 m) and at least 3 animals are required.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Applications can be submitted online through the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) portal at https://biogas.mnre.gov.in or through the district-level UREDA office.
To apply online for establishing a biogas plant, the applicant will need an Aadhaar card, ration card, and bank account. No PCB or NOC from any other department is required.
If you are unable to apply online, you can submit your application offline, and the district-level UREDA office will provide assistance.

Mode: Offline. Applicants can submit their applications offline by visiting the district-level UREDA office and the staff at the district-level UREDA office will provide assistance.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Ration Card
Bank Account
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: National Family Benefit Scheme- Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹20,000/- to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families upon the death of the primary breadwinner (main earning member of the family) to help them cope with immediate financial hardships.
benefits: A one-time financial assistance of ₹20,000/- is provided to the family in the event of the death of the primary earning member.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a family member of the deceased primary breadwinner.
1. The deceased primary breadwinner must have been a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The family must be classified under the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. The deceased must have been between 18 and 59 years of age at the time of death.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. At present, applications for this scheme are submitted offline. The eligible applicants can obtain the application form from the office of the Assistant Social Welfare Officer or download from the departmental website (https://socialwelfare.uk.gov.in). 
After that, the duly filled application form must be submitted along with the following documents: Aadhaar card of the family member/applicant, mobile number, attested photograph, bank account passbook linked/seeded with Aadhaar, BPL certificate, copy of family register, death certificate of the earning member, and Aadhaar card of the earning member. 
The application form along with the necessary documents are submitted to the office of the Assistant Social Welfare Officer. The application is sent to the Government of India from the district level and if the documents are found to be correct, the amount is paid directly into the beneficiary's account.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card of the Applicant/Family Member
Mobile Number
Passport-size Photograph
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar-linked)
BPL Certificate
Copy of Family Register
Aadhaar Card of the Deceased Breadwinner
Death Certificate of the Deceased Breadwinner

scheme_name: National Food Security Scheme (Antyodaya Anna Yojana - Pink Ration Card) - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to ensure food security for the poorest and most vulnerable families by providing them with subsidized food grains under the Antyodaya category in the state. Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive 35 kg of food grains and 1 kg of sugar per ration card at subsidized rates.
benefits:
Under the scheme, each Pink Ration Card holder receives 35 kg of food grains (13.30 kg of wheat at ₹2.00 per kg and 21.70 kg of rice at ₹3.00 per kg) along with 1 kg of sugar at ₹13.50 per kg. 
At present, from 1 January 2023, food grains are being distributed free of cost to all ration card holders in the state.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The beneficiary must belong to the Antyodaya category of the state.
 1. The following families/persons are eligible under the Antyodaya category:

 - Families in which any member is eligible for a disability pension and the total monthly family income is less than ₹4,000/-.
 - BPL families.
 - Individuals infected with HIV.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Targets have been set for each district under the Antyodaya Anna Yojana.
Procedure for removal of name from the Antyodaya category:
If a person is no longer eligible for the Antyodaya category, the individual must inform the District Supply Officer. After the department conducts an inspection and confirms the information to be true, the cardholder is removed from the Antyodaya category. The District Supply Officer also carries out periodic inspections and takes necessary action. If a person is found to be above the Antyodaya category, removal proceedings are initiated. In both urban and rural areas, if a person’s name is to be removed from the Antyodaya category, a proposal is presented in an open meeting of the Gram Sabha. Once the proposal is approved, the concerned Gram Panchayat Development Officer removes the person from the records. After informing the District Supply Officer/Supply Inspector with a recommendation for further action, the department removes the individual from the Antyodaya category. If information is received from a third party, the department investigates the Antyodaya cardholder and, if the information is found to be correct, removes the cardholder from the Antyodaya category.
Procedure to add name to the Antyodaya category:
The applicant must first obtain an application form from the office of the Gram Panchayat Development Officer or the District Supply Officer. The application must include the family’s Aadhaar cards, photographs, phone number, bank account details, gas connection details, voter ID/PAN card, income certificate, electricity bill, and a copy of the resolution passed in the Gram Panchayat’s open meeting declaring the family as an Antyodaya family. The applicant must submit the application form along with all the required documents to the respective Gram Panchayat Development Officer. 
After verification, the officer adds the name to the records and forwards the case with a recommendation to the Food Supply Department for further action. Antyodaya ration cards are issued in each district based on the population targets set by the Government of India. A new ration card is issued only when a vacancy arises. The individual can obtain the ration card from the office of the District Supply Officer/Supply Inspector/Regional Food Officer within 10 days.
If no proposal has been submitted by the Gram Panchayat, the applicant must submit the application form in the prescribed format, along with the above documents, to the office of the Gram Panchayat Development Officer or District Supply Officer. Afterward, the Gram Panchayat Development Officer/District Supply Officer conducts verification, and if the applicant is found eligible and a vacancy exists, digitization is carried out.
documents_required:
Aadhaar cards of all family members
Recent passport-size photograph
Mobile phone number
Bank account details
Gas connection details
Voter ID card / PAN card
Income certificate
Electricity bill
Copy of the resolution passed in the Gram Panchayat's open meeting declaring the family under the Antyodaya category
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: National Food Security Scheme (Priority Households - White Ration Card) - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to ensure food security for economically vulnerable and priority households in Uttarakhand by providing them with a guaranteed monthly supply of food grains at subsidized rates. Under the scheme, the eligible households are entitled to 5 kg of food grains per person per month.
benefits:
Under the scheme, 5 kg of food grains per person per month are provided, including 2 kg of wheat at ₹2.00 per kg and 3 kg of rice at ₹3.00 per kg.
At present, from 1 January 2023, food grains are being distributed free of cost.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. A household/person is eligible under the scheme if they meet any of the following criteria:

 - A household with a monthly income of less than ₹15,000/- or not having an Antyodaya Ration Card.
 - A tribal household residing in a tribal or border area/widow/single woman/person suffering from an incurable disease/person with a disability/person aged 60 years or above, who is the head of the family, with a monthly income of less than ₹15,000/-.
 - A household whose total irrigated land, as per revenue records, is less than 2 hectares; or has less than 1 hectare irrigated and 2 hectares unirrigated; or has a total area of less than 4 hectares of unirrigated land.
 - A person engaged in occupations such as rickshaw pulling, porter work, labor, rag picking, cobbling, blacksmithing, carpentry, rural artisanal work, domestic service, or sanitation work.
 - A household that cultivates land belonging to another farmer.
 - A household residing in a slum or hut in an urban area, living in Uttarakhand since or before the date specified in the relevant Government Order.
 - A household whose annual income does not attract liability under the Income Tax Act.
 - A person who is homeless and separated from their social class, residing in organizations or ashrams such as widows’ ashrams, child reform homes, beggars’ homes, leprosy ashrams, orphanages, ashrams for the mentally ill or handicapped, or old age homes.

Eligible households or persons, once identified according to the above criteria, will be selected in ascending order based on the lowest number in the BPL list prepared from surveys conducted by the Rural Development Department for rural areas.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The applicant must first obtain an application form from the office of the Gram Panchayat Development Officer or the District Supply Officer. The application must include the family’s Aadhaar card, photograph, phone number, bank account details, gas connection, voter ID/PAN card, an income certificate showing income less than ₹15,000/-, electricity bill, the applicable eligibility certificate, and a declaration stating that the family is not holding an Antyodaya card. The applicant must submit the application form along with all the documents to the respective Gram Panchayat Development Officer. 
After verification, the officer adds the name to the records and forwards the case with a recommendation to the Food Supply Department for further action. The ration cards are issued in each district based on the population targets set by the Government of India. A new ration card is issued only when a vacancy arises. The individual can obtain the ration card from the office of the District Supply Officer/Supply Inspector/Regional Food Officer within 10 days.
If no proposal has been submitted by the Gram Panchayat, the applicant must submit the application form in the prescribed format, along with the above documents, to the office of the Gram Panchayat Development Officer or District Supply Officer. Afterward, the Gram Panchayat Development Officer/District Supply Officer conducts verification, and if the applicant is found eligible and a vacancy exists, digitization is carried out.

Phone number

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Entrepreneurship Development Scheme - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
description: The scheme aims to promote employment generation through entrepreneurship development in the small ruminants, poultry, piggery, and the fodder sectors by providing financial and institutional support to individuals and organized groups under the National Livestock Mission.

benefits: Under this scheme, employment generation is promoted through entrepreneurship development in the small ruminants, poultry, piggery, and the fodder sector.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission: Livestock Insurance Scheme - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
description: The scheme aims to provide insurance coverage to livestock in order to protect cattle rearers against the loss of their animals due to death, thereby encouraging them to adopt better animal husbandry practices.
benefits: Under this scheme, insurance coverage is provided for livestock to protect cattle rearers in the event of loss of their animals.
eligibility: 1. All livestock rearers residing in Uttarakhand are eligible to avail benefits under this scheme.

documents_required: Documents as specified under the scheme, in accordance with the requirements of government veterinary hospitals, are required to avail the benefits of the scheme.

scheme_name: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Residential Hostel
description: The scheme aims to provide free hostel facilities to children (both boys and girls) aged 6 to 18 years who are enrolled in nearby schools for formal education. In addition, children are provided with a monthly stipend of ₹200/-.
benefits:
• All children residing in the hostels are enrolled in nearby schools for formal education.
• All hostel facilities are provided free of cost.
• Children are also given a monthly stipend of ₹200/-.
eligibility:
Free hostel facilities are provided to boys and girls aged 6 to 18 years who:

 - Belong to BPL families or whose family's annual income is less than ₹55,000/-, or
 - Belong to SC/ST/OBC or minority communities, or
 - Have one or both parents deceased, or
 - Are children with disabilities, or
 - Are ragpickers, beggars, or from urban deprived and weaker sections.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Before the commencement of the academic session, the Hostel Warden, Block Education Officer, or District Project Officer conducts wide publicity and invites applications for the vacant hostel seats. The application form can be downloaded from the Samagra Shiksha website https://ssa.uk.gov.in/ or obtained from the hostel warden.
For orphan, begging, or ragpicking children, all necessary documents are prepared at the hostel level. For other children, the required documents include the child’s photograph, Aadhaar card, birth certificate, permanent residence certificate, caste certificate, mobile number, Aadhaar card of the parent or guardian, and BPL certificate or ration card in case of BPL families, or an annual income certificate up to ₹55,000/-.
All the above documents, along with the application form, can be submitted by the parents or guardians to the concerned hostel. Admission is granted by the management committee after reviewing all the parameters and based on the availability of seats in the hostel.

description: The scheme aims to ensure that all children aged 3 to 9 achieve foundational literacy and numeracy by creating an enabling learning environment across all schools in Uttarakhand.

eligibility:

description: The scheme aims to provide free uniforms to all girl students studying in Classes 1 to 8 of government and government-aided schools, as well as to all boys belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, and boys from the General category who fall under the BPL category.

description: The scheme aims to ensure accessible, affordable and quality healthcare services for all citizens of Uttarakhand by providing free diagnostic tests across government healthcare facilities.
department: Medical Health And Family Welfare Department
benefits: Free diagnostic tests are provided at district hospitals, sub-district hospitals, community health centres, urban primary health centres, and primary health centres. Under the scheme, a total of 266 tests are available completely free of charge.

 1. The beneficiary can avail free health check-ups after registering at any government hospital in the state.

Laboratories are available in the state’s district hospitals, sub-district hospitals, community health centres, urban primary health centres, and primary health centres. Patients visiting these healthcare facilities after the scheduled hours, as determined by the hospital’s CMS or Hospital In-charge, are provided free diagnostic tests by personnel from an empanelled or contracted firm.

Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana (MSBY) is an health insurance scheme by the state government of Uttarakhand. The scheme was launched in April 2015 and is now benefiting at least 48 Lakh families in the state. The government is providing a health insurance coverage upto Rs.30,000 to all the left out families not covered under Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana.

UPDATE: 2nd Phase of Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana Launching on 1st August

Objective of Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana

The main objective of the scheme is to improve the Affordability, Availability and Accessibility of quality health care services to every citizen of the state. The scheme has been started to cover all the families against the health spending leading to poverty. 

The scheme aims to broaden the access and availability of health care services and the presence of a large private health sector in the state for all the families.

Features of Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana

Effective and affordable family care to the entire population.

Over 790 medical procedures and diagnostic services covered under the scheme.

Extension of tertiary care to poor people of rural areas.

About 770 Government and Private hospitals empaneled to provide cashless treatment under MSBY.

Ensure access and quality of service to those with no influence or voice.

Protecting the poor from becoming poorer resulting from medical expenditure.

Freedom to choose from multiple Govt and private health service providers.

Involvement of community in rural health care for increasing accountability.

How to get Enrolled

Any citizen of the state can get enrolled under the scheme to take insurance benefits. The interested candidates can visit any nearest Enrollment Center. The district and block wise list of enrollment centers and contact details can be obtained from the link below:

Enrollment Centers List

Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana Card

Under the Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana, a Bio-Metric smart card is issued to each family. The smart card can be used at any of the empaneled hospitals for treatment. Health insurance benefits of Rs. 30,000 per family per annum on a family floater basis (upto 5 members) are being provided under the scheme.

Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana – Sample Card | IMG Source: ukhfws.org

The status of the balance in the card cane also be checked online at this link by entering the URN number.

The scheme covers hospitalization expenses for both surgical and non-surgical procedures. Around 1159 surgical procedures are covered under the scheme which needs hospitalization or which can be handled on a day care basis.

List of Procedures and Empaneled Hospitals

The scheme covers a total of more than 790 medical procedures and diagnostic services which are also covered under the Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana. The complete list of covered medical procedures can be obtained from the below link:

Medical Procedures List for 2016-17

There are more than 770 Government and private hospitals in the state providing cashless treatment under the Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana. The district wise list of the empaneled hospitals can be seen on official website of the scheme using the link below

List of Empaneled Hospitals

You can also sort the list by district, specialty or type of hospital.

Quick Facts and Figures

48,05,008 smart cards have been issued in the state so far (By 14 July 2016) under the scheme and 2,050,257 claims have been fulfilled by the government. There are total 772 empaneled hospitals in the list out of which 318 are public and 454 are private hospitals.

Helpline and Contacts

The citizens can contact toll free at 104 for any information or query regarding the scheme or can view the hospital helpdesk contact details at the link below:

http://rsbycg.nic.in/healthrsby/common/HelpdeskOperators.aspx

Contact Detail of Claim Handling Team of TPAs under RSBY MSBY Chhattisgarh is available here.

scheme_name: Old Age Pension Scheme - On Completion of 60 Years (UKBOCWWB)
description: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,000/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board who have attained the age of 60 years.
benefits: • Pension Amount: ₹1,000/- per month
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
 1. The applicant must have completed 60 years of age.
application_process:
[Online - via CSC]
The online application can be submitted through Shramik Suvidha Kendras.
During the application process, the applicant is required to provide the Shramik Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, a Self-Declaration Certificate, and an affidavit stating that no benefit from any other scheme is being availed. 
If the documents are found correct during departmental investigation/verification, the pension is sanctioned and disbursed on a half-yearly basis. 
After every six months, the worker must submit a life certificate to continue receiving the pension.
documents_required:
Labour Card
Aadhaar Card
Bank Passbook
A Self-Declaration Certificate
An affidavit stating that no benefit from any other scheme is being availed

scheme_name: Old Age Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand
description: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- is provided to senior citizens (both husband and wife) in the state who are 60 years of age or above and whose family’s monthly income is up to ₹4,000/- or who belong to the BPL category.
benefits: A pension of ₹1,500/- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be 60 years of age or above.
1. The applicant’s family monthly income must not exceed ₹4,000/- or the applicant must belong to the BPL category.
1. The applicant must not be receiving any other pension.
application_process:
Mode: Online. The applicant can apply online either by themselves or through a Common Service Center (CSC) via the Department’s Pension Portal (https://ssp.uk.gov.in), the UMANG Mobile App, or the Apuni Sarkar Portal (https://eservices.uk.gov.in).
The following documents are mandatory at the time of applying: Applicant’s mobile number, Passport-size photograph (attested by Gram Pradhan / V.P.D.O. / certified by Councillor), Photocopy of Aadhaar card and Voter ID card, CBS bank account details (linked/seeded with Aadhaar), Valid family income certificate or BPL certificate, Copy of family register (for rural areas only), Copy of the resolution passed in the open meeting of Gram Panchayat (for rural areas) / certified by Councillor (for urban areas)
All the above documents must be issued from the district where the application is being submitted.
For verification of the online application form in rural areas, the final decision is taken by the District Social Welfare Officer after recommendations from the Gram Panchayat Development Officer, Assistant Social Welfare Officer, and Block Development Officer, respectively. In urban areas, verification and recommendation are done by the Assistant Social Welfare Officer and Sub-District Magistrate. If the application is found correct, the District Social Welfare Officer approves it, after which the pension payment process is initiated.The pension is credited to the applicant’s bank account one month after the approval of the application.
documents_required:

Aadhaar card

Valid family income certificate or BPL certificate
Copy of family register (only for rural areas)

Note: All the above documents must be issued from the district where the application is submitted.

eligibility:

scheme_name: One-day Seminar on Vedic Mathematics
description: The scheme aims to provide a common platform for officers, teachers, and students from universities, colleges, schools, and other departments to actively participate and gain knowledge about the simplified curriculum of Vedic Mathematics and its easy-to-apply methods.
benefits: Participants of the seminar will gain knowledge about the simplified course of Vedic Mathematics and learn its easy and practical methods.
eligibility: 1. Officers, teachers, and students from universities, colleges, schools, and other departments are eligible to participate in the seminar.
application_process: Mode: Offline. After finalizing the date, time, and venue of the seminar, the convener will submit the list of invitees, who will then be formally invited through letters issued by the Academy Secretary.

scheme_name: One-time and Annual Financial Grant to Soldiers Awarded with Gallantry Medals
description: Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance/annuity is provided to serving or ex-servicemen who have been conferred with the “Gallantry Medal Award.” In the event of martyrdom or death of the soldier, the grant is extended to the eligible family members or dependents.
benefits:
• A one time grant of maximum of ₹50,00,000/- and minimum ₹4,00,000/- is given.
• Annual financial assistance of a maximum of ₹3,00,000/- and a minimum of ₹40,000/- is given.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant should be a serving soldier, an ex-serviceman, or in the event of martyrdom/death of the soldier, an eligible dependent.
 1. The soldier must have been conferred with a “Gallantry Medal Award.”
 1. In case of martyrdom or death of the soldier, the following dependents are eligible to apply:

 - Veer Nari (lifelong or until remarriage)
 - Son (up to 25 years of age) / Daughter (till marriage)
 - Parents
 - Unmarried sisters
 - Brother (up to 25 years of age)
application_process:
Mode: Offline. After obtaining the application form from the District Sainik Welfare Office, it must be submitted to the concerned office.
The following documents are required for the application: Aadhaar Card of the applicant, PAN Card, Photocopy of bank passbook and cancelled cheque, Identity card of the dependent (if the applicant is a dependent), Domicile certificate of Uttarakhand, Photocopy of the gazette notification regarding the award of the gallantry medal, Affidavit (on ₹10 stamp paper) declaring that the applicant has not received, and will not receive in the future, the one-time grant/annuity payable on the gallantry medal from any other state, Photocopy of discharge book (if the applicant is an ex-serviceman)
After verification of the applications at the District Sainik Welfare Office level, eligible applicants are paid the approved amount through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Under this, the one-time grant is disbursed immediately, while the annuity amount is released annually.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card of the applicant
PAN Card

scheme_name: One-Time Grant Money to Soldiers Conferred with Vishisht Seva Medal Award
description: Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance/grant ranging from a minimum of ₹75,000/- to a maximum of ₹2,00,000/- is provided to serving soldiers and ex-servicemen of the state who have been conferred with the ‘Vishisht Seva Medal Award’.
benefits: • A one-time grant ranging from a minimum of ₹75,000/- to a maximum of ₹2,00,000/- is given to serving soldiers and ex-servicemen of the state.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be a serving soldier or an ex-serviceman of the state who has been conferred with the 'Vishisht Seva Medal Award'.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. After obtaining the application form from the District Sainik Welfare Office, it must be submitted to the concerned office.
The following documents are required for the application: Aadhaar Card of the applicant, PAN Card, Photocopy of bank passbook and cancelled cheque, Identity card of the dependent (if the applicant is a dependent), Domicile certificate of Uttarakhand, Affidavit (on ₹10/- stamp paper) declaring that the applicant has not received, and will not receive in the future, the one-time grant/annuity payable on the gallantry medal from any other state, Photocopy of discharge book (if the applicant is an ex-serviceman), a photocopy of the Gazette Notification regarding conferment of 'Vishisht Seva Medal Award'
After verification of the applications at the District Sainik Welfare Office level, eligible applicants are paid the approved amount through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Under this, the one-time grant is disbursed immediately, while the annuity amount is released annually.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card of the applicant
PAN Card
Photocopy of bank passbook and cancelled cheque
Identity card of the dependent (if the applicant is a dependent)
Domicile certificate of Uttarakhand
Affidavit (on ₹10 stamp paper) declaring that the applicant has not received, and will not receive in the future, the one-time grant/annuity payable on the gallantry medal from any other state
Photocopy of discharge book (if the applicant is an ex-serviceman)
A copy of the Gazette Notification regarding conferment of 'Vishisht Seva Medal Award'

scheme_name: Operation of Paragliding Activities
description: The scheme aims to promote safe, regulated, and professional paragliding activities in Uttarakhand by permitting certified paragliding companies and licensed tandem pilots to operate within the state.
benefits: Paragliding companies are permitted to operate, and tandem pilot licenses have been issued, allowing license holders to earn a livelihood through paragliding activities in the state.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand for at least ten years or a native of the state.
1. The applicant should possess advanced practical and technical knowledge of aero sports.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. (1) Applications are submitted by applicants desirous of participating in paragliding activities between 16th July and 30th August every year.
1. For running the firm:
Prescribed application form.
Valid registration under the Firm Societies Act.
Uttarakhand Travel Business Registration Certificate.
Insurance of the firm.
Details of the staff working in the firm.
Tandem Joy Rides Package Fare (Tariff Card).
Description of paragliding equipment.
Application fee as per rules: ₹1,000/-.
2. For Tandem Pilot:
The tandem pilot must have covered a minimum air distance of 35 km, and the name of the tandem pilot must be recorded in the digital flight log.
The applicant must have logged a minimum of 100 hours of flying time, with their name recorded in the digital log for these flights.
The tandem pilot should have advanced practical knowledge of aero sports, which will be tested by the Technical Committee through a practical test.
Tandem pilots must be medically fit, hold appropriate medical certificates, and have valid First Aid and CPR certification, subject to annual medical examination.
The operator must have valid circular party insurance covering paragliding.
The tandem pilot must have completed the SIV (Simulation in Flight) Tandem Paragliding Safety Course.
(2) After submission, applications are scrutinized by the Department and then placed before the Technical Committee for evaluation.
(3) After the recommendation of the Technical Committee, the Chief Executive Officer, Uttarakhand Tourism Development Council, shall issue the permission.
documents_required:
For running the firm:
Prescribed application form
Valid registration under the Firm Societies Act
Uttarakhand Travel Business Registration Certificate
Insurance of the firm
Details of the staff working in the firm
Tandem Joy Rides Package Fare (Tariff Card)
Description of paragliding equipment
Application fee as per rules: ₹1000/-
For Tandem Pilot:
Proof of minimum air distance covered (35 km) with the pilot’s name recorded.
Proof of minimum 100 hours of logged flying time with the pilot’s name in the digital log.
Certificate of advanced practical knowledge in aero sports (if available).
Proof of completion of SIV (Simulation in Flight) Tandem Paragliding Safety Course.
Medical fitness certificate from a recognized doctor.
Valid First Aid and CPR certification.
Proof of valid circular party insurance covering paragliding operations.
Certificate or report issued by the Technical Committee confirming successful completion of the practical test.

scheme_name: Operation of River Rafting / Kayaking Activities
description: The scheme aims to promote safe & regulated adventure tourism in the state by allowing licensed rafting companies to operate & issuing certifications to qualified river guides. Under this scheme, rafting companies are granted permission to operate, and licenses are issued to qualified river guides.
benefits: Rafting companies are permitted to operate, and licenses are issued to river guides, providing revenue benefits to the state and economic benefits to tourism businesses.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand for at least ten years or a native of the state.
1. The applicant should possess advanced practical and technical knowledge of aero sports.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. (1) Applicants seeking permission for River Rafting/Kayaking can apply between 1st July and 31st July for the River Ganga, and throughout the year for other rivers.
1. For running the firm:
Application letter
Prescribed application form
Insurance of the firm
Valid registration under the Firms/Societies Act
Uttarakhand Travel Business Registration Certificate
Three years of experience in adventure activities
Details of the staff working in the firm
Details of rafts/kayaks/safety equipment
Application fee as per rules: Rs. 1000/-
2. For River Guide:
Be in good health
Age should be between 18 and 50 years
Minimum educational qualification: Must have passed 10th (High School) class
Be capable of swimming
Every guide must hold a valid First Aid Certification issued by Red Cross, St. John's Ambulance, or other recognized organizations
(1) After due scrutiny of the applications by the Department, they are placed before the Technical Committee.
(2) After inspection by the Technical Committee, all applicants are informed about the permission, along with reasons, by the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board within a maximum period of 45 days.
documents_required:
For Rafting/Kayaking Firm Operation:
Application Letter
Prescribed Application Form
Insurance Certificate of the Firm
Valid Registration Certificate under the Firms Societies Act
Uttarakhand Travel Business Registration Certificate
Proof of Three Years’ Experience in Adventure Activities
Details of the Firm’s Working Staff
Details of Rafts/Kayaks/Safety Equipment
Application Fee Receipt (₹1000/-)
For River Guide License:
Medical Fitness Certificate (proving complete health)
Proof of Age (18–50 years)
Educational Qualification Certificate (Class 10 Pass)
Swimming Capability Proof (self-declaration or training certificate if applicable)
Valid First Aid Certification (from Red Cross/St John’s Ambulance/other recognised institutions)

scheme_name: Operation/implementation of Vidhik Seva Rath
description: The scheme aims to spread legal awareness and provide information about welfare schemes to people in both urban and remote rural areas, ensuring that citizens are informed about their rights and available government benefits.
benefits:
• Under the public awareness programme, the mobile van of the State Legal Services Authority, "Vidhik Seva Rath", is sent to visit every urban area and remote rural areas of two to three districts every month and various welfare schemes run by the central and state government are shown through films. 
 - The book "Saral Kanooni Gyan Mala" published on various subjects is distributed free of cost.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. All residents of the areas visited by the van can benefit from these programs. The team members assigned to the tour inform the public about the schemes using a projector installed in the "Vidhik Seva Rath".
application_process:
Mode: Offline. When the Vidhik Seva Rath visits an area, relevant information can be obtained, and for receiving books, the name, address/telephone/mobile number, and signature of the concerned person are recorded in the book distribution register. The books are provided free of cost.
Information about the arrival of the Vidhik Seva Rath in your area is shared through paralegal volunteers, whose names, mobile numbers, and other details are available on the Uttarakhand State Legal Services Authority website: www.slsa.uk.gov.in.
If any person, woman, or child is in urgent need of the books mentioned above, they can obtain them by submitting a written request to the District Authority's office at the district headquarters. No documents or identity cards are required for this purpose.
documents_required: To avail of the benefits, the individual should provide details such as the Name of the Applicant, Address, Mobile Number, and Signature.

scheme_name: Organisation of Cultural Programs
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to cultural groups and artists registered with the Department for performing in cultural programs organized during traditional fairs, festivals, regional celebrations within and outside the state, as well as on the occasion of national festivals.
benefits:
After the presentation of cultural programmes by groups/folk singers enlisted with the Culture Department on the occasion of traditional fairs, festivals, celebrations, and national festivals organized within or outside the state, the following honorarium and allowances are payable:

 1. Group Leader: Honorarium of ₹1,000/- and travelling allowance of ₹500/-.
 1. Other Artists: Honorarium of ₹800/- each and travelling allowance of ₹400/- each.
 1. Folk Singers:

• Category A: ₹7,500/- as honorarium.
• Category B: ₹4,250/- as honorarium.
• Travelling allowance: ₹300/- along with ordinary bus fare or second-class rail fare for the journey.
eligibility: • The applicant must be a cultural group or an artist registered with the Department of Culture, Uttarakhand.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The Directorate of Culture conducts auditions periodically to shortlist cultural groups and artists. 
For the selection of a cultural group, the following documents are required: the organization’s registration certificate, a copy of its bylaws, details and number of the group’s artists, and a certificate confirming that the members are natives or permanent residents of Uttarakhand. 
At present, the department has a total of 267 cultural groups and 226 solo artists on its list.
documents_required:
Registration certificate of the organization
Copy of the organization’s bylaws
Details and total number of artists in the group
Certificate of being a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand (for the artists)

scheme_name: Organising Sports Competitions and Training Camps
description: The scheme aims to promote sports at the grassroots levels by providing structured training, organizing competitions & nurturing sporting talent. Training is conducted through local camps in all districts for various sports, including football, athletics, boxing, volleyball, etc. with minimal fees.
benefits:
• The department conducts local training camps in all districts for various sports, including football, athletics, boxing, volleyball, hockey, badminton, cricket, wrestling, kho-kho, karate, kabaddi, wushu, taekwondo, basketball, handball, ju-jitsu, table tennis, lawn tennis, baseball, and sepaktakraw, with training provided at minimal fees.
 - The department operates Sports Colleges and Sports Hostels for sports such as football, athletics, boxing, volleyball, hockey, badminton, judo, and cricket, with admission provided at minimal fees.
 - A prize of ₹ 500/- is awarded for securing first position and ₹ 300/- for securing third position in state-level sports competitions.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a player aged 8 to 16 years.
1. In the case of amateur players, the applicant must be above 16 years of age.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To conduct local training camps in all districts, the District Sports Officer’s office issues a notice in daily newspapers in March to publicize the district-level camps. Applications are received offline and must be submitted to the District Sports Officer’s office. Selection trials are conducted annually in April and May.
For admission to Sports Colleges and Sports Hostels, preliminary selection trials are held at the district level. Successful candidates then undergo final trials at the state level, and admissions are granted against vacant seats based on the merit list.
Direct paid admission is available for local training camps conducted at the district level and for amateur players.
documents_required:
Proof of age 
Residence Certificate
Other relevant document as required

scheme_name: Organization of Multi-Purpose Camps/ Public Awareness Camps/ Medical Camps/Legal Service Camps
description: The scheme aims to organize camps & awareness programs across urban & rural areas to inform and empower vulnerable groups such as women, children, senior citizens, workers in the unorganized sector, persons with disabilities, acid attack survivors & victims of trafficking about their legal rights.
benefits: For the effective implementation of public welfare schemes of the Hon’ble National Legal Services Authority (NALSA), New Delhi, the District Legal Services Authorities, Tehsil Legal Services Committees, and the Uttarakhand State Legal Services Authority also organize multi-purpose camps, awareness programs, debate competitions, painting competitions, and essay competitions across urban areas and remote rural regions.
eligibility:
1. Individuals, women, and children from all walks of life particularly workers in the unorganized sector, persons with mental illness or disabilities, acid attack survivors, senior citizens, and victims of trafficking and commercial sexual exploitation are provided information about their legal rights.
 1. Multi-purpose camps are also organized to support the effective implementation of poverty alleviation schemes.
 1. These camps are conducted in the presence of representatives from all departments.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Before organizing any awareness camp or medical camp, the District Legal Services Authorities publicize the event through daily newspapers and inform public representatives and village panchayat-level officers of the concerned area so that local residents can avail the benefits of the multi-purpose or public awareness camps. 
Participation in these camps is completely free, and underprivileged individuals in need of certificates, medical examinations, or legal aid can obtain them at these camps. 
Updates regarding upcoming camps are also available on https://slsa.uk.gov.in.
documents_required: The documents required for legal aid depend on the type of assistance sought, and applicants must submit all relevant documents as specified for their case.

scheme_name: Organization of Sports Competitions and Training Programs
description: The scheme aims to promote sports & identify grassroots-level talent among youth through structured competitions & training. Players are provided with cash prizes and free training, & participation is encouraged at multiple levels, including Gram Panchayat, Development Block, District, and State.
department: Department of Youth Welfare and Provincial Protection Corps
benefits:
• Organizing Khel Mahakumbh Competitions – Various sports competitions are organized for the age groups Under-14, Under-17, and Under-21.
 - Prizes are awarded for first, second, and third places as follows:

Sl. No.Level1st Rank (Cash Prize ₹)2nd Rank (Cash Prize ₹)3rd Rank (Cash Prize ₹)1Gram Panchayat₹300/-₹200/-₹150/-2Block Development ₹500/-₹400/-₹300/-3District Level₹800/-₹600/-₹400/-4State Level₹1,500/-₹1,000/-₹700/-
 - During the competitions, talented players who perform best at the Block Development levels and District levels are identified by the department and provided free training prior to state-level participation.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a youth (boy or girl).
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The Khel Mahakumbh is usually held between October and December. Newspapers provide information about the competitions at the Gram Panchayat/Nyaya Panchayat level, and interested participants are invited to take part through forms distributed by government schools, the Youth Welfare Department, and the Sports Department.
To participate, players must possess a photo identity card or birth certificate, a bank account, a permanent residence certificate, and a passport-size photograph. With these documents, players can compete in the Khel Mahakumbh at the village or Nyaya Panchayat level. 
Players securing first, second, and third positions at this level advance to the Block Development level. Similarly, the top three players at the Block Development level proceed to the District level, and the top three at the District level qualify for the State level competition.
documents_required:
Photo identity card
Birth Certificate
Bank Account Details
Permanent Residence Certificate
Passport-size Photograph

scheme_name: Organization of Various Conclaves and Felicitations to Encourage Women, Women Scientists, Teachers and Young Students
description: The scheme aims to promote and enhance scientific attitude and skill development of women, women scientists, teachers, and young students of the state by organizing conclaves and felicitating them.
benefits:
Under this scheme, to promote and enhance scientific attitude and skill development among students, teachers, and women of the state, the following conclaves are organized and felicitations are given:

 - Yuva-Bal Samagam: Medhavi Chhatra Samman
 - Teacher/Science Conclave: Vigyan Prasar Samman
 - Woman Scientists Conclave: Utkrisht Yuva Mahila Vaigyanik Samman
 - Mahila Prayogdharmi Samman
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand state. 
1. The applicant must be a student, teacher, woman, and the general public.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. USERC organizes district-wise Bal Yuva Samagams. The top five meritorious students from each district, who achieve the highest marks in High School/12th Grade under the Uttarakhand Board, are honored. The merit list is provided by the District Education Officer of the respective district.
The Science Teachers' Conclave honors Uttarakhand’s science teachers and science-oriented educators with the Vigyan Prasar Samman to encourage and promote the exchange of ideas. Applications are invited from teachers across the state for the award, and advertisements are also published in newspapers.
USERC organizes the Women Scientists Conclave and the Utkrisht Yuva Mahila Vaigyaanik Samman Programme every year to encourage women scientists. Applications are invited from women scientists across the state, and advertisements are published in newspapers.
To identify and encourage women making exemplary contributions to the integration of science in the state, they are honored with the Mahila Prayogdharmi Samman on the occasion of International Women’s Day.
documents_required: Documents are required as per the Uttarakhand Science Education and Research Centre (USERC) guidelines in accordance with the honor/award.

scheme_name: Other Backward Caste Dashamottar Scholarship Scheme (Starting from Class 11) - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to support Other Backward Class (OBC) students of Uttarakhand from Class 11th onwards by providing financial assistance for their education, including tuition fees and other academic expenses.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must belong to the Other Backward Class (OBC) category.
 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized school/educational institution in Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 11 or higher level course.
 1. The applicant must possess valid documents, such as Caste Certificate, Residence Certificate, Bank Passbook, Aadhaar Card, Photograph, Educational Qualification Certificates, and Income Certificate.
 1. The total annual income of the parents/guardians from all sources must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh.
 1. The scholarship will be available for one year only for studying in any class.
 1. The applicant must have a counselling certificate.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Students apply online on the Government of India’s National Scholarship Portal (NSP) (https://scholarships.gov.in). 
The following documents must be uploaded with the application: Caste Certificate, Residence Certificate, Bank Passbook, Aadhaar, Photograph, Educational Qualification Certificates, and Income Certificate.
The student submits the application to their educational institution using their own ID. The concerned educational institution forwards the received online application to the District Social Welfare Officer. The District Social Welfare Officer examines the received applications and conducts physical verification of the complete applications. Incomplete applications that can be corrected are temporarily marked as defective, while those that cannot be corrected are permanently rejected. The eligible applicants receive the scholarship amount directly in their bank accounts, subject to the availability of funds.
Procedure:
Step 1: The student registers and submits the application form online.
Step 2: The educational institution verifies the submitted applications.
Step 3: Physical verification of the students is conducted by the Social Welfare Department (DSWO) and/or a third-party agency appointed by the government.
Step 4: Online verification is completed at the Social Welfare Department (DSWO) level.
Step 5: The scholarship amount is disbursed to the students whose applications are fully verified, through the PFMS (Public Financial Management System).
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Photograph
Caste Certificate
Residence Certificate
Bank Passbook
Educational Qualification Documents
Income Certificate
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Out of Turn Employment to Sportspersons in State Services
description: The scheme aims to provide job opportunities to medal-winning sportspersons of Uttarakhand, who have represented the state in international and national games, by offering them out-of-turn employment in various state services.
benefits: Under this scheme, medal-winning players from Uttarakhand who have represented the state in International or National Games are provided out-of-turn employment on Gazetted and Non-Gazetted posts (from Level-3 to Level-10) across various government departments.
eligibility:
1. State players/sportspersons who have won gold, silver, or bronze medals in international or national games, such as the Olympic/Paralympic Games, World Cup/World Championship, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, Asian Championship, Commonwealth Championship, SAF Games, and National Games, are eligible under the scheme.
 1. Players/sportspersons participating in any of the following sports will be considered eligible: Athletics, Archery, Badminton, Basketball, Boxing, Canoeing & Kayaking, Cycling, Diving, Equestrian, Fencing, Football, Golf, Handball, Hockey, Judo, Lawn Tennis, Shooting, Rowing, Sailing, Swimming, Table Tennis, Taekwondo, Volleyball, Weightlifting, Wrestling, Baseball, Chess, Cricket, Kabaddi, Karate, Kho-Kho, and Mallakhamb.
 1. The player/sportsperson must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The player/sportsperson must have represented the state of Uttarakhand in the National Games in the year and competition for which they are applying for employment.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. As outlined in Government Order No. 728/VI-3/2023-33(7)2014, dated 14.09.2023, the Sports Directorate will receive vacancy details from the relevant departments and publish advertisements in newspapers to recruit eligible athletes. Upon receiving applications directly from the Director, Sports Directorate, the committee will review the applications and submit its recommendations within two months.
The Sports Department will forward the committee’s recommendations to the respective departments. Selected medal-winning athletes will be appointed to supernumerary positions by the relevant department within four months.
For employment, athletes must possess the minimum educational qualifications required for the position. However, the committee may consider granting exemptions or relaxations for medal-winning athletes regarding mandatory or preferred qualifications. If a medal winner does not possess the required educational qualifications at the time of appointment, the department will allow the athlete up to four years to acquire the necessary qualifications.
Medal-winning athletes must submit their applications to the sports offices within two years (for seniors) and three years (for juniors) after achieving their success. Applications must include the completed form along with the medal-winning certificates, Aadhaar card, and permanent residence certificate.
Medal-winning athletes from 10 years ago and 5 years ago will be eligible to apply within 12 months from the date of issuance of this Government Order.
documents_required:
Medal Winning Certificate
Aadhaar Card
Residence Certificate
Educational Certificate
Note: All the certificates should be self-attested.

scheme_name: P1, P2, P3, P4, SIV, Guided Flying
description: The aim of the scheme is to train and develop skilled youth of Uttarakhand, aged between 18 to 30 years, who are educated, mentally, and physically fit, to become professional paragliding pilots and instructors.
benefits:
Beneficiaries can work in firms operating as:

• Tandem Pilots
• Instructors
• Competitors
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be between 18 to 30 years of age.
1. The applicant must be educated.
1. The applicant must be mentally and physically healthy.

> The total number of 215 beneficiaries will be selected.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The prescribed application form must be duly filled out and submitted along with all required documents to the office of the District Tourism Development Officer.
After the completion of the selection tests, the District Tourism Development Officer forwards the list of selected applicants to the headquarters for further processing.
documents_required: Applicants are required to submit the necessary documents in accordance with the guidelines specified by the department.

scheme_name: Paalna Ghar (Crèche)
description: The scheme aims to provide day care facilities for children aged 6 months to 6 years of working couples at a nominal monthly fee in Crèches.
department: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
benefits:
Under the scheme, a crèche is run for the children of working couples, providing day care facilities for children in the age group of 6 months to 6 years.
The following fees are applicable under the scheme:

 - For BPL families: ₹20/- per child per month
 - For families with an income less than ₹12,000/-: ₹100/- per child per month
 - For families with an income above ₹12,000/-: ₹200/- per child per month
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The beneficiary must be a child aged between 6 months and 6 years.
application_process: Mode: Offline. A crèche is established in every district of Uttarakhand. Working couples can avail of the benefits by paying the applicable fee.
documents_required:
Proof of age of the child
Income proof of the child’s parents/guardians
Any other documents as may be required

scheme_name: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Vigyaan Gram Sankul Pariyojana
description: The project aims to promote sustainable rural development through the application of science & technology to enhance livelihoods in selected villages throughout Uttarakhand. Under the project, rural development initiatives are implemented through the formation of village clusters across the state.
benefits:
• Under the project, rural development work is carried out by forming clusters of villages across various districts of the state. 
 - Based on the natural resources available in the selected villages, various units are established to improve farmers' livelihoods through the application of science and technology.
eligibility: 1. The beneficiaries of the project include selected farmers, entrepreneurs, self-help groups, and general public residing in Uttarakhand.
application_process: Mode: Offline. The project is being implemented through the formation of Gramodaya Cooperative Societies, with experienced farmers selected from the chosen clusters.
documents_required: Documents are required to be submitted as per the guidelines of the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology (UCOST).

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Educational Excellence Award
description: The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among schools & students by providing cash awards to the best-performing schools at the high school & intermediate levels at the state level, as well as to students securing top positions in Uttarakhand Board High School & Intermediate Examinations.
benefits:
> For Schools:

The 3 schools giving the best results at the state level are awarded prizes of:

• ₹10,00,000/-, ₹5,00,000/-, and ₹3,00,000/- at the Intermediate level.
• ₹8,00,000/-, ₹4,00,000/-, and ₹2,00,000/- at the High School level.

> For Students (Intermediate Level):

• Students securing 1st, 2nd, and 3rd positions: ₹21,000/-, ₹15,000/-, and ₹11,000/- respectively.
• Students securing 4th to 10th positions: ₹5,100/- each.

> For Students (High School Level):

• Students securing 1st, 2nd, and 3rd positions: ₹15,000/-, ₹11,000/-, and ₹8,000/- respectively.
• Students securing 4th to 10th positions: ₹5,100/- each.
eligibility:
> For School:

 1. The applicant school must be among the 3 best-performing schools at the Uttarakhand Board high school or intermediate level school at the state level.

> For Student:

 1. The applicant student must be among the top 10 rank holders in the Uttarakhand Board Council Examination at High School or Intermediate level examination.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The Secondary Education Department, Uttarakhand, receives the list from the Board after the examination results are declared. After obtaining approval from the competent authority for the amount to be awarded to high school and intermediate students securing top 10 positions in the Board examinations, the list is forwarded to the Chief Education Officer.
The concerned Chief Education Officer issues drafts to the respective schools according to the number of eligible students. The schools then provide these to the students directly or, in some cases, distribute the funds through award ceremonies. 
Under this scheme, students are not required to submit any application.
documents_required: No documents are required from the applicant.

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to promote & support organic farming among farmers in Uttarakhand. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹9,000/- per hectare to farmers for the purchase of organic inputs, including seeds, compost, green manure, biofertilizers, biopesticides, neem oil, etc.
benefits: This scheme promotes organic farming by providing farmers with an incentive of ₹9,000/- per hectare for purchasing organic inputs such as seeds, compost, green manure, biofertilizers, biopesticides, neem oil, PROM, Burmese compost, waste decomposers, and other materials required for organic farming.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a native of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a farmer.
1. The farmer must own agricultural land within the state.
1. The farmer’s name must be recorded in the land revenue records.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To avail the benefits of this scheme, farmers are selected through open meetings of the Gram Sabhas in the presence of departmental officers and Hon’ble public representatives. 
The farmer can submit a proposal during the Gram Panchayat meeting, and if the proposal is approved, the public representative informs the department. After departmental scrutiny and once the farmer purchases organic inputs such as fertilizers and seeds from the Krishi Nivesh Kendras, the financial assistance is provided. 
To receive the benefit, farmers must submit a permanent/original residence certificate, identity card, Aadhaar card, mobile number, ration card, birth certificate, Khasra/Khatauni of agricultural land, and a passport-size photograph along with the proposal.

Mode: Online. Farmers can apply online at https://pgsindia-ncof.gov.in. 
The farmer needs to submit all necessary documents during the online application. After the farmer makes the required investment in organic inputs, the subsidy amount is directly credited to their bank account.
documents_required:
Permanent/original residence certificate
Identity card
Aadhaar card
Mobile number
Ration card
Birth certificate
Khasra/Khatauni of agricultural land
Passport-size photograph
All documents to be submitted along with the proposal.

scheme_name: Payment of Ex-Gratia Amount on Death of the UPNL Employee During Service
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- to the legal dependents of deceased UPNL employees in the event of the employee’s death during their service period.
benefits: A one-time ex-gratia payment of ₹1,00,000/- shall be made from the UPNL fund to the family/legal dependents of a UPNL employee in the event of the employee’s death during the service period.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a legal dependent of the deceased UPNL employee.
1. The deceased employee must have been a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must have been nominated during the service period of the deceased employee to receive the ex-gratia amount.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. In the event of the death of a UPNL employee during service, the legal dependent must submit the application form to the UPNL Headquarter Office at the earliest, along with the following documents:
Death certificate of the employee
Service certificate from the department of the deceased employee, as per the enclosed format
Aadhaar card of the dependent
Bank account details of the dependent (photocopy of passbook)
Photograph of the dependent
Copy of Aadhaar card of family members along with a certified copy of the family register

eligibility:

application_process:

An identified list of agitators has already been released. Those who were left out will be eligible to receive the benefits of the scheme only after their respective identity card is issued.
