A./2006.08 dated 22.10.2008, read with Government Order Number 1192/Twenty.4/2017-3 (13)/2011 dated 01.12.2017. scheme_name: Pension Scheme for Craftsmen
description: The scheme aims to provide financial support and social security to traditional artisans of Uttarakhand who are aged 60 years or above and belong to families living below the poverty line.
benefits: Under this scheme, craftsmen aged 60 years or above who are already receiving an old age pension are provided with an additional incentive of ₹400/- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be an artisan/craftsman aged 60 years or above.
 1. The applicant must be already receiving an old age pension from the government.
 1. The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
 1. If the son or grandson of the artisan is 20 years of age or above and the family still lives below the poverty line, the applicant remains eligible.
 1. The applicant must be engaged in traditional handicrafts such as stone, wood, iron, lamp, ringal, bamboo, and product development from natural fibres, or in any other crafts approved by the government from time to time.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Application forms can be obtained from the office of the General Manager, District Industries Centre, or downloaded from the departmental website https://doi.uk.org.
Along with the application form, applicants must submit the following documents to the General Manager, District Industries Centre of the concerned district: Aadhaar card, bank account details, proof of receiving old age pension, BPL certificate, birth certificate/Aadhaar as proof of date of birth, a certified copy of the family register to define the family, and a certificate confirming the applicant’s status as a craftsman.
Selection Process: 
The documents of eligible artisans are verified by a committee constituted under the chairmanship of the General Manager, District Industries Centre. Based on this verification, the eligible applicants are selected for the pension.
After selection, the additional incentive pension is disbursed quarterly into the artisan’s bank or post office account.

Proof of receiving old age pension

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for Elderly, Destitute Artists, Litterateurs and Writers of Uttarakhand State
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to elderly and impoverished artists, litterateurs and writers who have dedicated their lives to the development of art, culture, and literature and have made significant and distinguished contributions.
benefits: The department provides a monthly pension of ₹3,000/- to the beneficiaries under this scheme.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be an elderly, destitute artist, litterateur, or writer from Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must have dedicated their life to the development of art, culture, and literature.
1. The applicant must have made significant and distinguished contributions in their field.
1. The applicant must be at least 60 years of age.
1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
application_process:
Mode: Online. To avail the benefits under the pension scheme, applicants can register and apply through the “Apuni Sarkar Uttarakhand” portal available at https://eservices.uk.gov.in. Along with the application form, the eligible applicant must submit complete details of themselves and their family, along with necessary documents such as Aadhaar card, permanent residence certificate of Uttarakhand, PAN card, bank account details, educational qualification certificate, caste certificate, birth certificate or age certificate issued by a medical officer, a certificate related to artist/litterateur/writer issued by a government, semi-government, non-government or other recognized institution, a certificate of being an artist, and a recommendation from the district administration.
The process is considered complete only after these documents are uploaded on the portal by signing up at the "Apuni Sarkar Uttarakhand” Portal, https://eservices.uk.gov.in. After the submission, the applications are scrutinized by the Director General/Director and then presented before a committee constituted under the chairmanship of the Secretary/Principal Secretary. The committee verifies the submitted documents and calls the concerned artist for an interview. If found eligible during the interview and document verification, the pension is recommended. Subsequently, the Directorate of Culture disburses the approved pension amount to the artist every month. 
In the event of the death of an artist or litterateur, the monthly pension is transferred to their spouse as a dependent. At present, the Directorate of Culture is providing monthly pension benefits to a total of 123 elderly and indigent artists.

scheme_name: Personal Accident Assistance Scheme
description: The scheme aims to provide financial support and compensation to farmers, agricultural laborers, and Mandi laborers in Uttarakhand who suffer injury or death due to accidents while engaged in agricultural work or operating agricultural equipment.
benefits: Under the Mandi Act of Uttarakhand, farmers, agricultural labourers, and Mandi labourers working in Mandi areas regulated by the state, who are engaged in agricultural activities or the operation of agricultural equipment such as power equipment, digging or deepening wells and ponds for irrigation, using tractors for threshing or transporting produce, or performing other fieldwork are covered under the scheme operated by the Mandi Marketing Board through Mandi Committees. In case of physical injury or death resulting from an accident, the scheme provides them with compensation.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age to be eligible to claim compensation.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. For the above-mentioned accident, the affected farmer/laborer must report it to the local market committee or district officer as soon as possible, and in any case, within 45 days. Upon receiving the accident report, an investigation will be conducted by the individual or a market committee employee within a maximum of 15 days.
In the event of the death of the victim, in addition to their legal representative or heir, the claim form must be signed by two close relatives as witnesses for verification. If the claim application is verified by the village head or two members of the Panchayat, all entries, signatures, thumb impressions, or severed handprints must be certified or verified by the secretary, chairman, or administrator of the concerned market committee.
In the case of accidental death, a death certificate, postmortem report, or panchnama prepared by a doctor at the primary health center or district hospital must be submitted. In special circumstances, a panchnama for cremation must also be provided.
In the case of an accident, it is mandatory to attach a medical certificate, two color photographs (postcard size) of the severed or damaged body parts, and a certificate attested by two close relatives.
The claim form must be completely filled out. The market committee must also confirm the accident and attach a comprehensive investigation report.
The claim form must be completed and signed by the applicant, including the left or right thumb impression. If the left thumb is missing, the right thumb impression may be used. If both thumbs are missing, the fingerprint of the working hand may be used. If both hands are missing, the fingerprint of the front of the missing hand must be used. This applies to both men and women.
After scrutiny by the Secretary of the Market Committee, the entire claim form, along with their recommendation, will be sent to the Chairman or Administrator for approval and sanction of payment. As mentioned at the end of the claim form, before accepting the claim, the Chairman/Administrator will have it scrutinized by Revenue Department officials. The claim will be approved within one month wherever possible; however, in special circumstances, the Chairman/Administrator may extend this period. After approval, the Chairman/Administrator will send the claim form to the Managing Director of the Uttarakhand Agricultural Produce Marketing Board for payment. The Mandi Board will then prepare a draft of the claim amount in the name of the claimant and send it to the concerned Mandi Secretary for disbursement.
documents_required:
Accident Report
Claim Form – Fully completed and signed by the applicant, including thumb/fingerprint impression as applicable
Certification by Authorities – If verified by village head or Panchayat members, all entries/signatures/thumb impressions must be certified by the Secretary/Chairman/Administrator of the concerned market committee
Death Certificate (In the event of accidental death)
Postmortem Report/Panchnama – Prepared by a doctor at the primary health center or district hospital
Panchnama for Cremation, if applicable
Medical Certificate (For injury or accident claims)
Two color photographs (postcard size)
Investigation Report – Prepared and attached by the Market Committee confirming the accident
Other documents as required

scheme_name: Policy for Establishment of Private Industrial Estates/Areas - 2023
description: The scheme aims to promote and facilitate the development of private industrial estates and areas in Uttarakhand by providing financial incentives, infrastructure support, and a streamlined regulatory framework.
benefits: • Capital Subsidy on Infrastructure: ₹10 lakh per acre. - Subsidy for Setting Up CETP: 40% of the cost, up to a maximum of ₹1 crore. - Assistance for External Infrastructure Development: 2% of the total fixed capital investment made by the private promoter on the fixed assets created for the industrial establishment, per park/area, will be payable.
eligibility:
1. Any individual, founder, developer, partnership firm, LLP, company, or institution legally registered under the Companies Act, Societies Act, or Limited Liability Partnership Act, as well as entities operating in Joint Venture or Public-Private Partnership (PPP) mode, or as a Land Aggregator (with written consent of all concerned landowners), shall be eligible to apply for setting up a Private Industrial Estate/Area.
 1. For establishing a private industrial estate/area/park, it is mandatory to have at least 30 acres of land in plain areas and at least 2 acres in hilly areas.
 1. The promoter/investor must arrange the required land from their own sources for setting up the industrial estate/area.
 1. In cases where land is aggregated through land aggregators, SIDCUL will enter into an agreement with the promoter/land aggregator to ensure fulfillment of financial obligations under the policy.
 1. If a minimum of 80% of the land is acquired or aggregated by the private industrial estate/park developer, and there is an obstacle in acquiring the remaining land, SIIDCUL (State Infrastructure and Industrial Development Corporation of Uttarakhand Limited) may acquire the remaining land through the District Magistrate, provided a bank guarantee from the developer equal to the acquisition price is submitted.
 1. In cases where land is leased or aggregated by the developer, the minimum period of lease/agreement shall be 30 years, which may be renewed with the mutual consent of both parties.
 1. The proposed land must be legally in the possession of the promoter and free from any encroachment.
application_process:
Mode: Online. For the formation of a Private Industrial Estate, the eligible developer shall submit the application along with all mandatory documents through the CAF tab on the portal www.investuttarakhand.uk.gov.in.
After receiving in-principle approval, the developer shall apply for the notification of formation of the industrial estate through the Departmental Services tab on the single-window portal, along with all required documents.
Once the notification for the formation of the Private Industrial Estate/Park is issued, the developer may submit an online application for financial incentives under the policy through the Incentive tab on www.investuttarakhand.uk.gov.in.
Capital Subsidy Assistance for Infrastructure will be disbursed in four phases, with each phase payable upon fulfillment of the prescribed conditions and completion of the specified work.
documents_required: Documents are required as per the Policy guidelines to avail the benefits of the scheme.

scheme_name: Post-Harvest Management
description: The scheme aims to promote the development of modern post-harvest infrastructure by supporting farmers & entrepreneurs in setting up facilities such as pack houses, pre-cooling units, cold rooms, cold storage units, etc., thereby reducing post-harvest losses & marketability of horticultural produce.
benefits: For setting up units such as Pack Houses (9 m / 6 m), Pre-Cooling Units (6 MT capacity), Mobile Pre-Cooling Units (5 MT capacity), Cold Rooms (30 MT capacity), Cold Storage Units, Refer Vans/Containers (6 MT capacity), and Ripening Chambers (300 MT capacity), a subsidy of 35% to 50% is provided through a bank-linked, loan-based subsidy mechanism.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be an interested entrepreneur or farmer.
1. The applicant must either own the land or have it on lease for a period of 25 to 30 years.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Application forms must be obtained from officers or staff working at the Horticulture Mobile team Centres, or they can be downloaded from the department's website: https://shm.uk.gov.in. The application form/proposal must include land-related documents, such as Khasra and Khatauni, a lease certificate for leased land, Aadhaar card, PAN card, bank account details, mobile number, and training certificate. Currently, the application process is offline. 
In case of difficulty in completing the application proposal, personnel at the relevant Horticulture Mobile team Centre will provide assistance. The completed application form must be submitted to this office. Simultaneously, the concerned entrepreneur/farmer must apply for a bank loan. Personnel at the Horticulture Mobile team Centre forward the proposal to the district level, which then forwards it to the Directorate. After the Directorate approves the proposal, the district issues an order granting the required approval/work order.
Once a farmer’s proposal is approved, the district officer sends an approval letter to the farmer/entrepreneur and informs them by phone. During this period, the farmer/entrepreneur must obtain loan approval with the assistance of departmental officials. After the loan is approved, the information must be provided to the department. Post-harvest management is carried out with the technical assistance and supervision of departmental officials. Upon completion, a joint team of departmental officials conducts an inspection, and the appropriate government assistance or subsidy is disbursed to the farmer's loan account.

description: The scheme aims to provide pucca houses with basic amenities to eligible rural households in Uttarakhand, ensuring dignified living conditions for economically and socially disadvantaged families.

Based on the Awaas Plus survey data, a permanent waitlist was prepared, and since the year 2020-21, housing targets have been allocated by the Government of India on the basis of this list. full_details:
Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G) has finally been launched by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi in Agra on 20th November 2016. Under the PM Awas Yojana Gramin affordable housing scheme, central government aims to develop 3 Crore homes by the year 2022 in rural areas for poor families including BPL.

PMAY-G is the revamped version of Indira Awas Yojana which was renamed earlier this year with some pro-poor changes in the scheme. Housing units under the PMAY-G scheme are already being offered to the beneficiaries in rural areas across the country. Pradhan Mantri Narendra Modi also handed over the allotment letters to the beneficiaries during the launch event.

The minimum area of home under the new scheme has been increased to 25 Square meter (267 Square foot) from 20 Sq.Mt. in earlier scheme.

Government has also released the scheme logo and a video

http://iay.nic.in/netiay/Video/PMAYGLaunch.mp4

The objective of the scheme is to provide homes to every Indian by the year 2022. Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin will be implemented across the country except Delhi and Chandigarh. The immediate target of PMAY-G is to construct 1 Crore affordable homes in rural areas by the year 2018-19.

Financial Assistance Under PMAY-G

The central government would be providing a financial assistance of Rs. Rs. 120,000 in plain areas and Rs. 130,000 in eastern, hilly and IAP areas to the beneficiaries. Along with this, an additional Rs. 12000 will also be provided to build toilet to each beneficiary under the Swachch Bharat Mission. The beneficiaries will also be provided daily wages of up to 90-95 days (Rs. 18000) through MGNREGA.

Hence, the total financial assistance amount will be 1 Lakh 50 thousand for plain areas and 1 Lakh 60 thousand for eastern, hilly and IAP areas. Interested beneficiaries can also avail a loan of upto Rs. 70000 from any of the nationalized banks for the construction of home. 

Selection of beneficiaries under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin will be done on the basis of SECC-2011 data. The government has also launched AwaasApp for beneficiaries to know the status of their application, funding or share the progress of construction.

To know more about the PMAY-G, please visit the following links

IN ENGLISH: https://sarkariyojana.com/pradhan-mantri-awas-yojana-gramin/

IN HINDI: Pradhan Mantri Gramin Awas Yojana in Hindi

OR visit the official website at http://iay.nic.in

Video & Image Source and Credits: http://iay.nic.in

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban: Individual House Construction Component - Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC) Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to eligible urban families for constructing a pucca house on their own land or for improving their existing kutcha or weak houses.
benefits:
• Under the scheme, a grant of ₹2 lakh is provided to approved beneficiaries in installments, based on the progress of housing construction. Of this amount, ₹50,000/- is provided by the State Government and ₹1,50,000/- by the Government of India.
 - As per Hon’ble Chief Minister’s Announcement No. 458/2022, beneficiaries of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) are provided an additional incentive of ₹5,000/- for home decoration upon completion of the house.
eligibility:
The following are the eligibility criteria to avail the benefits of the scheme:

 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must have been residing in the city from which he/she wishes to receive the benefit on or before 17th June 2015.
 1. The applicant, or any member of their family, must not own a house in their name anywhere in India. (Here, a house refers to a habitable unit suitable for all-weather living.)
 1. The annual family income must not exceed ₹3 lakh.
 1. The applicant must not have received any benefit for residential housing under any other Central, State, or externally aided scheme.
 1. The applicant must have a legally owned plot of land or an existing kutcha/weak residential structure on which they wish to construct a pucca house.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To avail the benefits of the scheme, interested persons/families can visit the Municipal Body office according to their housing demand and eligibility, and register their demand for free housing along with the following documents/legal land ownership records:
Aadhaar card of all family members as identity proof.
Proof of residence in the city before 17th June 2015 (such as electricity bill, water bill, telephone bill, voter ID, Aadhaar card, ration card, passport, or any other authentic document).
Bank account in the name of an adult female member of the beneficiary family; in the absence of an adult female member, the account may be in the name of a male member.
Certified copy of legal land ownership records (Registry/Khasra/Khatauni/Patta, etc.), which should be verified both physically and documentarily.
Valid Income Certificate or self-declared income on a ₹10/- stamp paper.
Caste certificate, photocopy of BPL card, or disability certificate.
Notarized affidavit on a ₹10/- stamp paper based on the following eligibility criteria:
Has been residing in the municipal area since 17th June 2015 or earlier.
Does not own a permanent house in his or her name or in the name of any family member anywhere in India. (Beneficiary family includes husband, wife, and their unmarried sons or daughters.)
The annual income of the family does not exceed ₹3 lakh.
Has not availed any benefit for residential housing under any other Central, State, or externally aided scheme.
8. Selection of beneficiaries is done after examining and verifying the above records and documents. All details are mandatorily recorded on the official website of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban (www.pmaymis.gov.in). A survey code is issued after registering a housing demand on the portal. This code is compiled with a list of eligible beneficiaries and sent to the Government of India through the State Government for approval. After receiving approval from the Government of India, the beneficiary is granted the housing benefit. There is a free application process to avail the scheme's benefits.
documents_required:
Aadhaar card of all family members as identity proof
Proof of residence in the city before 17th June 2015 (such as electricity bill, water bill, telephone bill, voter ID, Aadhaar card, ration card, passport, or any other authentic document).

Certified copy of legal land ownership records (Registry/Khasra/Khatauni/Patta, etc.), which should be verified both physically and documentarily.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan Yojana (PM-KUSUM) - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to promote clean and affordable irrigation by replacing diesel pump sets with solar-powered pump sets, reducing farmers’ irrigation costs, enhancing energy security, and increasing farmers’ income through sustainable and efficient use of solar energy.
benefits:
Under the scheme, farmers receive an 80% subsidy on the cost of a solar pump set from the Government of India and the State Government, while the remaining 20% of the cost is borne by the farmer. 
The scheme allows individual farmers to convert their diesel pump sets into solar pump sets of up to 7.5 HP capacity, which helps reduce expenditure on diesel and lowers production costs, thereby increasing farmers’ income.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The beneficiary must be a farmer engaged in agricultural activities.
 1. As per the guidelines of MNRE, Government of India:

 - The farmer must agree to contribute 20% of the cost of the solar pump set as the farmer’s share.
 - The farmer must have his own borewell.
 - The farmer should currently be using a diesel pump set for irrigation.
 - A farmer who wishes to install a USPC along with the solar pump set must agree to make 100% payment for the said work.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The interested farmer must submit the application form along with all relevant documents to the Block/Sub-Division Office of the department in the district. After the survey, if found suitable, the farmer will deposit 20% of the cost as their contribution for the solar pump set in the concerned office.
After receiving the farmer’s contribution, a work order is issued to the firms empanelled/selected by the department for the installation of the solar pump set. Following the site survey, the solar pump is installed.
documents_required: Documents are required as per the department’s guidelines prescribed for this scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Har Khet Ko Pani (Groundwater Irrigation Scheme) Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to provide assured and sustainable irrigation to every farm by developing groundwater-based irrigation facilities for farmers. This scheme is a centrally sponsored scheme with a funding pattern of 90% Central share and 10% State share.
benefits:
Under the scheme, farmers are provided with free irrigation facilities. Collective irrigation projects or individual groundwater irrigation projects are constructed. The works carried out under the scheme include:

• Solar-powered pumpsets
• Electrically operated pumpsets
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The beneficiary must be a farmer engaged in agricultural activities.
 1. As per the guidelines issued by the Government of India:

 - For the construction of collective irrigation projects, a command area of 5 hectares must be available.
 - According to the report of the Central Ground Water Board, Government of India, the command area must be classified under the safe category.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. For construction of the project, project's proposal may be submitted to the Division, Sub-Division, or other departmental offices through the Gram Sabha, Gram Panchayat, District Panchayat, or other authorized channels. Based on site inspection and the suitability of the received proposals, a Detailed Project Report (DPR) will be prepared.
After examination by the departmental TAC, the DPR is forwarded to the headquarters. Thereafter, following approval by the State-level Technical Advisory Committee, the proposals are forwarded to the State Level Sanctioning Committee, chaired by the Chief Secretary of the Government of Uttarakhand. Upon approval, the DPR is forwarded to the Government of India for financial sanction. The construction work of the projects is initiated after receiving financial approval from the Government of India.
documents_required: Documents are required as per the department’s guidelines prescribed for this scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Har Khet Ko Pani (Surface Scheme) Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to provide every farmer with reliable surface irrigation facilities by developing sustainable irrigation infrastructure, ensuring that every field receives adequate water to improve agricultural productivity.
benefits:
Under this scheme, farmers are provided with free irrigation facilities. The following works are carried out to ensure irrigation support:

• Pipelines / Gool (water channels)
• Storage tanks / Geo-lined tanks
• Solar pump sets
• Small gated weirs
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The beneficiary must be a farmer engaged in agricultural activities.
 1. As per the guidelines issued by the Government of India:

 - For the construction of collective irrigation schemes, clusters will be formed within a radius of 5 km from the proposed village, with a command area of 20 hectares or more.
 - In the case of an individual scheme, the command area should be 10 hectares or more.
 - The cost of the scheme must not exceed ₹4.00 lakh per hectare.
 - The benefit-cost ratio of the scheme must be greater than 1.0.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. For construction of the project, project's proposal may be submitted to the Division, Sub-Division, or other departmental offices through the Gram Sabha, Gram Panchayat, District Panchayat, or other authorized channels. Based on site inspection and the suitability of the received proposals, a Detailed Project Report (DPR) will be prepared.
After examination by the departmental TAC, the DPR is forwarded to the headquarters. Thereafter, following approval by the State-level Technical Advisory Committee, the proposals are forwarded to the State Level Sanctioning Committee, chaired by the Chief Secretary of the Government of Uttarakhand. Upon approval, the DPR is forwarded to the Government of India for financial sanction. The construction work of the projects is initiated after receiving financial approval from the Government of India.
documents_required: Documents are required as per the department’s guidelines prescribed for this scheme.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to promote growth of fisheries sector by providing financial assistance & technical support for modern fisheries activities, thereby increasing fish production,improving livelihood opportunities,& encouraging adoption of advanced fisheries infrastructure among eligible beneficiaries.
benefits:
A 60% subsidy is provided to SC/ST and Women beneficiaries for pond construction, trout units, rearing units, RAS, biofloc units, cage culture, cold storage, motorcycles with ice boxes, fish kiosks, ornamental fisheries, feed mills, hatcheries, and similar activities. A 40% subsidy is provided for all other categories, and a 20% subsidy is provided specifically for large RAS units.

1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant may belong to any caste category, including General, Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), or be a woman.
1. The applicant must have availability of land and a water supply source.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To avail the benefits of the scheme, the applicant must submit an application to the office of the Assistant Director of Fisheries/District Fisheries In-charge at the district level. The application should be submitted along with the following documents: Aadhaar card, land records, permanent residence certificate, caste certificate, bank account details, and mobile number.
In the future, the application process will be made available online through the Apuni Sarkar Portal.
After the application is submitted, a survey is conducted by the Fisheries Inspector/field personnel, and a proposal is prepared in consultation with the beneficiary. Once the proposal is finalized, the concerned district officer approves the work. Field personnel then supervise the implementation and provide technical assistance to ensure timely completion. Subsequently, the subsidy is transferred directly to the beneficiary’s bank account through DBT.
documents_required:
Aadhaar card
Land records
Permanent residence certificate
Caste certificate
Bank account details
Mobile number
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Accident Insurance Scheme - Uttarakhand
description: Under this scheme, fish farmers are provided insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh in case of accidental death/total permanent disability, ₹2.5 lakh for partial disability, & ₹50,000 for hospitalization. No premium is required to be paid by fish farmers, entire cost of the insurance is fully borne by Dept.
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Agriculture,Rural & Environment
benefits:
Under this scheme, an annual insurance coverage is provided as follows:

• ₹5,00,000/- in case of accidental death or total permanent disability.
• ₹2,50,000/- for partial disability (such as loss of limbs, fingers, or partial loss of vision/hearing/speech, etc.).
• ₹50,000/- for hospitalization expenses due to accidents.
• The fish farmer is not required to pay any insurance premium. The entire premium amount is borne by the Department.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be engaged in fish production or fishing as a profession.
1. The applicant may belong to any caste category, including General, Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), or be a woman.
1. The applicant’s age must be between 18 and 70 years at the time of enrollment.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To avail of the benefits under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries can obtain the insurance application form through the field personnel of the Fisheries Department.
The duly filled application form must be submitted along with the fisherman’s Aadhaar card, bank account details, birth certificate, permanent residence certificate, nominee details, and Aadhaar card. The insurance premium is paid by the department. After the fisherman is insured, the department will issue the relevant insurance certificate.
In the event of an accident, death, or hospitalization, the beneficiary’s family must immediately inform the field personnel/officers of the Fisheries Department in the concerned area.
In case of an accident, the claim form along with the necessary documents, such as a medical certificate, death certificate, hospitalization certificate, and insurance certificate, must be submitted. The claim amount will then be disbursed accordingly.
documents_required:

Bank Account Details
Proof of age
Permanent Residence Certificate
Nominee Details (Name, Relationship, Aadhaar Card)
Claim DocumentInsurance Certificate (issued after enrollment)
Recent Passport Size Photograph
Claim Form (in case of accident, hospitalization, or death)
Medical Certificate (in case of partial disability/hospitalization)
Death Certificate (in case of fatal accident)
Hospital Admission/Discharge Certificate (in case of hospitalization)

scheme_name: Pragati Scholarship (81 for Uttarakhand girl students (Diploma) and 50 for Graduation)
description: The scheme aims to encourage higher education among girl students of the state by providing financial assistance in the form of scholarship. Under this scheme, scholarships are awarded to 81 girl students enrolled in Diploma courses and 50 girl students enrolled in Graduation courses in Uttarakhand.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per annum is provided for girl students at the Diploma and Graduation levels.
eligibility:
• The applicant must be a girl student.
• The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
• The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000/-.
• A maximum of two girl children are allowed per family to avail of this scholarship.
application_process:
Mode: Online. These scholarships are administered by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). Under the AICTE scheme, applications are invited through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) between September and December, and scholarships are awarded based on merit. Applicants are required to submit their high school and intermediate mark sheets and certificates, along with an income certificate.
For the Pragati Yojana, scholarships can be sanctioned to two girl students per institute, for which an income certificate is mandatory. For all AICTE schemes, students must first apply online through the institute where they are studying. The application is then verified by the Principal of the institute, followed by verification by the State Level Officer (S.L.O.), and finally forwarded to the AICTE, New Delhi for approval.
documents_required:
High School and Intermediate mark sheets and certificates
Income certificate

scheme_name: Pre-Examination Coaching Scheme
description: Under this scheme, free coaching and monthly scholarships are provided to eligible Scheduled Tribe students appearing for exams like IAS, PCS, engineering, medical, NDA, Group ‘C’ exams and other competitive examinations.
benefits:
Free Coaching:

• Provided for competitive exams such as IAS, PCS, Engineering, Medical, Nursing, NDA, Group ‘C’, and others.

Monthly Scholarship:

• ₹1,500/- per month for external (non-local) students.
• ₹750/- per month for local students.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community.
 1. The applicant should be a student. 
 1. The applicant should be preparing for competitive examinations such as IAS, PCS, Engineering, Medical, Nursing, NDA, or Group ‘C’ exams.
 1. The applicant should have passed High School, Intermediate, or Graduation.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Application Process for the Student:Step 1: The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the office of the Tribal Welfare Department and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
Step 2: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the office of the Tribal Welfare Department.
Notes: Applications for the selection of coaching institutes are invited through newspapers, and institutes are selected after approval at the government level.
Applications are also received from students, and preference for selection in coaching is given based on the marks obtained in high school, intermediate, or graduation.
documents_required:
Identity Proof
Caste Certificate
Educational Qualification certificates
Bank account details
Any Other Document if Required

scheme_name: Printing and Free Distribution of Sanskrit Textbooks
description: The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education by providing free Sanskrit textbooks to students studying in Classes 1 to 12. Under this scheme, annual financial assistance ranging from ₹250/- to ₹700/- is provided to each student enrolled in Classes 1 to 12 of Sanskrit schools.
benefits:
Each student is provided annual financial assistance under the scheme as follows:

 - Classes 1st to 5th: ₹250/- per student - Classes 6th to 8th: ₹400/- per student - Classes 9th to 10th: ₹600/- per student - Classes 11th to 12th: ₹700/- per student
eligibility: 1. The students studying in Classes 1 to 12 at Sanskrit schools across Uttarakhand are eligible.
application_process:
Mode: Online. The application of the concerned student is first forwarded/recommended by the school principal and then further recommended by the Assistant Director of the respective district. 
Required documents include the student’s Aadhaar card and bank account details. 
For students studying in the same class during the same session, the student or their guardian can apply online through the Aapni Sarkar portal.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card of the Student
Bank Account Details
Any Other Document if Required

scheme_name: Priyank Pathak Scholarship for B.Sc. Agriculture (4th Year) Students
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students pursuing a B.Sc. in Agriculture who are in their fourth year of study, by awarding them a monthly scholarship of ₹ 800/- for one year.
benefits: Rate of Scholarship: ₹800/- per month.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a student.
 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the 4th year of the B.Sc. Agriculture program at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar.
 1. The scholarship is awarded for a duration of one year only.
application_process: Mode: Offline. Students are first invited to submit their applications on the prescribed form. A committee, constituted by the Vice Chancellor, then reviews and evaluates these applications following a defined procedure. Based on the committee’s recommendations, the Vice Chancellor grants approval, after which the selected students receive the scholarship payments.
documents_required: Documents are required in accordance with the university guidelines prescribed for this scheme.

scheme_name: Procedure for Admission in Government Child Care Institution, Government Communication Home and Open Shelter Home
description: The scheme aims to support orphaned, destitute, abandoned & vulnerable children by providing them with clothing, food, accommodation, medical care, education & other essential facilities in Government Child Care Institutions, Government Communication Homes, & Open Shelter Homes within the state.
department: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
benefits: In the institutions and homes, children are provided with free facilities such as clothing, food, accommodation, medical care, counselling, entertainment, training, and education. Along with these facilities, children are also provided day care facility based on their needs.
eligibility:
1. In Government Child Care Institutions, orphaned/destitute children, abandoned children, surrendered children, exploited and neglected children, and victimized children are admitted.
 1. In Government Communication Homes, children who are in conflict with the law or have violated the law are admitted.
 1. In Open Shelter Homes, destitute children living on the roadside, beggars, ragpickers, and children from slums who do not attend school are admitted.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Through the Child Welfare Committee and the Juvenile Justice Board, concerned children are admitted to the respective institutions. Complaints can also be lodged through the toll-free number 1098. At present, the following institutions/homes have been established in the state:
Government Child Care Institutions: A total of 05 institutions established in Dehradun, Haridwar, and Almora.
Government Communication Homes: A total of 10 homes established in Almora, Dehradun, Haridwar, Nainital, Uttarkashi, Pauri, and Udham Singh Nagar.
Open Shelter Homes: A total of 07 homes established in Dehradun, Nainital, and Haridwar.
documents_required:
Application/Referral Order from Child Welfare Committee or Juvenile Justice Board
Birth certificate / Age proof of the child (if available)
Medical fitness certificate or health check-up report of the child (if available)
Police report / FIR / General Diary entry (in cases of abandoned or missing children) (if available)
Photographs of the child (passport size)
Any other documents as required

scheme_name: Procedure for Admission to Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre and Women's Home
description: The scheme aims to provide support to women above 18 years of age who are orphans, destitute, abandoned, found on roads, or mentally and physically disabled. Such women are provided with clothing, food, accommodation, medical care, counselling, entertainment, and training facilities free of cost.
department: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
benefits: Women above 18 years of age who are mentally and physically disabled, or destitute women, are provided with clothing, food, accommodation, medical care, counseling, entertainment, and training facilities free of cost.
eligibility: Women above 18 years of age who are orphans, destitute, abandoned, found on roads, mentally or physically disabled, or involved in immoral trafficking are eligible.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The woman herself or any citizen can provide information about mentally or physically disabled women, or destitute women in their area, by calling helpline number 181. Information can also be given to the Police, SDM, City Magistrate, or District Magistrate of the concerned area.
After receiving the information, the Police rescue the woman, conduct medical and other necessary examinations, and on the orders of the District Magistrate, send her to the Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre or Mahila Griha. The list of such centres is as follows:
Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre (Mental), Kedarpuram, Dehradun.
Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre, Kedarpuram, Dehradun.
Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre (Protection Home), Nainital.
Government Women Welfare and Rehabilitation Centre (Protection Home), Kotdwar.
Government Destitute Women Workshop and Training Centre, Pithoragarh.
documents_required:
1. Proof of age of the applicant woman
2. Any other documents as required

scheme_name: Procedure for Making "Orphan Certificate" for Getting Horizontal Reservation for Orphan Children
description: This certificate provides 5% horizontal reservation in Government/Non-Government services for affected children, including those whose both biological or adoptive parents have died within 21 years from the child’s birth. orphan children residing in voluntary or government-run homes within the state.
department: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
category: Women and Child, Social welfare & Empowerment
benefits: Through this certificate, a 5% horizontal reservation is provided in Government/Non-Government services to eligible beneficiaries.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. Children whose both biological or adoptive parents have died within 21 years from the child’s birth are eligible for reservation.
1. Orphan children residing in voluntary or government-run homes within the state are also eligible for reservation.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. An application must be submitted to the District Magistrate Office or the District Probation Officer’s Office of the concerned district to obtain a certificate of orphanhood. The application should be accompanied by the orphan child’s Aadhaar card, permanent residence certificate, and the death certificates of both parents.
Thereafter, the department or District Magistrate’s Office will conduct an investigation, and, based on the recommendation of the District Probation Officer, the certificate will be issued by an officer not below the rank of Sub-Divisional Magistrate.
The concerned child can use this orphan certificate while applying for services. Only upon presenting this certificate will the child be eligible for orphan reservation.
Currently, the application process is offline.
documents_required:
Aadhaar card of the orphan child
Permanent residence certificate
Death certificates of both parents

scheme_name: Procedure for Making Medical Certificate (for Certifying Disability)
description: The certificate aims to ensure that persons with disabilities can easily obtain authentic medical certification required to avail benefits under various social welfare schemes, including disability pensions, scholarships, healthcare facilities, and employment reservations.
department: Medical Health And Family Welfare Department
benefits: This certificate is essential to verify a person’s disability and to enable them to avail the benefits of various social welfare schemes such as pensions, scholarships, and reservations in employment.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be a person with disabilities.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To obtain a medical certificate, a person with disabilities must visit the district hospital on Wednesdays. They can collect a registration form there after paying a nominal fee. After registration, the individual is examined by the concerned doctors or specialists relevant to their type of disability. 
The applicant must carry their Aadhaar card, mobile number, and a passport-size photograph. The Chief Medical Officer (CMO) is generally present at the district hospital every Wednesday and, based on the medical examination reports, issues the disability certificate to the concerned individual. If the certificate is not available immediately, it can later be collected from the office of the Chief Medical Officer.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Passport-size Photograph
Mobile Number
Any Previous Medical Reports or Disability-related Documents (if available)

scheme_name: Promotion of Post-Harvest Management, Processing, and Value Addition of Aromatic Plant Produce to Farmers/Institutions/Groups in the State - Centre for Aromatic Plants
description: The scheme aims to encourage and support farmers, institutions, and groups engaged in aromatic plant cultivation to establish post-harvest management and processing facilities.
beneficiary_type: Individual, Self Help Groups (SHGS), Business Entity
benefits:
Under this scheme, the following support is provided:

 - A grant of up to ₹10 lakh is available for setting up necessary machinery, equipment, distillation units, etc., for drying, storage, and processing of aromatic plants. The grant is provided through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) at the rate of 75% in hilly areas and 50% in plain areas.
 - Establishment of distillation (processing) facilities to serve other farmers within the cluster.
 - Development of entrepreneurship among farmers.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a farmer, organization, or group belonging to Uttarakhand.
 1. The farmer, organization, or group must be registered with the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun.
 1. The cluster must have plants, machinery, and equipment as per the capacity and requirements of the aromatic cultivated area.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. For post-harvest processing, farmers first obtain an application form for setting up a distillation (processing) plant from the CAP website or field personnel. The application form must be accompanied by a photograph, land records/lease certificates, a CAP registration certificate, and a description of the distillation plant.
The farmer, organization, or group will submit the application form in the prescribed format to the Director of the Centre for Aromatic Plants or provide it to a field worker. The District Coordinator then conducts a site inspection and provides a recommendation. Following the inspection, the Director of CAP grants written permission to the farmer to establish a distillation plant. The farmer will then establish their distillation plant at their own expense, as per the details attached to the CAP permission letter.
The prescribed application form for disbursing the subsidy after the plant is established can be obtained from the CAP website or from field workers. The application form, along with the bill, a photo of the farmer, a photo of the distillation plant, land documents, and bank account details, will be submitted to the Director of CAP, along with the recommendation of the Master Trainer/Technical Assistant.
An evaluation committee constituted at the Director level then conducts a site inspection. Following the committee's report and the District Coordinator's recommendation, the Director of CAP disburses the lump-sum subsidy to the farmer's account.
documents_required:
Photograph of the farmer/applicant
Land records documents or lease certificates
CAP registration certificate
Description/details of the distillation (processing) plant
Bill/invoice of machinery or equipment
Photograph of the distillation plant
Land documents (for verification)
Bank account details of the applicant
Recommendation from the Master Trainer/Technical Assistant
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Providing Model Maps for Residential Construction
description: It aims to provide landowners in Haridwar district with model maps for residential construction according to the size of their plots.
benefits: Model maps for residential construction are provided to all landowners across Haridwar district.
eligibility: 1. All landowners in the Haridwar district of Uttarakhand are eligible.
application_process: Mode: Online. For the convenience of landowners in Haridwar district, model maps have been uploaded on the authority’s website. Landowners can select a model map according to the area of their plot and avail the facility.
documents_required: The required documents must be submitted as per the guidelines of the Haridwar-Roorkee Development Authority.

scheme_name: Provision of Special Assistance for Development of Low-Cost Educational Materials (SIPDA)
description: The scheme aims to provide financial support for the development and supply of low-cost educational materials for visually impaired students. Through this scheme, grants are provided to implementing agencies for purchasing and producing assistive learning devices.
benefits: • Support for Braille Presses: Assistance is given for the installation of new Braille presses and enhancement of the capacity and modernization of existing Braille presses. - Upgradation of Talking Book Studios: Financial support is offered for increasing the capacity and modernization of existing Talking Book Studios. - Creation and Enhancement of Digital Book Production Centers: Grants are available for setting up new Digital Book Production Centers and modernizing existing centers to improve production capabilities. - Support for Large Print Book Production: Funding is provided for establishing new Large Print Book Production Centers and increasing the capacity and modernization of existing large print facilities.
eligibility:
> Individual Eligibility:

 - The applicant must be a visually impaired student enrolled in school or pursuing higher education.
 - The applicant must have a valid Unique Disability ID (UDID) card issued by the competent authority.

> Institutional Eligibility:

 - The agency must be approved for SIPDA projects.
 - The agency must be actively involved in the development, production, or distribution of educational materials for persons with visual disabilities.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. For Institutional Applicants:Step 1: The implementing agency should prepare a project proposal outlining the infrastructure to be established or upgraded.
Step 2: The proposal should be submitted to NIEPVD or the concerned state authority for review and approval.
Step 3: Once approved, funds are disbursed as per the sanctioned amount.
Step 4: The agency must maintain transparency in utilization and submit reports and utilization certificates as required.
For Student Beneficiaries (if applicable):Step 1: The student should approach an approved implementing agency.
Step 2: Submit necessary documents such as Aadhaar, UDID, and school/college ID.
Step 3: The agency will facilitate access to learning materials based on availability and eligibility.
Website: niepvd.nic.inTelephone No.: 7579278149
documents_required:
For Students:Unique Disability ID (UDID)
Date of Birth
Parent/Guardian's Mobile Number
School Details
For Implementing Agencies:Project Proposal outlining the development and production of education support materials.
Relevant Financial Statements (for recurring and non-recurring grant applications).
Any other documents as required.

scheme_name: Provision of Sports Kits to Players Participating at the National Level
description: This scheme provides a sports kit worth ₹5000/- (including tracksuit, jersey, shorts, socks, etc.) to approximately 1000 players annually who participate in various sports at the national level, selected through their respective sports federations.
benefits:
• Under this scheme, sports kits are provided through sports associations to players and team members participating in various sports disciplines at the national level across different age groups. 
 - Approximately 1,000 players benefit from the scheme annually.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a player or a member of a team representing Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant or their team must be participating in national-level sports competitions.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The respective sports federations select the teams to participate at the national level and apply for kits in the prescribed format. 
Each player or team member participating in various age groups at the national level is provided with a sports kit (including a tracksuit, jersey, shorts, socks, and shoes) worth ₹5,000/-.
documents_required: Submission of documents as required by the respective sports federations.

scheme_name: Quality Test Report - Centre for Aromatic Plants
description: The scheme aims to provide quality testing facilities at a subsidized rate to registered aromatic farmers, enabling them to obtain authentic quality reports for their produce or essential oils.
benefits: Under this initiative, farmers receive a 50% discount on the quality testing fee for their produce/essential oil. The quality test report enables farmers to obtain a fair market price for their oil.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The farmer must be engaged in the cultivation of aromatic plants.
 1. The farmer must be registered with the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun.
application_process: Mode: Offline. Farmers must submit a sample of the oil they have produced to CAP along with the prescribed fee, after which a quality test report will be issued. It is mandatory for the farmer to visit the CAP office in person to submit the sample.
documents_required: Documents are required as per the guidelines of the Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun to avail the benefits of the scheme.

scheme_name: Rafting Course & Internship
description: The scheme aims to train and certify youth of Uttarakhand, aged 18 to 30 years, as skilled and professional river rafting guides. Under this scheme, rafting training and internship opportunities are provided to youth of the state.
benefits: The beneficiary will receive training and internship opportunities to become a river rafting guide.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a youth of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be between 18 to 30 years of age.
1. The applicant must be educated.
1. The applicant must be mentally and physically healthy.

> The total number of 215 beneficiaries will be selected.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Applicants must complete the prescribed application form and submit it along with the required documents to the office of the District Tourism Development Officer.
Upon completion of the tests, the District Tourism Development Officer will forward the list of shortlisted candidates to the headquarters.
Final selection of participants will be made by a committee constituted at the headquarters.
documents_required: Applicants are required to submit the necessary documents in accordance with the guidelines specified by the department.

scheme_name: Rajya Samekit Sahkari Vikas Yojana - Ganga Gaay Mahila Dairy Yojana
description: The scheme aims to promote dairy entrepreneurship among women, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and general category members of cooperative societies by providing financial assistance through subsidies and loans for the purchase of milch cows and buffaloes.
benefits:
*The following benefits are provided to members of milk-producing cooperative societies for purchasing cows or buffaloes::*
For members of the general category:

• A grant of 50% and a loan of 40% is approved through the District Cooperative Bank for the establishment of a unit of 2, 3, and 5 dairy animals (including animal purchase, insurance, transportation expenses, cattle shed, milk van, etc.), and the remaining 10% is borne by the beneficiary.
• The dairy department will provide a grant of ₹80,000 for 2 animals, ₹1,23,250 for 3 animals, and ₹2,03,625 for 5 animals.

For Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and women members (of any caste):

• For the establishment of units for 2, 3 and 5 dairy animals (covering animal purchase, insurance, transportation, cattle shed including calf, milk van, etc.), a 75% grant and a 25% loan are approved through the District Cooperative Bank. 
• The dairy department will provide funds of ₹1,20,000/- for 2 animals, ₹1,84,875/- for 3 animals, and ₹3,05,438/- for 5 animals. 
• A minimum of 2 animals must be purchased, and taking a loan is mandatory to receive the subsidy.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a member of a milk-producing cooperative society. (Individuals who are not currently members can become eligible by joining a cooperative society.)
1. The applicant must belong to the General, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, or Women category.
1. The applicant must intend to purchase cows (with a minimum milk yield of 12 liters per day) or buffaloes (with a minimum milk yield of 10 liters per day).
1. The applicant must purchase animals from outside the state.
1. The applicant must purchase a minimum of two (2) animals.
1. To avail of the subsidy, it is mandatory to take a loan for the purchase of milch animals.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. It is mandatory for the applicant to be a member of the society. Any member above 18 years of age in the concerned Gram Panchayat or rural area can obtain membership by depositing a ₹25.00 membership fee with the nearest society secretary and receiving a receipt. It is not necessary to be a cattle rearer to become a member.
The application form can be obtained from the milk cooperative society or the nearest district cooperative bank. The form must be submitted along with Aadhaar card, bank account details, caste certificate, cooperative society membership number (if applicable), and movable/immovable property or land certificate. If the above documents are not available, two guarantors who are members of the milk society must be provided.
If a loan has been taken from any institution, its details along with the number of animals to be acquired must be submitted to the milk cooperative society. The Society Secretary certifies the application. The Manager/Chief Manager of the Milk Producers Cooperative Union Ltd. and the Assistant Director of Dairy provide recommendations after scrutiny.
After receiving the recommendations, the application is submitted to the bank. Once the bank verifies all documents, the loan is approved according to the beneficiary’s eligibility, and the loan amount is disbursed to the beneficiary’s account.
Upon receiving the funds, the Dairy Cooperative Society/Dairy Department’s Purchase Society informs the beneficiary and accompanies them to purchase animals from department-listed dairy farms outside the state. The Purchase Society selects and purchases the animals, inspects their health, and delivers them to the owner’s home. The owner does not have to pay any money to departmental personnel.
If the beneficiary is not satisfied with the animals from the listed firm, they must notify the relevant District Manager in writing. After receiving permission, the Purchase Society will provide animals from an alternative source outside the state.
documents_required:
Aadhaar card
Bank account details
Caste certificate (if applicable)
Cooperative society membership number (if applicable)
Movable/immovable property or land certificate (if applicable)
Two guarantors (if required)
Loan details, if any
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Rajya/Mukhyamantri Swarn/Rajat Padak Protsahan Puraskar
description: This scheme awards cash incentives to NCC cadets who demonstrate outstanding performance in the current year's RDC, TSC, VSC, or NSC camps, recognizing six gold medal recipients with ₹3,000/- and six silver medal recipients with ₹2000/-.
benefits: • Gold Medal Winners: A cash award of ₹3,000/- each is given to 6 cadets who achieve gold medals during NCC training and camps.- Silver Medal Winners: A cash award of ₹2,000/- each is given to 6 cadets who achieve silver medals during NCC training and camps.
eligibility:

Fully Filled Application Form.
Any other documents as required.

scheme_name: Registration of Aromatic Plant Farmers - Centre for Aromatic Plants
description: The registration ensures that farmers are eligible to access the benefits of all schemes offered by CAP, including state and central government subsidies, technical guidance, training programs, and product clearance support.
benefits:

description: It aims to register cultivators who grow medicinal and aromatic plants, make the process of using their cultivated herbs easier, and stop the illegal collection of herbs from forests.

scheme_name: Residential- Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya/ Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya
description: The scheme aims to provide free and accessible education for children from Class 6 to 12 by offering free education, accommodation, meals, study materials, sports facilities, and other essential services across all Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya / Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya in the state.
benefits:

full_details:
Table of Contents

Revised U-Health Card Scheme – FeaturesComprehensive Health Insurance Scheme PremiumNeed for Revised U-Health Card Scheme in UttarakhandReferences

Uttarakhand Govt. is planning to start the Revised U-Health Card Scheme for all the state govt. employees. Accordingly, this scheme will provide cashless health insurance to all employees and pensioners. The entire staff will be covered under this Comprehensive Health Insurance Cover which will start from 15 August 2018.

Revised U-Health Card Scheme will also resolve the issue of delay in the payment. Govt. will also cover Out Patient Department (OPD) in this scheme so that more number of hospitals appears in the List of Empanelled Hospitals under this scheme 

U-Health Card Scheme for govt. employees was firstly launched on 25 October 2010. At that time, this health insurance scheme was optional for employees. But this time, it will be a major success with enhanced coverage. 

Revised U-Health Card Scheme – Features

The important features and highlights of this scheme are as follows:-

Employee Organization demands for inclusion of OPDs Fees in this Revised U-Health Card Insurance Scheme.

All the representatives of employees will be included in the steering committee of Comprehensive Health Assurance Scheme.

Under the U Health Card Scheme, all the cardholders along with their families will get unlimited cashless medical reimbursement in the empanelled hospitals.

Revised U-Health Insurance Coverage will provide cashless benefits to all employees and pensioners in all empanelled govt. and private hospitals.

Mismanagement and other payment issues will get resolved.

Till date, there are only few empaneled hospitals in Uttarakhand. In addition, 2 more empanelled hospitals are located in National Capital Region (NCR) – Medanta Medicity Gurugram and National Heart Institute New Delhi. For all details like Bank Challan Form, Consent Forms, Deduction Head, Day Care Treatment of the existing U-Health Card Scheme – Click Here

Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme Premium

Under the revised scheme, the insurance premium rates will be finalised soon. Till then, we are providing the premium rates for the existing U-Health Card Scheme in Uttarakhand. All the state govt. employees are required to pay the following premium as mentioned in the table given below:-

Uttarakhand U-Health Card Scheme Premium Rates

Grade Pay (GP) of Employees

Annual Premium

GP > Rs. 6600

Rs. 5000

GP between Rs. 4200 to Rs. 5400

Rs. 3500

GP between Rs. 1900 to Rs. 2800

Rs. 1500

GP < Rs. 1800

Rs. 700

The employees hopes that the Revised Health Insurance Scheme would ensure that there are max number of private empaneled hospitals in the scheme.

Need for Revised U-Health Card Scheme in Uttarakhand

Various employees organizations are demanding for a comprehensive health insurance cover for all employees from a long period. The Existing U-health Card Scheme was optional for employees and was also not much attractive. So, govt. employees and hospitals stays away from this scheme.

Now there is a demand of revision in the existing U-Health Card Scheme and to make it more attractive so as to empanel more number of hospitals in order to provide benefits to all staff.

A delegation of Joint Forum of Employees met the Secretary of Health and Family Welfare and discussed the scheme. The state govt. will revise U-health Card Scheme & will launch this scheme on 15 August this year.

— In case of any query, candidates can contact the U Health Cell – Contact Us

scheme_name: Right to Education Act 2009 - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to provide free education, textbooks, uniforms, and the benefits of the PM Poshan Yojana to children up to Class 8 in private schools, targeting rural and urban children from weaker and deprived sections of Uttarakhand.
benefits:
• Under Section 12(1)(c) of the Right to Education Act, children from weaker and disadvantaged sections in rural and urban areas of Uttarakhand are provided free education, textbooks, uniforms, and the benefits of the PM Poshan Yojana up to Class 8 in private schools.
 - In private schools, 25% of the total seats in the entry-level class are reserved for children from weaker and disadvantaged sections under Section 12(1)(c) of the Right to Education Act.
eligibility:
Children from the following categories will be eligible for admission up to Class 8 in private schools:

 1. Children from weaker sections: Those whose parents/guardians have an annual income of ₹55,000/- or less, or are BPL card holders. 1. Children from disadvantaged classes: SC, ST, and children belonging to the non-creamy layer of OBC, with a family annual income of up to ₹4.5 lakh. 1. Orphan children.
 1. Children with physical disabilities.
 1. Children living with HIV/AIDS or those dependent on parents who are HIV/AIDS positive.
 1. Children dependent on disabled parents or parents affected by leprosy, with a family annual income of less than ₹4.5 lakh.
 1. Children dependent on a divorced or widowed mother, with an annual family income of less than ₹80,000/-.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Online applications are invited through an advertisement issued in February-March. Parents or guardians can apply online through the official portal or with the help of a cyber café.
Before applying, the following documents are mandatory for children from weaker and disadvantaged sections: passport-size photograph of the child, Aadhaar card of the child and parents/guardians, caste certificate, permanent residence certificate, BPL certificate or income certificate (as applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), husband’s death certificate (in case of widow), divorce certificate (in case of divorcee), and orphan certificate (if applicable).
After filling in the address details on the portal, the parent/guardian can view the list of schools available in their ward and must select the nearest school. Once the form is submitted online, a printout of the application, along with self-attested copies of the required documents, must be submitted to the office of the concerned Deputy Education Officer / Block Education Officer.
All submitted documents are verified by a committee at the development block level. The details of students found eligible are updated and verified on the online portal.
If the number of applications exceeds the available seats in private schools, the selection of children is done through an online lottery conducted at the state level.
documents_required:
Passport-size photograph of the child
Aadhaar card of the child and parents/guardians
Caste certificate
Permanent residence certificate
BPL certificate / Income certificate (as applicable under eligibility)
Disability certificate (if applicable)
Husband’s death certificate (in case of widow)
Divorce certificate (in case of divorcee)
Orphan certificate (if applicable)

scheme_name: Rural Business Incubators - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship and develop a robust entrepreneurial ecosystem in the state by providing aspiring and existing entrepreneurs with technical, business, legal, marketing, and mentorship support.
benefits: This is an innovative initiative of the Rural Development Department, under which entrepreneurs are provided with free of cost technical, business, and legal advice, marketing support, and mentorship through the incubator.
eligibility:
• The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand and interested in starting or expanding a business in the state.
• The applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
• The applicant may belong to any of the following categories:

• A member of a self-help group (SHG) in the state who wishes to start a business.
• An individual already running a business and seeking to expand it.
• An individual seeking technical or vocational training.
• An individual requiring assistance in preparing a business plan.
• An individual seeking guidance on legal procedures related to business.
• An individual aiming to enhance the market reach of their products or services.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. If anyone in the state wishes to start a business but is unsure about aspects such as obtaining a bank loan, available government support, or marketing strategies, they can visit the Rural Business Incubators (RBI) office at the district headquarters to receive business-related information and other incubator services. Applicants can also apply online through the departmental website https://ukrdd.uk.gov.in or contact the RBI via email at rbiuttarakhand@gmail.com or by phone at 7060463021.
Additionally, the department periodically publishes advertisements to inform the public about the services offered by Rural Business Incubators. After receiving an application or call, RBI contacts the applicant. Upon visiting the office, the applicant is provided guidance regarding business, training, and related services, and a file is prepared on the subject of assistance. After screening by the District Level Screening Committee, relevant support is provided to the incubatees under the RBI initiative through HEARTS.
The main objective of the Rural Business Incubators Scheme is to develop and promote the entrepreneurial ecosystem in Uttarakhand, encourage self-employment, strengthen the local economy, reduce youth migration, and promote reverse migration.
RBI-Hubs have been established in Haldwani, Almora district (covering the districts of Kumaon division) and Kotdwar, Pauri district (covering the districts of Garhwal division). RBI-Spokes, currently operating along with offices at the district headquarters, have been established in the remaining 11 districts.
The following services are provided free of cost at these offices: Self-employment support, Expert consultation, Business planning support, Marketing support, Business training, Business registration, Business investment support, Legal compliance for business

Mode: Online. Applicants can also apply online through the departmental website https://ukrdd.uk.gov.in or contact the RBI via email at rbiuttarakhand@gmail.com or by phone at 7060463021.
documents_required: Documents are required as per the guidelines of the Rural Business Incubators to avail the benefits under the scheme.

scheme_name: Rural Technology Complex
description: The scheme "Rural Technology Complex" by the Programme Implementation Department, Government of Uttarakhand, aims to enhance livelihood opportunities in the Himalayan region through the use of local, need-based and environment-friendly technologies.
benefits: • Free Training: All training programmes under the scheme are provided at no cost. - Livelihood Enhancement: Training equips individuals with skills for sustainable, eco-friendly income generation. - Practical Exposure: Training includes hands-on learning and field demonstrations. - No Participation Charges: There is no fee for training or the exposure visit to the Rural Technology Campus.

 1. A central or state government officer or staff member.

 1. A rural woman or man interested in acquiring environment-friendly livelihood-based technological skills.

scheme_name: S.P. Nautiyal Museum
description: The scheme “S.P. Nautiyal Sangrahalaya” implemented by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology, provides insights into the Great Himalayas through geological maps, charts, models, and educational exhibits, displaying rock, mineral, and fossil samples from the entire Himalayan region.
benefits: • Educational Insight: Provides in-depth knowledge and understanding of the Great Himalayas through geo-scientific exhibits. - Awareness Generation: Raises awareness about the geological and natural heritage of the Himalayan region. - Diverse Exhibits: Offers a wide range of exhibits including maps, charts, models, and actual samples of rocks, minerals, and fossils. - Accessibility: Open to both national and international visitors, making it a globally accessible resource for Himalayan studies.

scheme_name: Sainik School Scholarship Located Outside the Uttarakhand
description: The scheme offers financial assistance to students from Uttarakhand enrolled in classes 6 to 12 at Sainik Schools outside the state, with scholarships awarded based on family income.
benefits:
Rate of Scholarships:

• ₹40,000/- per annum for students from families with a monthly income up to ₹12,000/-.
• ₹30,000/- per annum for students from families with a monthly income of ₹12,001/- to ₹15,000/-.
• ₹20,000/- per annum for students from families with a monthly income of ₹15,001/- to ₹18,000/-.
• ₹10,000/- per annum for students from families with a monthly income of ₹18,001/- to ₹22,000/-.
eligibility:
• The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
• The applicant must be studying in Classes 6 to 12 in a Sainik School located outside Uttarakhand.
• The scholarship will be awarded on the basis of the applicant’s family income.
• The applicant is not eligible if the monthly family income exceeds ₹22,000/-.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The student studying in a Sainik School located outside Uttarakhand will apply for a scholarship in that school. 
Along with the application, the student must submit the following documents: a valid family income certificate issued by the tehsil, permanent residence certificate, Aadhaar card, and proof of an Aadhaar-linked bank account. All Sainik Schools located outside the state will forward the applications to Sainik School Ghorakhal. Sainik School Ghorakhal will compile the applications, prepare a proposal, and send it to the department. 
The department will allocate funds to the concerned schools through Sainik School Ghorakhal, and the schools will disburse the scholarship to the students via DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer).
documents_required:
A valid family income certificate issued by the tehsil
Permanent residence certificate
Aadhaar card
Proof of an Aadhaar-linked bank account

scheme_name: Sakhi Niwas - Working Women's Hostel

benefits:

• Facilities include: Accommodation, Mess, Library, Gym, TV Hall, Creche, and more.
eligibility:
