• The applicant must be a woman pursuing higher education or professional training, or a working woman.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. At present, hostel facilities are operational in the districts of Dehradun, Haridwar, and Udham Singh Nagar. 
Applicants need to visit the hostel, submit a form along with their Aadhaar card and family details, and pay the required fees to stay in the hostel.
documents_required:
Aadhaar card
Details of family members

scheme_name: Saksham Scholarship
description: The scheme aims to support meritorious differently-abled students pursuing graduate-level studies in the state by providing them with financial assistance in the form of scholarships.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per annum is provided for Graduate-level studies.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a student.
 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must have at least 40% disability.
 1. The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000/-.
application_process:
Mode: Online. These scholarships are administered by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). Under the AICTE scheme, applications are invited through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) between September and December, and scholarships are awarded on the basis of merit.
Applicants are required to submit their high school and intermediate mark sheets and certificates, along with an income certificate. For the Saksham Yojana, a valid disability certificate of at least 40%, issued by the competent authority, is also mandatory.
For all AICTE schemes, students must first apply online through the institute where they are studying. The application is verified by the Principal of the institute, then by the State Level Officer (S.L.O.), and finally forwarded to the AICTE, New Delhi, for approval.
documents_required:
High School and Intermediate mark sheets and certificates
Income certificate
Disability certificate of minimum 40% issued by the competent authority

scheme_name: Samaaveshit Shiksha
description: The scheme aims to provide equal and inclusive educational opportunities to all children with special needs (Divyang children) studying in government schools from Classes 1 to 12.
benefits:
• Escort facility, home-based education, sports activities, exposure visits, stipend for girls, and free equipment are provided to all children with special needs studying in government schools from Classes 1 to 12. 
 - Marking and equipment distribution camps are also organized for such children, where assistive devices are provided free of cost as per the requirement of disabled children.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be a child with a disability, aged 6 to 18 years, eligible for all facilities approved by the Government of India under the ‘Samaveshit Shiksha’ scheme.
 1. The applicant must be studying in government schools from Classes 1 to 12.
application_process: Mode: Offline. At the beginning of the academic session, special educators at the block level identify children with disabilities, who are then enrolled in nearby schools.
documents_required:
Disability Certificate
Proof of Age
Other documents as required

scheme_name: Samman Pension Yojana for All First-Generation Living Legal Heirs of Freedom Fighters of Uttarakhand State
description: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹4,800/- per month as pension to all first-generation living legal heirs of freedom fighters residing in the state of Uttarakhand.
benefits: Samman Pension Amount: ₹4,800/- per month
eligibility:
• The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
• The applicant must be a first-generation living legal heir of a freedom fighter.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The application form can be obtained from the office of the District Magistrate of the concerned district and must be submitted there along with the required documents. 
The Samman Pension will be sanctioned only after verification at the level of the District Magistrate. 
The pension will commence only after the lifetime of the widowed wife or widower husband of the deceased freedom fighter. All surviving first-generation legal heirs of the deceased freedom fighter, including sons and daughters (married or unmarried), as well as the widow of a first-generation heir, will be jointly entitled to receive the pension.
documents_required:
Identity Proof of Applicant
Proof of Residence
Death Certificate of the deceased freedom fighter
Bank Account Details
Any other document as required

2. Other documents as required

scheme_name: Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana (UKBOCWWB)
description: The scheme aims to support the marriage of daughters of registered construction workers by providing financial assistance of ₹61,000/- for their daughter’s marriage in a group marriage event.
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
benefits:
• ₹61,000/- will be provided as financial assistance to registered construction workers for the marriage of their daughters.
 - ₹10,000/- per couple will be paid to the organizer to cover expenses incurred in organizing the mass marriage.
 - ₹5,000/- will be provided to each bride and groom for purchasing their wedding attire.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker.
 1. In the case of a mass marriage, registration must be completed at least 15 days prior to the scheduled date of the marriage.
application_process:
[Online - via CSC]
Applications for mass marriage can be submitted at least 15 days prior to the scheduled date.
It is mandatory to attach the necessary documents with the application form. The daughter and the proposed groom should be at least 18 years and 21 years of age, respectively. Aadhar authentication of the daughter of the construction worker is required under the mass marriage scheme. A self-attested copy of the birth certificate, school leaving certificate, or family register verifying age must be submitted, and the marriage card should be certified and verified by the local village head, tehsildar, member, or councilor.
Additionally, a self-written certificate stating that the applicant has not received assistance from any other department in this regard must be provided.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card of the daughter (mandatory for Aadhaar authentication)
Proof of Age (Birth Certificate/School Leaving Certificate/Self-attested copy of Family Register, any one)
Self-attested copy of the marriage card
A certificate issued by the local head/tehsildar/sarpanch verifying the marriage and authenticity of the applicant
Self-Declaration Certificate (the applicant confirming that no assistance has been availed under similar schemes from any other department)

scheme_name: Sanskrit Chhaatr Pratiyogita
description: The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education among students by organizing Sanskrit competitions at various levels. Under this scheme, Sanskrit competitions are organized at various levels for both junior (Class 6 to 10) and senior (Class 11 to post-graduation) categories.
benefits:
Separate six Sanskrit competitions for junior and senior categories are organized at every level. The prize distribution is as follows:
Development Block Level

• Team Events: Minimum prize of ₹300/- and maximum prize of ₹800/-- Individual Competition: Minimum prize of ₹300/- and maximum prize of ₹500/-
District Level

• Team Events: Minimum prize of ₹400/- and maximum prize of ₹2,000/-- Individual Competition: Minimum prize of ₹400/- and maximum prize of ₹800/-
State Level

• Team Events: Minimum prize of ₹6,000/- and maximum prize of ₹25,000/-- Individual Competition: Minimum prize of ₹2,000/- and maximum prize of ₹4,000/-
eligibility:
1. The institutional students studying in the junior classes (Class 6 to 10) and senior classes (Class 11 to post-graduation) of any government, private, or non-governmental school/college in Uttarakhand are eligible to participate.
 1. The students pursuing B.Ed., Ph.D., or Diploma courses are not eligible for participation.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. This competition is held once a year, typically between September and November. An advertisement or notification is issued and sent to the relevant District Coordinator and Block Coordinator. After students are selected at the school or college level, they are recommended by their principal and presented to the Block Education Officer/Block Coordinator for participation.
Prizes are awarded to participants or teams that secure first, second, and third place in the block-level competition. All first- and second-place finishers then advance to the district-level competition.
At the district level, prize money is awarded to participants or teams securing first, second, and third place. All first-place winners at the district level advance to the state-level competition, where prize money is awarded to the first, second, and third-place winners.
documents_required: Documents required in accordance with the competition guidelines.

scheme_name: Sanskrit Chhatra Pratibha Samman
description: The scheme aims to encourage and motivate students to pursue higher studies in Sanskrit by rewarding those who achieve top positions in the subject at the high school, intermediate, undergraduate, and postgraduate levels.
benefits:
Awards:
•	First Place: ₹5,100/-
•	Second Place: ₹4,100/-
•	Third Place: ₹3,100/-
eligibility:
Students securing First, Second, or Third position in Sanskrit subject in the following examinations will be eligible:

 - High School Examination (Uttarakhand Vidyalaya Shiksha Parishad)
 - Intermediate Examination (Uttarakhand Vidyalaya Shiksha Parishad)
 - Purva Madhyama Examination (Uttarakhand Sanskrit Shiksha Parishad)
 - Uttar Madhyama Examination (Uttarakhand Sanskrit Shiksha Parishad)
 - Shastri and Acharya Examinations (Uttarakhand Sanskrit University, Haridwar and Central Sanskrit University, Campus Devprayag, etc.)
 - Graduate and Postgraduate classes of higher education institutions (on the basis of marks obtained in Sanskrit subject).
application_process:
Mode: Offline. The Academy obtains information about the highest-scoring students in Sanskrit in the relevant High School and Intermediate Examinations through correspondence with the Secretary of the respective Board. Similarly, the list of students securing First, Second, and Third positions in Sanskrit at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels is obtained through correspondence with the Controller of Examinations/Registrar of the respective University.
An award ceremony is organized, during which payment is made through cheque, and the students are honoured with certificates and other recognitions.
documents_required: Documents required for the award will be as per the guidelines prescribed by the Uttarakhand Sanskrit Academy.

scheme_name: Sanskrit Shodh Chhaatravrtti Yojana
description: The aim of the scheme is to encourage and support high-quality research in Sanskrit by providing financial assistance to meritorious Ph.D. students across state universities.
benefits:
• A research scholarship of ₹40,000/- per year is awarded to 20 students registered for a Ph.D. in Sanskrit at universities across Uttarakhand.

eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.

1. The applicant must belong to the General, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, and Economically Weaker Section. 
1. A total of 20 research scholars are eligible for the scholarship, including 10 from the General category, 5 from Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, and 5 from Economically Weaker Section (EWS) certificate holders.

application_process:

Applicants must submit their applications along with all required documents, including Aadhaar card, NET examination mark sheet, academic certificates, Ph.D. registration certificate, and bank account details. 
After evaluation by a selection committee, eligible research scholars are awarded annual scholarships to support their research in Sanskrit.

Aadhaar Card
NET Examination Marksheet
Academic Certificates
Ph.D. Registration Certificate
Bank Account Details
Caste Certificate

scheme_name: Scheduled Caste Dashamottar Scholarship (Starting from Class 11) - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to support Scheduled Caste students of Uttarakhand from Class 11th onwards by providing financial assistance for their education, including tuition fees and other academic expenses.
benefits:
*The total scholarship amount determined by the districts = Educational Allowance + Tuition Fee.*
*Group 1:*
Professional courses at undergraduate and postgraduate levels

 - Hostellers: ₹13,500/-
 - Day Scholars: ₹7,000/-

*Group 2:*
Other Professional Courses leading to Degree, Diploma, Certificate

 - Hostellers: ₹9,500/-
 - Day Scholars: ₹6,500/-

*Group 3*
Undergraduate and postgraduate courses which do not fall under Group 1 and 2

 - Hostellers: ₹6,000/-
 - Day Scholars: ₹3,000/-

*Group 4*
All Post Matriculation (level after Class 10th) Non-Degree Courses

 - Hostellers: ₹4,000/-
 - Day Scholars: ₹2,500/-
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized school/educational institution in Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 11 or higher level course.
 1. The applicant must possess valid documents, such as Caste Certificate, Residence Certificate, Bank Passbook, Aadhaar, Photograph, Educational Qualification Certificates, and Income Certificate.
 1. The total annual income of the parents/guardians from all sources must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh.
 1. The scholarship will be available for one year only for studying in any class.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Students apply online on the Government of India’s National Scholarship Portal (NSP) (https://scholarships.gov.in). 
The following documents must be uploaded with the application: Caste Certificate, Residence Certificate, Bank Passbook, Aadhaar, Photograph, Educational Qualification Certificates, and Income Certificate.
The student submits the application to their educational institution using their own ID. The concerned educational institution forwards the received online application to the District Social Welfare Officer. The District Social Welfare Officer examines the received applications and conducts physical verification of the complete applications. Incomplete applications that can be corrected are temporarily marked as defective, while those that cannot be corrected are permanently rejected. The eligible applicants receive the scholarship amount directly in their bank accounts, subject to the availability of funds.
Procedure:
Step 1: The student registers and submits the application form online.
Step 2: The educational institution verifies the submitted applications.
Step 3: Physical verification of the students is conducted by the Social Welfare Department (DSWO) and/or a third-party agency appointed by the government.
Step 4: Online verification is completed at the Social Welfare Department (DSWO) level.
Step 5: The scholarship amount is disbursed to the students whose applications are fully verified, through the PFMS (Public Financial Management System).
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Photograph
Caste Certificate
Residence Certificate
Bank Passbook
Educational Qualification Certificates
Income Certificate
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Scheduled Tribe/Scheduled Caste Subplan
description: The scheme aims to promote fish farming as a sustainable livelihood opportunity among individuals and groups belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
benefits:
Under this scheme:

 - Pond clusters, comprising a minimum of 10 ponds at one location, are created for individuals belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. The scheme provides 60% of the total cost as a grant for pond construction and the first-year investment, including expenses on fish hatcheries and feed. A minimum of 10 ponds will be constructed in each village.
 - Individual beneficiaries are eligible to receive a grant for a maximum of 500 cubic meters, up to ₹3,00,000/-. For societies, groups, mahasanghs, federations, or mangal dals belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, a grant of ₹5,10,000/- is provided, which constitutes 60% of the total project cost of ₹8,50,000/- for the construction of a 1-hectare pond in the plains.
 - Ponds of sizes ranging from 0.05 to 0.50 hectares will be constructed in the plains under this scheme.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be an individual belonging to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category and residing in the mountainous or plain areas of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be interested in, or currently engaged in, fish farming or fish production.
 1. The applicant (individual or group) must own or lease land and have a nearby water source within the state.
 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To avail the benefits of this scheme, eligible beneficiaries or groups must submit an application to the office of the Assistant Director of Fisheries or the District Fisheries Incharge at the district level. The application must include an Aadhaar card, land records, permanent residence certificate, bank account details, mobile number, Caste Certificate and, in the case of group applications, the relevant registration certificate or land availability certificate.
(In the future, the application process will be made available online through the Apuni Sarkar Portal.)
After submission of the application, a survey is conducted by fisheries inspectors or field personnel, and a proposal is prepared in collaboration with the beneficiary. Once the proposal is finalized, the concerned district officer grants approval. Pond construction work is then carried out under the supervision and technical guidance of field personnel.
If a beneficiary does not have the required 40% of funds, they may obtain a loan from the nearest cooperative or commercial bank. In the case of a loan, the bank approves the proposal prepared by the department and releases the funds after completing the necessary formalities. Upon completion of the construction, the subsidy is transferred to the beneficiary’s account via DBT based on the completion certificate. In the case of a loan, the subsidy is transferred to the beneficiary through the bank.
Technical assistance from the department is available at any time. If required, beneficiaries are also provided with free training. For fish marketing, beneficiaries are free to sell their produce directly in the market or through UttaraFish, a fishery enterprise established by the department.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Permanent Residence Certificate
Khasra-Khatauni of Land (Land Ownership Document)
Bank Account Details/Copy of Front Page of Bank Passbook
Mobile Number
Group Registration Certificate (in case of group application)
Land Availability Certificate (if land is not owned by the applicant but is accessible)
Photograph of pond construction site
Caste Certificate

scheme_name: Scheme for Construction of Ideal Fish Pond in Hilly Areas
description: The scheme aims to encourage individuals and groups to construct fish ponds by providing financial assistance and to promote sustainable fish farming while enhancing livelihood opportunities in the hilly regions of the state.
benefits:
Under this scheme:

 - Pond clusters (a minimum of 10 ponds must be built at one location) are created to better utilize water resources in mountainous areas, individuals of all castes are eligible to receive a 50% grant for pond construction and the first year’s investment, including fish hatchery and feed. A single individual can construct up to 10 ponds, or a group of individuals may construct them collectively.
 - Free technical assistance is provided for rearing fish species with high growth rates.
 - Individual beneficiaries are eligible for a grant for pond construction up to 500 cubic meters, with a maximum grant amount of ₹2.5 lakh.
 - For a society, group, federation, or mangal dal, a maximum grant of ₹5 lakh is provided for pond construction up to 1000 cubic meters.
 - Beneficiaries are required to contribute the remaining 50% of the cost from their own resources or through a bank loan.
eligibility:
1. All caste categories, both women and men from the hilly areas of Uttarakhand who are interested in or engaged in fish production, are eligible under this scheme.
 1. The beneficiary must have land or leased land and an available water supply source within the state.
 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To avail the benefits of this scheme, eligible beneficiaries or groups must submit an application to the office of the Assistant Director of Fisheries or the District Fisheries Incharge at the district level. The application must include an Aadhaar card, land records, permanent residence certificate, bank account details, mobile number, and, in the case of group applications, the relevant registration certificate or land availability certificate.
(In the future, the application process will be made available online through the Apuni Sarkar portal.)
After submission of the application, a survey is conducted by fisheries inspectors or field personnel, and a proposal is prepared in collaboration with the beneficiary. Once the proposal is finalized, the concerned district officer grants approval. Pond construction work is then carried out under the supervision and technical guidance of field personnel.
If a beneficiary does not have the required 50% of funds, they may obtain a loan from the nearest cooperative or commercial bank. In the case of a loan, the bank approves the proposal prepared by the department and releases the funds after completing the necessary formalities. Upon completion of the construction, the subsidy is transferred to the beneficiary’s account via DBT based on the completion certificate. In the case of a loan, the subsidy is transferred to the beneficiary through the bank.
Technical assistance from the department is available at any time. If required, beneficiaries are also provided with free training. For fish marketing, beneficiaries are free to sell their produce directly in the market or through UttaraFish, a fishery enterprise established by the department.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Khasra-Khatauni of Land (Land Ownership Document)
Permanent Residence Certificate
Bank Account Details
Mobile Number
Photo of construction Site
Relevant registration certificate or land availability certificate (in case of group application)

scheme_name: Scheme for Fencing in Gardens
description: The scheme aims to protect fruit plants, horticultural crops, and orchards from wild animals by providing financial assistance for fencing.
benefits: The scheme provides financial support for fencing gardens to protect fruit plants, horticultural crops, and orchards from wild animals, offering a subsidy of 50% of the total cost, up to a maximum of ₹1.00 lakh per hectare.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a farmer and must hold a valid Udhyan Card.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Applications for garden fencing must be submitted to the officers or staff at the Horticulture Mobile team Centres. The application should include land-related documents such as Khasra and Khatauni, Aadhaar card, PAN card, Udhyan card, bank account details, and mobile number. Currently, the application process is offline.
If a farmer faces difficulty in filling out the application, personnel at the respective Horticulture Mobile team Centre will provide assistance. Once submitted, the application is forwarded by the Centre to the district level, which then sends it to the Directorate. Upon approval of the farmer’s proposal by the Directorate, a government order is issued, authorizing the district to grant approval/work orders accordingly.
Upon acceptance, the district officer sends the farmer an approval letter and informs them via phone. The fencing is then carried out in the presence of departmental officials, followed by an on-site inspection. After verification, the subsidy is disbursed directly into the farmer’s account.
documents_required:
Land-related documents such as Khasra and Khatauni
Aadhaar Card
PAN Card
Udhyan Card
Bank Account Details
Mobile Number

scheme_name: Scheme for Providing Soft Skill Training Courses to Students Studying in State Colleges
description: The scheme aims to enhance the soft skills of students studying in state colleges of Uttarakhand by providing training through Mahindra Pride Classroom and the Nandi Foundation.
benefits: Soft Skill training courses are being organized in various colleges of the state through Mahindra Pride Classroom and Nandi Foundation.
eligibility: 1. All students studying in the colleges of Uttarakhand are eligible.
application_process: Mode: Offline. Under the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of Uttarakhand and the Nandi Foundation, soft skill courses will be conducted in Satpuli, Kanda, Nainbag, Garud, Lohaghat, Ranikhet, Haldwani, and Raipur. Students from selected government colleges can participate in these courses.
documents_required: Documents required as per Soft Skill Training Course guidelines.

scheme_name: Scholarship for Engineering and Medical Education
description: The scheme aims to support the higher education of dependents of ex-servicemen by providing financial assistance for pursuing engineering, medical, and PhD courses. Under this scheme, annual scholarships are awarded to beneficiaries based on their course of study.
benefits:
Rate of Scholarship:

• ₹12,000/- per year for Engineering students
• ₹15,000/- per year for Medical students
• ₹10,000/- per year for PhD students
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be a dependent of an ex-serviceman.
 1. The applicant should be pursuing a course in Engineering, Medical, or Ph.D. from a recognized institution.

Note: It is mandatory that the applicant's correct name is mentioned both in the bank account and the discharge book.
application_process:
Mode: Online. The applicant must apply online on the official website of the Sainik Welfare Department at www.sainikkalyan.org
The following documents are required for the application: Aadhaar card of the applicant, bank account details, ex-serviceman identity card, discharge book, and a certificate of the course in which the applicant is studying. 
After verification of applications at the District Sainik Welfare Office and Directorate level, applicants found eligible are provided the sanctioned amount through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) from the Kargil Shaheed Parivar Mukhyamantri Sahayata Kosh.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card of the Applicant
Bank Account Details
Ex-serviceman Identity Card
Discharge Book of the ex-serviceman
Certificate of the course in which the student is studying

scheme_name: Scholarship on Merit Basis
description: The scheme aims to encourage meritorious students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate studies at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University by awarding scholarships to those who secure the highest marks in the relevant course, class, or subject.
benefits: Under this scheme, one student from each undergraduate and postgraduate class at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University is awarded a scholarship equal to the tuition fee of their respective class.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate course at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University.
1. The student must have secured the highest marks in the relevant course, class, or subject.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. A Scholarship Cell has been established at the university level to manage the scholarship process. The cell provides application forms to students, who must complete the forms and submit them along with their high school certificate, Aadhaar card, grade sheet, and bank account details. 
After scrutinizing the applications, the cell prepares a list of eligible students. Upon administrative and financial approval, the scholarship funds are transferred directly to the bank accounts of the eligible students.
documents_required:
High School Certificate
Aadhaar Card
Mark Sheet of the respective Class
Bank Account Details

scheme_name: scholarship scheme - Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board, Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the sons and daughters of small and marginal farmers, agricultural laborers, and market workers of Uttarakhand to pursue higher education in Agriculture, Forestry, Fisheries, Horticulture & other related fields.
benefits: Students pursuing courses in Agriculture, Forestry, Fisheries, Horticulture and other related fields at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar; R.M.P. (P.G.) College, Gurukul Narsan, Haridwar; V.C.S.G. Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and Forestry, Bharsar, Pauri Garhwal; and the College of Horticulture, V.C.S.G. Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and Forestry, Ranichauri, are eligible for scholarships, which are awarded to the sons and daughters of small and marginal farmers, agricultural laborers, market laborers, and their dependents to support their higher education in these fields.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a student.
1. The applicant must be the son or daughter of a small or marginal farmer, agricultural laborer, or mandi worker, or their dependent.

application_process:

Eligible students must apply to the university or college.
Meritorious students will be selected by a committee constituted by the university or college.

Identity proof

scheme_name: Scholarship to Divyang Students (Class 1 to 8)
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹600/- for students in Class 1 to 5 and ₹960/- for students in Class 6 to 8, to regularly enrolled disable students.
benefits:
*Rate of Scholarships:*

• Class 1 to 5: ₹600/- - Class 6 to 8: ₹960/-
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a disabled student.
1. The applicant must be studying in Class 1 to 8.
1. The applicant’s annual family income must be less than ₹24,000/-.
1. The student must not availing benefits from any other scholarship scheme.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Students can apply online for scholarship by visiting the NSP Portal of Government of India (https://scholarships.gov.in/).
The following documents will be attached with the application: Aadhaar card of the applicant, mobile number, certified photo and CBS bank account which is Aadhaar linked/seeded, previous class passed mark sheet, disability certificate, income certificate, self-declaration certificate that the applicant is not taking benefit of any other scholarship scheme of the government. 
The student sends the application to his/her educational institution; the concerned educational institution verifies the application form and forwards it online to the District Social Welfare Officer.
The District Social Welfare Officer examines the received application form and gets the complete application forms physically verified. Incomplete applications (which can be corrected) are temporarily marked as defective, otherwise they are completely rejected. The scholarship amount is paid to the eligible applicants directly in their bank account in the financial year as per the availability of budget.
documents_required:

Mobile number
Verified photo
CBS bank account linked/seeded to Aadhaar
Previous class mark sheet
Disability certificate

Self-declaration form stating that the student is not availing benefits from any other scholarship scheme

scheme_name: Scholarship to Poor Students
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students enrolled in undergraduate and postgraduate programs at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University.
benefits: Under this scheme, one student from each undergraduate and postgraduate class at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University is awarded a scholarship equal to the tuition fee of their respective class.

application_process:

scheme_name: Scholarships to Meritorious Students of Sanskrit Schools
description: The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education by providing scholarships to meritorious students of Prathmik Madhyama (Class 10) and Uttar Madhyama (Class 12) in Sanskrit schools who secure the highest marks.
benefits:
1. Meritorious students of Prathmik Madhyama (Class 10) are awarded a scholarship of ₹500 per month for 20 months.
1. Three meritorious students of Uttar Madhyama (Class 12) are awarded cash prizes:

• First Position: ₹20,000/-- Second Position: ₹15,000/-- Third Position: ₹10,000/-
eligibility:

 1. The applicant must have secured a place in the top 10 in the class 10th merit list or in the top 3 in the class 12th merit list from the Board Examination of Sanskrit School. 1. The applicant must be currently studying in class 11th or 12th after clearing class 10th.
application_process:
Mode: Online. The student’s application is first forwarded and recommended by the school principal, and then by the Assistant Director of the respective district.
Required documents include the Aadhaar card, bank account details, and the merit list certificate.
If the student’s name appears in the merit list, they or their guardian can submit the application online through the Apuni Sarkar portal during the same session.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Bank Account Details
Merit List Certificate

scheme_name: Science Communication and Popularization
description: The scheme aims to promote scientific thinking and awareness among citizens by providing support and funding to educational institutions, R&D organizations, and NGOs to organize science communication activities.
benefits:
Popularization of Science is one of the key programs initiated by the Council to promote scientific temper among the citizens of Uttarakhand, particularly the youth. A number of activities are conducted under this program. 
The Council provides financial assistance for organizing various events such as seminars, workshops, and conferences. It also organizes popular lectures and celebrates National Science Day.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be an educational, research, or development organization, or an NGO based in Uttarakhand.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Proposals are invited twice a year through advertisements published on the website: https://www.ucost.in. 
The received proposals are evaluated in the Project Evaluation Group (PEG) meeting, where expert committee members assess them and recommend proposals for funding that address state-specific issues and contribute to the overall welfare of the state.
documents_required: Documents should be submitted as per the guidelines of the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology.

scheme_name: Seed Grant
description: The scheme aims to provide seeds to farmers at a concessional rate during Kisan Melas with a subsidy of up to 15%.
benefits: Farmers are provided seeds at a subsidy of up to 15% during Kisan Melas.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a farmer.
application_process: Mode: Offline. All farmers are provided seeds during Kisan Melas on the basis of availability.
documents_required:
1. Identity card
2. Other documents as required

scheme_name: Seemant Parvatiya Janpad Baal Vigyan Mahotsav
description: It aims to provide students from classes 6 to 12 of government/non-government schools in six border districts of the state (Uttarkashi, Chamoli, Rudraprayag, Champawat, Bageshwar,Pithoragarh) with an opportunity to participate in science competitions & to promote scientific awareness in these areas.
benefits: Under this, special opportunities are provided to child scientists from the border hill districts to participate in various state-level science competitions and to promote scientific awareness through activities in remote border areas.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a student from classes 6 to 12, studying in a government or non-government school in any of the six border districts of the state: Uttarkashi, Chamoli, Rudraprayag, Champawat, Bageshwar, or Pithoragarh.
application_process: Mode: Offline. All students from classes 6th to 12th can participate at the block level. The students selected at the block level then participate at the district level, and those selected at the district level get an opportunity to participate at the state level.
documents_required: Documents are required as per the guidelines of the science competition (Vigyan Mahotsav).

scheme_name: Self-Employment Scheme for Scheduled Castes and Tribes
description: The scheme aims to support scheduled castes and scheduled tribes families below the poverty line through concessional loans and subsidies for self-employment in various sectors.
category: Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance
benefits:
> Financial Assistance:

• Loan Amount: Project loans from ₹20,000/- to ₹7,00,000/- through nationalized banks.- Subsidy: 50% of the project cost or up to ₹10,000/- as government subsidy.- Margin Money: 25% of project cost provided at 4% annual interest.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Castes and Tribes community.
1. The applicant must be living below the poverty line.
1. The applicant annual income must not exceed ₹15,975/- in rural areas and ₹21,206/- in urban areas.
1. The applicant must not be a defaulter of any bank or financial institution.
1. The applicant must not have availed any subsidy from any government scheme earlier.
1. The applicant must possess a commercial driving license.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Application Process:Step 1: The interested applicant downloads the application form from the official website.
Step 2: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Village Development Officer/Assistant Social Welfare Officer/Block Development Officer.
Selection Process:Rural Areas: Beneficiaries are selected through open meetings in Gram Sabha.
Urban Areas: Selection is done through interviews.
documents_required:
Passport-size Photograph.
BPL Card.
Caste Certificate (Issued by Tehsildar).
Income Certificate (Issued by Tehsildar/BDO).
Bank Details. 
Any Other Document if Required.

scheme_name: Self-Employment Scheme for Unemployed Minority Communities
description: The scheme aims to provide a grant of 25% of the loan amount (for loans ranging from ₹1 lakh to ₹10 lakh) to individuals belonging to minority communities, who are permanent residents of Uttarakhand, for the purpose of self-employment.
benefits:
• Under this scheme, a grant is provided for self-employment. On taking a loan of ₹1 lakh to ₹10 lakh, a grant of 25% of the loan amount is given, with a minimum grant of ₹25,000/- and a maximum of ₹2,50,000/-.
 - The benefit of the scheme is available only on taking a loan, in which 60% of the project cost is provided as a loan, 25% as grant/subsidy by the department, and 15% as contribution by the applicant.
 - Interest on the loan will be charged according to the current prevailing rates of the bank.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain).
1. The applicant’s age should be between 18 and 55 years.
1. The annual family income from all sources should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-, or the applicant should be a member of a BPL family.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Advertisement is issued by the department to select the beneficiary. Thereafter, the application form can be obtained from the district offices of the state (District Minority Welfare Officer / District Social Welfare Officer).
Along with the application form, the applicant must attach the prescribed income certificate / BPL certificate, caste certificate, permanent residence certificate, Aadhaar card, bank account details, and a project report for the proposed scheme. The completed application form should then be submitted to the office of the District Minority Welfare Officer / District Social Welfare Officer of the concerned district.
Thereafter, an interview is conducted by a selection committee constituted under the chairmanship of the Chief Development Officer at the district level. The application forms of candidates who are successful in the interview are forwarded to the applicant’s bank for loan sanction.
After the bank sanctions the loan, the district office sends the application form to the corporation headquarters for the release of 25% of the grant amount upon completion of all formalities. The grant amount is made available to the district office after approval from the Managing Director at the Corporation Headquarters.
Thereafter, the district office, after receiving 15% of the beneficiary’s share, transfers 40% of the total amount to the concerned bank, after which the bank releases the loan to the applicant.
Currently, the application process is offline, while the online process is under development.
documents_required:
Income certificate / BPL certificate
Caste certificate
Permanent residence certificate
Aadhaar card
Bank account details
A project report for the proposed scheme

scheme_name: Shilpi Gram Scheme (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe)

Free Skill Training:

• Training is offered at three levels — awareness & orientation, basic training, and vocational training.

Infrastructure Support:

Marketing Assistance:

• Support for exhibitions, fairs, permanent haats, and promotion of Uttarakhand-branded craft products.

• Awards for outstanding artisans and participation in national/international fairs.

Exposure Visits:

scheme_name: Shodhgrantha Chayan Yojana
description: The scheme aims to invite scholars from any state in India to submit research manuscripts on Sanskrit literature, as well as socially relevant research books related to Sanskrit literature in the context of Uttarakhand.
benefits: For the research paper, the author receives an honorarium of ₹151/- per page, and 25 copies of the published book are provided free of cost.
eligibility:
1. Authentic and socially relevant research books related to Sanskrit literature in the context of Uttarakhand are invited for publication.
 1. Scholars from any state of the country (who write research papers within the scope of research methodology) will be eligible.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. In accordance with the thesis selection rules, advertisements are published in newspapers and on websites. 
Authors must submit three copies of their thesis along with the application form and an affidavit certifying the originality of the work. 
Eligible theses are published by the evaluation committee.
documents_required:
Three (3) copies of the research manuscript
An affidavit declaring the originality of the manuscript
Any other documents as required

scheme_name: Shooting Permission Certificate
description: The scheme aims to simplify the process of granting official permission for film shooting in Uttarakhand through a single-window online system, ensuring timely approvals and promoting the state as a film-friendly destination.
benefits: Permission is provided for shooting films in the state.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a film producer.
application_process:
Mode: Online. Before obtaining permission for film production, the producer must apply online on the "Single Window System" portal at https://investuttarakhand.uk.gov.in/filmshooting. While submitting the application, the producer must attach the Aadhaar Card, synopsis of the film, Registration Certificate/GST of the production house, or, in the case of a line producer handling the production, an authorization letter for the line producer, along with the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) form filled online.
Once the department grants permission, a copy of the Film Shooting Permission Certificate is automatically sent to the relevant departments through the portal. The list of departments is as follows:
Office of the District Magistrate
Senior Superintendent of Police / Superintendent of Police
Concerned DFO/Ranger/Forest Officer
Concerned Kotwali / Police Station / Outpost In-charge
If the film is to be shot in a centrally operated forest area, the Film Development Council corresponds with the Chief Conservator of Forests (CCF) and the concerned Divisional Forest Officer (DFO) for the issuance of a No Objection Certificate.
Permission for film shooting is also provided to the filmmaker free of cost within 14 days through email at ufdc2015@gmail.com.
documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Synopsis of the film
Registration Certificate/GST of the production house
Authorization letter for the Line Producer (if applicable)
Filled Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) form

scheme_name: Shri Varun Panwar Memorial Award for B.Sc. Agriculture (2nd Year, 3rd Year, and 4th Year) Students
description: The scheme aims to recognize and encourage B.Sc. Agriculture students in their 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year of study by awarding them a cash prize of ₹10,000/- for their academic excellence.
benefits:
1. Award Amount: ₹10,000/- per year
1. Number of Awards: One award for each class

• 2nd Year: 1 student
• 3rd Year: 1 student
• 4th Year: 1 student
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a student.
 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the B.Sc. Agriculture program and be in their 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year of study at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar.
 1. The award is granted for a duration of one year only.
application_process: Mode: Offline. Students are first invited to submit their applications on the prescribed form. A committee, constituted by the Vice Chancellor, then reviews and evaluates these applications following a defined procedure. Based on the committee’s recommendations, the Vice Chancellor grants approval, after which the selected students receive the payments.
documents_required: Documents are required in accordance with the university guidelines prescribed for this scheme.

scheme_name: Shridev Suman State Merit Scholarship
description: The scheme provides monthly scholarship of ₹1,000/- to meritorious students who qualify in eligibility test conducted by SCERT Uttarakhand. The scholarship is awarded to the next 5 students from each development block of Uttarakhand who are not selected for the Dr. Shivanand Nautiyal Scholarship.
benefits:
• On the basis of the declared results of the eligibility test conducted by SCERT Uttarakhand, the scholarship is awarded to the next five students from each of the 95 development blocks of Uttarakhand (95 × 5 = 475) who are not selected for the Dr. Shivanand Nautiyal Scholarship. 
 - Each selected student receives ₹1,000/- per month for a duration of 10 months.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must be an institutional student of Class 8 in any government, local body, or government-aided school (excluding central and residential schools) in Uttarakhand.
 1. The applicant must have passed the annual Class 7 examination with a minimum of 50% marks (40% for reserved categories).
 1. There is no restriction on the annual income of parents or guardians.
 1. The scholarship will be awarded for a period of 4 years, from Class 9 to Class 12.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. To appear in the scholarship examination, students can obtain the application form from the office of the Block Education Officer or download it from the School Education Department’s website (https://schooleducation.uk.gov.in) or SCERT Uttarakhand’s website (https://scert.uk.gov.in) during September–October every year. A photocopy of the application form is also valid. No application or examination fee is charged.
While filling out the application form, students must attach a passport-size photograph, Aadhaar card, Class 7 mark sheet, caste certificate, and disability certificate (if applicable). All information must be filled in correctly, and the completed form should be submitted to the Principal of the school where the student is enrolled.
The Principal will verify the form based on the attached documents and school records, attest the photograph, and forward the verified form to the Block Education Officer’s office by the tentative date of 12 November.
After submission, the Block Education Officer issues the admit card. Students can collect the admit card either from their school or the Block Education Officer’s office.
The examination is conducted every year in the month of January.
After the successful completion of the process, the school Principal informs the student. The student must provide their Aadhaar card and Aadhaar-linked bank account details to the school, following which the scholarship amount is transferred directly to the student’s bank account.
documents_required:
Recent Passport-Size Photograph
Aadhaar Card
Class 7 Marksheet
Caste Certificate (for reserved category students)
Income Certificate of Parents/Guardians
Residence Certificate
Disability Certificate (if applicable)

scheme_name: Silage evam Dudharu Pashu Poshan Yojana
description: The scheme aims to improve the nutrition of dairy animals and enhance milk production by providing subsidized silage and feed to members of milk cooperative societies.
benefits:
• Under this scheme, members of milk cooperative societies in hilly and plain rural areas are provided with quality mineral mixtures and probiotics at current rates, receive a 75% subsidy on silage including an upfront subsidy of ₹2.00 per kg.
 - Compact feed blocks are available at a 50% subsidy, costing the beneficiary ₹8.00 per kg.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a member of a milk-producing cooperative society supplying milk to the society.
application_process: Mode: Offline. The porer member who supplies milk to the societies must submit an application for fodder, addressed to the Secretary of the society. Based on the requirement verified by the concerned society Secretary, the demand is forwarded to the District Milk Union, and the animal nutrition feed is provided to the member through the milk cooperative society itself.
documents_required: Documents required as per the directions of the concerned milk cooperative society.

scheme_name: Silk Tree Plantation
description: The scheme aims to promote mulberry cultivation and silkworm rearing among farmers in Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance, technical support, and organized cluster-based sericulture activities to enhance their income and livelihood.
benefits: Under this scheme, selected farmers in a cluster receive a grant of ₹17,244/- for silk tree plantations, and 2-silk trees are provided free of cost by the department.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The beneficiary must belong to a cluster or group.
 1. In mountainous areas, a minimum of 25 farmers is required for a cluster, while in plain areas, at least 50 farmers are mandatory.
 1. The beneficiaries in the group must have land available for the plantation of at least 300 plants.
 1. Silkworm rearing is conducted under departmental supervision. Therefore, clusters must be selected within a 15–20 km radius of departmental silkworm farms. If the distance exceeds this, the selected group must provide one acre of land for a collective rearing center and may conduct silkworm rearing after receiving training.
 1. Priority is given to farmers who already practice sericulture or those who have mulberry saplings available. Mulberry silkworm rearing can be carried out up to an altitude of 4,000 feet, although warmer valley areas are more suitable for this activity.
 1. The department has not specified any particular regions for silkworm rearing; however, most state-run sericulture farms were established in locations where mulberry silk production is feasible.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Interested beneficiaries are selected through publicity seminars and meetings organized in the area by representatives of cooperative societies or silk self-help groups affiliated with the Chowki centers and center/range in-charges.
Upon receiving a cluster proposal in a specific area, an expert committee conducts a field inspection to determine whether the area is suitable for silkworm plantations. Based on the recommendations of the inspection, mulberry plantations and other activities are carried out in accordance with the plan’s guidelines, with technical assistance from departmental personnel.
To prepare the Project Implementation Sheet (PIS) of the selected beneficiaries, documents such as voter ID/ration card, bank account details, land ownership documents, and photographs of the plantation area are collected. Subsequently, tree planting and other activities are completed under departmental supervision, and grant funds are disbursed to farmers based on the work completed.
documents_required:
Voter ID Card or Ration Card
Bank Account Details
Land Documents / Ownership Proof
Photographs of the Plantation Area
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Silkworm Rearing Chamber
description: The scheme aims to promote sericulture & enhance silk production among farmers by providing financial assistance for establishing dedicated silkworm rearing chambers. Under this scheme, farmers are provided financial support of upto ₹1,00,000 (80:10:10 pattern) for construction of rearing chambers.
benefits: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- is provided for the construction of a silkworm rearing chamber on an 80:10:10 cost-sharing basis. The farmer contributes ₹10,000/- for completing the foundation of the chamber, while the state government provides ₹90,000/- as a subsidy in two equal installments.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The beneficiary must have availed assistance under the Silk Tree Plantation Scheme.
 1. The beneficiary must have at least 300 mulberry plants available for silkworm rearing.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Under the Silk Samagra Yojana, farmers are selected in cluster mode. A departmental committee conducts a field inspection, and the scheme is implemented based on the suitability of the area. The required documents are compiled to prepare the farmer’s Project Implementation Sheet (PIS).
For the construction of the rearing chamber, the farmer builds the foundation using their own funds. Based on the progress of the construction and the recommendations of the cluster in-charge, the government subsidy is released into the farmer’s account in accordance with the scheme guidelines.
documents_required:
Voter ID/Ration Card
Bank Account Detail
Details of construction of rearing chamber
Other supporting documents as required

scheme_name: Silkworm Rearing Equipment
description: The scheme aims to support individuals in silkworm rearing by providing necessary equipment, financial assistance, and technical guidance. Under this scheme, financial assistance of upto ₹40,000/- is provided to individuals for procuring essential equipment required for silkworm rearing.
benefits: Under this scheme, selected beneficiaries are provided ₹40,000/- (in an 80:10:10 ratio) to purchase equipment necessary for silkworm rearing. Beneficiaries are required to contribute 10% of this amount themselves for the installation of the leaf chamber, while other rearing materials are provided by the department.
eligibility:
1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
 1. The beneficiary must belong to a cluster or group.
 1. In hilly areas, a minimum of 25 farmers is required to form a cluster, while in plain areas, at least 50 farmers are mandatory.
 1. The beneficiary must be willing to engage in sericulture.
 1. Preference will be given to farmers who are already engaged in sericulture or who have mulberry seedlings available.
 1. Under the Silk Samagra Yojana, saplings are planted on the boundaries of farmers’ fields, with a standard of 300 saplings per acre.
 1. All farmers in the selected cluster are required to plant the saplings.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. Interested beneficiaries are selected through publicity seminars, meetings, and training programs organized in the area by representatives of cooperative societies or silk self-help groups affiliated with the Chowki centers and center/range in-charges.
Upon receiving a cluster proposal for a specific area, an expert committee conducts a field inspection to determine whether the area is suitable for silkworm plantations. Following the recommendations of the field inspection, mulberry plantations and other related activities are carried out in accordance with the action plan guidelines, with the technical support of departmental personnel.
To prepare the Project Implementation Sheet (PIS) of selected beneficiaries, documents such as voter ID or ration card, bank account details, land documents, and photographs of the plantation area are collected. Leaf chambers are established by the farmers, while other rearing materials are provided by the department.
Under the Silk Samagra Yojana, training is provided to all selected farmers in the cluster, covering tree plantation, silkworm rearing, and related activities. Beneficiaries who are not selected under the scheme are also provided training in the same manner as mentioned above.
documents_required:
Voter ID Card/Ration Card
Bank Account Details
Land Documents / Ownership Proof
Photographs of the Plantation Area
Other supporting documents as required

description: The scheme aims to enhance the employability and entrepreneurial skills of students, researchers, and farmers in the field of biotechnology, thereby promoting self-employment and entrepreneurship in emerging areas of the biotechnology sector.
benefits:
Training programs are organized to promote self-employment under the Skill Development in Critical Areas of Biotechnology. These programs range in duration from 30/45 to 90 days for undergraduate and postgraduate students, and 180 days (Dissertation Program) for postgraduate students.
During the training period, selected students conduct their research and practical training in the Council’s modern research laboratories. The trainees receive hands-on training in plant tissue culture, molecular biology and genetic engineering, environmental biotechnology, hydroponics, and soilless farming. After receiving the training, beneficiaries are better able to manage their business, self-employment, and agricultural activities.

Candidates can apply for training of 30, 45, or 90 days by downloading the application form and guidelines from the Council’s website www.ucb.ac.in. The duly completed application (hard copy or soft copy) should be submitted to the Council’s address after obtaining the recommendation of the competent authority, Principal, or Head of Department.
Selection is based on merit. For short-term training, students are provided training in the relevant area or laboratory. For the six-month Research Dissertation Programme (Dissertation), the Council issues a notification on its website, and after receiving applications, the maximum number of students is selected for training on the basis of merit.
Along with the completed application, candidates must submit photocopies of their Aadhar Card, high school, intermediate, graduation, and post-graduation certificates and mark sheets, as well as any other equivalent degree certificates, permanent residence proof, and caste certificate (if applicable).

scheme_name: Soil Health Card Scheme - Uttarakhand
description: The scheme aims to provide Soil Health Cards to all farmers in the state, helping them understand the nutrient composition of their soil and the type and quantity of fertilizers suitable for their crops.
benefits:
• To provide Soil Health Cards to all farmers in the state.
 - The soil of each farmer’s field is tested at soil testing laboratories, which are operational in all 13 districts.
 - Farmers receive detailed information about the nutrient content of their soil, along with recommendations on the type and quantity of fertilizers best suited for their crops.
 - Soil testing is provided free of cost to farmers.
 - In hilly areas, a Soil Health Card is issued for agricultural land up to 2.5 hectares, while in plain areas, it is issued for land up to 10 hectares. Each card is valid for three years.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must be a farmer.
1. The farmer must own agricultural land in the state and be actively engaged in farming activities.
application_process:
Mode: Offline. First, the farmer must collect a soil sample from his or her field. The process is as follows: The farmer should identify six locations in his or her field from which he or she wishes to collect samples. He or she should clean the area from which the sample is to be taken, such as removing the grass on top of the soil. Dry soil is used for soil testing. If the collected soil sample is moist, it should be dried in the shade to allow it to air dry.
To collect a sample, dig a V-shaped pit 6 inches deep, 6 inches long, and 4 inches wide with a shovel or hoe. Collect approximately 1–2 inches of soil from the top to the bottom along the edge of the pit. Remove this collected soil and place it in a clean area. Collect soil from six locations in this manner. Once the soil is collected, mix it thoroughly and remove any pebbles, stones, grass, or roots. Divide the thoroughly mixed soil into four equal parts, discarding two, and retain the remaining two. Mix the remaining two parts thoroughly again, then divide them into four equal parts, discarding two. Repeat this process until you have half a kilogram of soil left. Half a kilogram of soil is a suitable sample for testing.
This half-kilogram soil sample should be kept in a clean bag, and a slip should be put in the bag in which the farmer’s name, complete address, Khasra number, mobile number, and information about the crop he or she wants to grow are mentioned. Along with the sample, the Aadhar card, residence certificate, and mobile number should also be included.
Farmers can submit this sample to the soil testing laboratory of their district themselves or through the Assistant Agriculture Officer of their Panchayat. After submission, when this sample is tested, the farmer is provided with his or her soil health card, according to which he or she can carry out farming and use manure and fertilizers. If a farmer in a remote district is unable to reach the headquarters, he or she can avail of the soil testing facility by contacting the in-charge of the Agriculture Department of his or her Panchayat, and the Aadhar card, residence certificate, and mobile number will be required.
documents_required:
Aadhar card
Residence certificate
Mobile number

scheme_name: Solar Based Hydroponic System
description: The system aims to develop and promote an innovative solar-based hydroponic system that integrates solar energy with modern greenhouse technology and mobile application support.
benefits:
A solar-based hydroponic system has been installed at UCOST Dehradun. 
The solar-based hydroponic system is the latest research in the state, in which an innovative and integrated solar greenhouse-based hydroponic solution and an Android mobile application have been developed for farmers and consumers.
Benefit: The automated solar-based hydroponic system will reduce energy consumption, minimize water usage, and enhance crop yields. The system also has the potential to serve as an entrepreneurial or business model and can be replicated in other Himalayan states, thereby creating improved livelihood opportunities for hill farmers and youth.
Smaller off-grid models of solar-based hydroponic systems, proposed to be developed in addition to on-grid systems, can be installed in remote areas where electricity supply is a major issue. This would help increase the individual income of hill farmers.
eligibility:

scheme_name: Solar Water Heater Yojana - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
description: The scheme aims to promote the use of solar energy for water heating in the state to reduce dependence on conventional electricity and fossil fuels, and to encourage the adoption of green and sustainable energy sources in Uttarakhand.
benefits:
1. Under the Solar Water Heater Scheme, the power supply to electricity consumers in the state is often maintained by purchasing electricity at high rates by the DISCOM during peak hours, which directly impacts both consumers and the state government. The installation of solar water heaters will reduce consumers' dependence on grid power and promote solar energy projects across the state. This scheme represents a significant contribution by the State Government toward fulfilling Government of India’s commitment to achieving the global SDG-7 goals.
 1. The scheme will encourage the use of green and renewable energy across the state.
 1. Increasing the installation of solar water heaters will lead to electricity savings during peak demand periods and a reduction in annual carbon dioxide emissions. Installing a solar water heater system with a capacity of 100 liters per day can reduce carbon dioxide emissions by approximately 1.5 tons per year, resulting in positive environmental impacts.
 1. In the mountainous regions of Uttarakhand, where there is a frequent need for hot water, it is often produced by burning wood, which harms the environment. The adoption of solar water heaters will significantly reduce environmental damage caused by traditional methods such as the use of wood or electricity for water heating.
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
1. The applicant must have a valid electricity connection with Uttarakhand Power Corporation Limited (UPCL).
1. The applicant must be the owner of the residential property where the solar water heater is proposed to be installed.
application_process:
Mode: Online. An online portal (www.uredaonline.uk.gov.in) has been developed for applications and selection under the scheme.
Applicants must register and upload the required information on the portal, including their mobile number, place of establishment, copy of Aadhaar card, electricity bill, bill of the installed plant, prescribed self-declaration form, and the first page of their bank passbook for grant transfer details. They must also upload a copy of the demand draft for the prescribed application fee in favor of the Director, UREDA, or the receipt of the online fee transfer. During registration, the applicant must select their category (General/SC/ST) and specify the capacity of the installed plant.
Applicants must also indicate whether the system is for domestic or non-domestic use based on the electricity bill. The application fee, calculated at ₹100 per 100 liters per day of capacity, must be paid online through the portal. Failure to pay the prescribed fee may lead to rejection of the application.
Applications received on the portal will be processed by UREDA on a first-come, first-served basis, subject to budget availability. The grant will be released only if the installation is found appropriate. After installation, UREDA will conduct a site inspection upon the applicant’s request for a grant through the portal.
Once the application fee and required documents are received, the Senior/Project Officer of the concerned district will inspect the plant. If the installation meets the prescribed standards, a joint inspection report will be uploaded and forwarded to UREDA Headquarters for grant release.
In case deficiencies are found, the applicant must take corrective action, upload the required compliance report, and request a re-inspection through the portal. Applicants are advised to make the final payment to the installation firm only after successful UREDA inspection.
Upon receiving the district officer’s recommendation, UREDA Headquarters will transfer the grant amount online to the beneficiary’s bank account. The beneficiary/approved applicant will then make payment to the installation firm directly. UREDA will not be responsible for or involved in any dispute related to payment between the beneficiary and the installation firm.
In case of non-availability of budget during the financial year, or if the number of applications exceeds the available funds, or if additional funds are not approved for pending applications, or if the state grant cannot be issued for any other reason, the application fee deposited by the applicant will be refunded.
documents_required:
Aadhaar card
Electricity bill
Bill/invoice of the installed solar water heater plant
Prescribed self-declaration form
First page of bank passbook
Demand draft/online payment receipt of the application fee
Mobile number and installation address details
Other supporting documents as required
